

========================================

function properties_() { return PropertiesService.getScriptProperties(); }
function authorize_(admin) {
  const owner=properties_().getProperty('OWNER_EMAIL'),email=Session.getActiveUser().getEmail().trim().toLowerCase();
  if(!owner)throw new Error('Ejecuta setupRadar desde el editor de Apps Script.');
  if(!email || !email.endsWith('@bbva.com'))throw new Error('Accede con tu cuenta bbva.com. Google debe facilitar la identidad del usuario dentro del dominio.');
  const session={email,admin:email===owner};
  if(admin && !session.admin)throw new Error('Acceso no autorizado: se requiere administrador.');
  return session;
}

function metrics_(events,now) {
  const start=now-30*86400000,week=now-7*86400000,day=now-86400000;
  const selected=events.filter(e=>new Date(e.fecha).getTime()>=start),users=new Map(),sessions=new Set(),byDay={},latencies=[];
  let failures=0;
  selected.forEach(e=>{
    const entry=users.get(e.correo)||{correo:e.correo,first:e.fecha,last:e.fecha,sessions:new Set(),actions:0};
    entry.first=entry.first<e.fecha?entry.first:e.fecha;entry.last=entry.last>e.fecha?entry.last:e.fecha;entry.sessions.add(e.sesion);entry.actions++;users.set(e.correo,entry);sessions.add(e.correo+'|'+e.sesion);
    const key=recordDay(e.fecha,settings_().timezone);if(!byDay[key])byDay[key]={sessions:new Set(),users:new Set()};byDay[key].sessions.add(e.correo+'|'+e.sesion);byDay[key].users.add(e.correo);
    if(e.evento==='rendimiento')latencies.push(Number(e.duracion_ms));
    if(e.evento==='error')failures++;
  });
  latencies.sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  const list=[...users.values()].map(e=>({...e,sessions:e.sessions.size})).sort((a,b)=>b.last.localeCompare(a.last));
  return {mau:users.size,wau:list.filter(e=>new Date(e.last).getTime()>=week).length,dau:list.filter(e=>new Date(e.last).getTime()>=day).length,sessions:sessions.size,returning:list.filter(e=>e.sessions>1).length,users:list,daily:Object.entries(byDay).sort(([a],[b])=>a.localeCompare(b)).map(([date,value])=>({date,users:value.users.size,sessions:value.sessions.size})),latencyP95:latencies.length?latencies[Math.ceil(latencies.length*.95)-1]:null,failures,events:selected.length};
}

function serviceQuotaPause_(error){return /for one day|daily quota|quota exceeded|limit exceeded/i.test(String(error?.message||error))?86400000:0;}
function scheduledTriggers_(handler){return ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().filter(trigger=>trigger.getHandlerFunction()===handler);}
function dailyScheduleStatus_(){
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key='daily-schedule',cached=cache.get(key);
  if(cached!==null&&cached!==undefined)return cached==='true';
  const enabled=scheduledTriggers_('dailyRadar_').length>0;cache.put(key,String(enabled),300);return enabled;
}
function replaceDailySchedule_(handler,hour,minute=0){
  scheduledTriggers_(handler).forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));
  ScriptApp.newTrigger(handler).timeBased().atHour(hour).nearMinute(minute).everyDays(1).inTimezone(settings_().timezone).create();
}
function collectionScheduleLabel_(){const config=settings_();return 'Banca digital: diaria · '+config.dailyHour+':00 · '+config.timezone;}
function replaceCollectionSchedule_(){replaceDailySchedule_('dailyRadar_',settings_().dailyHour);CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('daily-schedule');}
function ensureBackgroundWorker_(delay=60000){
  if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('background');return;}
  properties_().setProperty('BACKGROUND_PENDING','true');
  const triggers=scheduledTriggers_('backgroundTick_'),next=Date.now()+Math.max(60000,delay);
  if(triggers.length===1&&Number(properties_().getProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT'))<=next)return;
  triggers.forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));ScriptApp.newTrigger('backgroundTick_').timeBased().after(Math.max(60000,delay)).create();properties_().setProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT',String(next));
}
function translationReadyAt_(){
  const job=translationJob_(),request=properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST'),today=recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone);
  if(job?.state==='Publicando'||!request&&(!job||job.state==='Completada'))return Infinity;
  const paused=Number(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0);if(paused>Date.now())return paused;
  if(translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls)return nextDailyReset(Date.now(),settings_().timezone);
  if(request&&(!job||job.state==='Completada'||recordDay(job.started,settings_().timezone)<today))return Date.now();
  return job&&job.state!=='Completada'?Math.max(Date.now(),Number(job.pausedUntil||0)):Infinity;
}
function collectionReadyAt_(work){
  const jobs=new Map(work.jobs.map(job=>[job.id,job])),represented=new Set(),now=Date.now(),retryMs=settings_().retryMinutes*60000,fetchPausedUntil=Number(properties_().getProperty('FETCH_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0);let next=Infinity;
  for(const task of work.tasks){
    if(!['Pendiente','Reintento programado'].includes(task.estado)||!jobs.has(task.ciclo))continue;
    represented.add(task.ciclo);const retry=task.estado==='Reintento programado'?Date.parse(task.actualizada)+retryMs:0;
    next=Math.min(next,Math.max(now,Number(jobs.get(task.ciclo).pausa||0),fetchPausedUntil,retry));
  }
  for(const job of work.jobs)if(Number(job.pendientes)>0&&!represented.has(job.id))next=Math.min(next,Math.max(now,Number(job.pausa||0),fetchPausedUntil));
  return next;
}
function backgroundTick_(){return processBackground_();}
function businessTranslationPending_(){return Boolean(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_PRIORITY_REQUEST')||translationJob_()?.businessPending>0);}
function requestDailyPipeline_(){
  if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('daily');return;}
  properties_().setProperty('DAILY_PIPELINE_REQUEST',recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone));ensureBackgroundWorker_();
}
function drainDailyPipeline_(){
  const p=properties_(),day=p.getProperty('DAILY_PIPELINE_REQUEST');if(!day)return;
  if(p.getProperty('DAILY_PIPELINE_DAY')!==day){
    queueScheduledCollection_('daily');p.setProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST',day);p.setProperty('DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST',day);p.setProperty('DAILY_PIPELINE_DAY',day);p.setProperty('CATALOG_SYNC_REQUEST',day);
    if(newsletterEnabled_())requestNewsletterDelivery_();
  }
  if(p.getProperty('DAILY_PIPELINE_REQUEST')===day)p.deleteProperty('DAILY_PIPELINE_REQUEST');
}
function dailyCollectionPending_(work){return collectionRequests_().some(request=>request.kind==='daily')||(work?.jobs||collectionJobs_()).some(job=>job.tipo==='daily'&&(Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando'));}
function businessPipelinePending_(work){
  const p=properties_();return Boolean(snapshotJobsPending_()||p.getProperty('DAILY_PIPELINE_REQUEST')||dailyCollectionPending_(work)||p.getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')||classificationPending_()||p.getProperty('DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST')||businessTranslationPending_());
}
function drainDailyTranslations_(work){
  const p=properties_(),day=p.getProperty('DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST');
  if(!day||dailyCollectionPending_(work)||p.getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')||classificationPending_())return;
  if(p.getProperty('TRANSLATION_ENABLED')!=='false')requestTranslations_(true);
  if(p.getProperty('DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST')===day)p.deleteProperty('DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST');
}
function snapshotPublicationPending_(work,includeDue=true){return snapshotJobsPending_()||(work?.jobs||collectionJobs_()).some(job=>job.estado==='Publicando')||Boolean(properties_().getProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD'))||includeDue&&dashboardSnapshotsDue_();}
function backgroundTask_(work,daily){
  if(daily)return 'collection';
  const blocked=dailyCollectionPending_(work)||properties_().getProperty('DAILY_PIPELINE_REQUEST');
  if(!blocked&&classificationReadyAt_()<=Date.now())return 'classification';
  if(!blocked&&(!classificationPending_()||snapshotJobsPending_())&&snapshotPublicationPending_(work))return 'snapshot';
  if(!blocked&&!classificationPending_()&&!properties_().getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')){
    if(newsletterReadyAt_(work)<=Date.now())return 'newsletter';
    if(translationReadyAt_()<=Date.now())return 'translation';
    if(properties_().getProperty('CATALOG_SYNC_REQUEST'))return 'catalogSync';
    if(taxonomyReadyAt_()<=Date.now())return 'taxonomy';
    if(taxonomyTranslationReadyAt_()<=Date.now())return 'taxonomyTranslation';
    if(enrichmentReadyAt_()<=Date.now())return 'enrichment';
    if(maintenanceReadyAt_()<=Date.now())return 'maintenance';
  }
  return work.pending.length?'collection':'';
}
// Wake only for runnable work; lower queues cannot poll while their prerequisites are paused.
function backgroundNextAt_(work,completed=true){
  const now=Date.now(),p=properties_();if(!work||!completed||backgroundQueued_(work))return now;
  const collection=work.tasks?collectionReadyAt_(work):Math.min(...(work.jobs||[]).filter(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando').map(job=>Math.max(now,Number(p.getProperty('FETCH_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0),Number(job.pausa||0))));
  if(dailyCollectionPending_(work)||p.getProperty('DAILY_PIPELINE_REQUEST'))return collection;
  if(classificationPending_())return snapshotJobsPending_()?now:Math.min(collection,classificationReadyAt_());
  if(dashboardSnapshotsReady_(work))return now;
  return Math.min(collection,translationReadyAt_(),taxonomyReadyAt_(),taxonomyTranslationReadyAt_(),newsletterReadyAt_(work),enrichmentReadyAt_(),maintenanceReadyAt_());
}
function processBackground_(batchLimit=BACKGROUND_WORK.maxBatches){
  if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('background');return {added:0,errors:[],paused:true};}
  scheduledTriggers_('backgroundTick_').forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT');
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();if(!lock.tryLock(1000)){ensureBackgroundWorker_();return {added:0,errors:[],busy:true};}
  const started=Date.now(),runId=Utilities.getUuid(),errors=[];let work,known,knownRevision,completed=false,added=0,acquired=true;
  try{
    for(let batch=0;batch<batchLimit&&Date.now()-started<BACKGROUND_WORK.maxMs;batch++){
      if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('background');break;}
      if(batch){lock.releaseLock();acquired=false;if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('background');break;}if(!lock.tryLock(1000))break;acquired=true;dataGenerationMemory_=undefined;if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('background');break;}if(String(properties_().getProperty('CONFIG_REVISION')||'0')!==configurationVersionMemory_){configurationMemory_=undefined;configurationVersionMemory_=undefined;}}
      drainDailyPipeline_();drainCollectionRequests_();drainMaintenanceRequest_();work=collectionWork_(Date.now());
      const daily=Boolean(work.pending.length&&work.jobs.some(job=>job.id===work.pending[0].ciclo&&job.tipo==='daily'));
      if(!work.pending.length&&batch===0)collectionBatch_(work);
      if(!daily&&!dailyCollectionPending_(work)){drainClassificationRequest_();drainDailyTranslations_(work);drainTaxonomyRequest_();}
      const collectionJob=work.pending[0]?.ciclo,task=backgroundTask_(work,daily);if(!task){if(dashboardSnapshotsReady_(work))dashboardSnapshotBatch_();break;}
      const remaining=Math.min(BACKGROUND_WORK.sliceMs,BACKGROUND_WORK.maxMs-(Date.now()-started));if(remaining<=0)break;
      progressContextMemory_=undefined;properties_().setProperty('BACKGROUND_RUN_ID',runId);const stage=task==='collection'?daily?'daily':'annual':task;properties_().setProperty('BACKGROUND_ACTIVE',stage);properties_().setProperty('BACKGROUND_ACTIVE_UNTIL',String(Date.now()+BACKGROUND_WORK.maxMs+BACKGROUND_WORK.activeGraceMs));properties_().setProperty('JOB_LAST_EXECUTED:'+stage,new Date().toISOString());
      if(task==='snapshot')dashboardSnapshotBatch_();
      else if(task==='enrichment')enrichmentBatch_(remaining);
      else if(task==='maintenance')maintenanceBatch_(Math.min(MAINTENANCE_POLICY.maxMs,remaining));
      else if(task==='newsletter')deliverNewsletterBatch_(work,remaining);
      else if(task==='catalogSync'){const synced=refreshFunctionalCatalog_();if(synced.changed){if(!taxonomyPending_())requestTaxonomy_('catalog-change');requestEnrichment_();}properties_().deleteProperty('CATALOG_SYNC_REQUEST');}
      else if(task==='taxonomyTranslation')taxonomyTranslationBatch_(Math.min(TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxMs,remaining));
      else if(task==='taxonomy')taxonomyBatch_(Math.min(TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxMs,remaining));
      else if(task==='classification')newsClassificationBatch_(Math.min(CLASSIFICATION_WORK.maxMs,remaining));
      else if(task==='translation'){translationBatch_(Math.min(TRANSLATION_WORK.maxMs,remaining));known=undefined;}
      else{
        const revision=properties_().getProperty('NEWS_REVISION');if(!known||knownRevision!==revision)known=knownUrls_();const result=collectionBatch_({...work,known}),day=recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone);added+=result.added;errors.push(...result.errors);
        if(daily&&work.jobs.some(job=>job.id===work.pending[0].ciclo&&job.estado==='Completada')&&properties_().getProperty('MAINTENANCE_DAY')!==day){maintenance_();properties_().setProperty('MAINTENANCE_DAY',day);}
      }
      if(task!=='snapshot'&&backgroundStageComplete_(task,work,collectionJob))requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);
      knownRevision=properties_().getProperty('NEWS_REVISION');properties_().setProperty('BACKGROUND_LAST',task);
    }
    completed=true;return {...collectionStatus_(null,work?.jobs),added,errors};
  }finally{
    try{
      const next=backgroundNextAt_(work,completed);
      if(Number.isFinite(next))ensureBackgroundWorker_(next-Date.now());else properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_PENDING');
    }finally{if(acquired){if(properties_().getProperty('BACKGROUND_RUN_ID')===runId){properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_RUN_ID');properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_ACTIVE');properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_ACTIVE_UNTIL');}lock.releaseLock();}}
  }
}
function initializeBackgroundSchedules_(){
  const p=properties_();
  CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('daily-schedule');
  for(const handler of ['collectionTick_','collectionWake_','translationTick_','backgroundTick_','nightlyTranslations_','dailyClassification_','dailyTaxonomy_','newsletterTick_','deliverNewsletters_'])scheduledTriggers_(handler).forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));
  p.deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT');
  if(!scheduledTriggers_('backgroundWatchdog_').length)ScriptApp.newTrigger('backgroundWatchdog_').timeBased().everyMinutes(BACKGROUND_WORK.watchdogMinutes).create();
  if(p.getProperty('DAILY_ENABLED')==='true')replaceCollectionSchedule_();else scheduledTriggers_('dailyRadar_').forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));
  if(p.getProperty('TRANSLATION_ENABLED')!=='false')p.setProperty('TRANSLATION_ENABLED','true');
  if(settings_().newsletterEnabled)replaceDailySchedule_('scheduledNewsletters_',settings_().dailyHour);else scheduledTriggers_('scheduledNewsletters_').forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));
  if(dashboardSnapshotsPending_()||Number.isFinite(taxonomyTranslationReadyAt_())||taxonomyPending_()||p.getProperty('TAXONOMY_REQUEST')||p.getProperty('CATALOG_SYNC_REQUEST')||classificationPending_()||p.getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')||collectionRequests_().length||collectionJobs_().some(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0)||Number.isFinite(translationReadyAt_())||Number.isFinite(newsletterReadyAt_())||Number.isFinite(enrichmentReadyAt_()))ensureBackgroundWorker_();
}
function updateOperationalSchedule(){authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{initializeBackgroundSchedules_();return 'Prioridades y programación actualizadas.';});}

function backgroundWatchdog_(){
  const p=properties_(),values=p.getProperties();if(backgroundPaused_())return;
  if(Object.entries(values).some(([key,value])=>key.startsWith('WORK_PENDING:')&&value==='true')){workWake_();return;}
  if(!dashboardSnapshotsPending_()&&!values.BACKGROUND_PENDING&&!['MAINTENANCE_REQUEST','DAILY_PIPELINE_REQUEST','CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST','DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST','TRANSLATION_REQUEST','TAXONOMY_REQUEST','CATALOG_SYNC_REQUEST','TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST','ENRICHMENT_REQUEST'].some(key=>values[key])&&!(values.NEWSLETTER_REQUEST&&settings_().newsletterEnabled)&&!Number.isFinite(enrichmentReadyAt_())&&!Number.isFinite(maintenanceReadyAt_()))return;
  if(scheduledTriggers_('backgroundTick_').length&&Number(p.getProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT'))>Date.now()-BACKGROUND_WORK.maxMs*2)return;
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();if(!lock.tryLock(1000))return;
  try{
    const now=Date.now(),jobs=collectionJobs_(),next=backgroundNextAt_({jobs});
    if(Number.isFinite(next)){p.deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT');ensureBackgroundWorker_(next-now);}else p.deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_PENDING');
  }finally{lock.releaseLock();}
}

function backgroundQueued_(work){
  const p=properties_();return Boolean(p.getProperty('MAINTENANCE_REQUEST')||p.getProperty('DAILY_PIPELINE_REQUEST')||collectionRequests_().length||!dailyCollectionPending_(work)&&!classificationPending_()&&(p.getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')||p.getProperty('DAILY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST')||p.getProperty('CATALOG_SYNC_REQUEST'))||!businessPipelinePending_(work)&&(p.getProperty('TAXONOMY_REQUEST')&&!taxonomyPending_()));
}

function backgroundStageComplete_(task,work,collectionJob){
  if(task==='collection'&&collectionJob)return work.jobs.some(job=>job.id===collectionJob&&Number(job.pendientes)===0&&job.estado!=='Preparando');
  if(task==='collection')return !work.jobs.some(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando');
  const job={classification:classificationJob_,translation:translationJob_,taxonomy:taxonomyJob_,taxonomyTranslation:taxonomyTranslationJob_,maintenance:maintenanceJob_}[task];
  return task==='newsletter'||Boolean(job&&job()?.state==='Completada');
}

function newsletterSubject_(filters,language='es',t=taxonomyLanguage_(language)){
  const labels={entity:'Entidad',country:'Geografía',source:'Fuente',type:'Tipo de entidad',segment:'Segmento',coverage:'Cobertura',signal:'Novedad',search:'Buscar',palanca:"Bloque funcional",subpalanca:"Funcionalidad / Sub Operativa",from:'Desde',to:'Hasta'};
  const values=Object.entries(labels).filter(([key])=>filters[key]).map(([key,label])=>t(label)+': '+(key==='search'||key==='from'||key==='to'?String(filters[key]).replace(/[\r\n]+/g,' '):t(key==='coverage'?coverageOptions[filters[key]]:key==='subpalanca'?taxonomySubLabel(filters[key]):filters[key])));
  return '[bIA] '+(values.join(' · ')||t('Todo el sector'));
}
function briefing_(rows,perGeography=false,geography=row=>geographyLabel(row.pais),entityName=entityKey_){
  const entities=new Map(),ranked=rows.filter(briefingAllowed).map(row=>{
    const entity=entityName(row.entidad);entities.set(entity,(entities.get(entity)||0)+1);
    return {row,entity,score:newsRelevance_(row)};
  });
  ranked.sort((a,b)=>Number(b.entity==='BBVA')-Number(a.entity==='BBVA')||entities.get(b.entity)-entities.get(a.entity)||a.entity.localeCompare(b.entity,'es')||b.score-a.score||b.row.fecha.localeCompare(a.row.fecha));
  const overview=noveltyOverview(ranked.map(item=>item.row),BRIEFING_ALLOWED_SIGNALS,geography),items=[],limit=settings_().briefingLimit;
  const groups=new Map();
  for(const {row} of ranked){const key=perGeography?geography(row):'';if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,[]);groups.get(key).push(row);}
  for(const group of groups.values())items.push(...group.slice(0,limit));
  return {...overview,items,limited:overview.total>items.length};
}
function newsletter_(rows,query,title,now,subscriptionId,language='es',editionId='',known=new Set()){
  return newsletterContent_(selectNews_(rows,newsletterSelectionQuery_(query)),query,title,now,subscriptionId,language,editionId,known);
}
function newsletterContent_(selected,query,title,now,subscriptionId,language='es',editionId='',known=new Set()){
  if(!supportedLanguage(language))throw Error('Idioma no admitido.');
  const evidence=selected.filter(row=>plainText_(row.titular).trim()&&briefingAllowed(row)),t=taxonomyLanguage_(language),editorial=newsletterDigest_(evidence,query,language,t,known),examples=new Map(editorial.cards.map(card=>[card.id,null])),links=newsletterLinks_(subscriptionId,editionId,query.view,query),images=new Map([['bia-logo',{id:'bia-logo',data:NEWSLETTER_BIA_PNG}]]);
  for(const row of evidence)if(examples.has(row.id))examples.set(row.id,row);
  const items=[...examples.values()],localized=savedArticleTranslations_(items,language);for(let i=0;i<editorial.cards.length;i++){editorial.cards[i].title=newsletterWords_(localized[i].titular,NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.titleWords);editorial.cards[i].fact=newsletterWords_(localized[i].extracto,NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.factWords);}
  const escape=value=>String(value??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,char=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[char]));
  const label=value=>escape(t(value)),message=(value,params)=>escape(formatText(value,params,language)),fortnightly=editorial.cadence==='fortnightly',period=query.from&&query.to?formatCalendarDay(query.from,language)+' — '+formatCalendarDay(query.to,language):formatCalendarDay(recordDay(now,settings_().timezone),language),selection=newsletterSubject_({...query,from:'',to:''},language,t).slice(6);
  for(const card of editorial.cards){
    const international=editorial.focused&&card.scope==='global',country=international?(card.countries.length===1?card.countries[0]:''):editorial.focused?(card.scope==='local'?query.country:''):(query.country||''),geography=international?(card.countries.length===1?applicationGeography(editorial.scope,query.segment)({pais:country}):''):'';
    card.topicLabel=t('Bloque funcional');
    card.related=editionId&&card.relatedCount>1&&links.app?newsletterExploreLink_(links.app,'news',country,'',card.category,'',international?'international':'',geography):'';
  }
  const relatedLabel=card=>card.additionalCount?formatText(fortnightly?(card.additionalCount===1?"1 noticia más en este ámbito":"{count} noticias más en este ámbito"):(card.additionalCount===1?"1 noticia más en este bloque funcional":"{count} noticias más en este bloque funcional"),{count:card.additionalCount},language):'';
  const cardHtml=card=>{
    const country=label(geographyLabel(card.country));
    const title='<h3>'+(card.url?'<a href="'+escape(card.url)+'">'+escape(card.title)+'</a>':escape(card.title))+'</h3>';
    const identity='<table role="presentation" class="newsletter-article-heading"><tr><td><p class="newsletter-bank">'+escape(card.entity)+' · '+country+'</p></td><td class="newsletter-identity-cell">'+storyIdentity(card.entity,card.country,escape,images)+'</td></tr></table>';
    const detail=fortnightly?label(card.category):card.subcategories.filter(Boolean).map(label).join(' · ');
    const example=identity+title+(detail?'<p class="newsletter-subcategory">'+label(fortnightly?"Bloque funcional":"Funcionalidad / Sub Operativa")+': '+detail+'</p>':'')+(card.fact?'<p class="newsletter-excerpt">'+escape(card.fact)+'</p>':'')+'<p class="newsletter-insight">'+escape(card.relevance)+'</p><p class="newsletter-meta">'+escape(formatCalendarDay(card.date,language))+' · '+identityMark('publishers',card.publisher,escape,images)+escape(card.publisher)+'</p>';

    const theme='<p class="newsletter-lever-label">'+escape(card.topicLabel)+'</p><h2 class="newsletter-lever">'+label(card.category||'Noticias del sector')+'</h2><p class="newsletter-volume">'+message('Noticias: {count} · Entidades: {entities}',{count:card.relatedCount,entities:card.entityCount})+(!editorial.focused&&card.countryCount?' · '+message('Geografías: {count}',{count:card.countryCount}):'')+'</p>';
    const body='<div class="newsletter-example"><p class="newsletter-example-label">'+label(fortnightly?"Noticia seleccionada":"Un ejemplo de este bloque funcional")+'</p>'+example+'</div>';
    const more=card.related?'<a class="newsletter-related" href="'+escape(card.related)+'">'+escape(relatedLabel(card))+' ↗</a>':escape(relatedLabel(card));
    return '<article class="newsletter-article">'+theme+body+'<p class="newsletter-links">'+more+'</p></article>';
  };
  let previousScope='';
  const sections=fortnightly?editorial.cards.map(card=>{
    const heading=card.scope!==previousScope?'<div class="newsletter-scope"><p class="newsletter-eyebrow">'+label(fortnightly?(card.scope==='local'?'TU GEOGRAFÍA':'MIRADA INTERNACIONAL'):editorial.focused?(card.scope==='local'?'TU GEOGRAFÍA':'MIRADA INTERNACIONAL'):'MIRADA GLOBAL')+'</p><h2>'+label(editorial.focused?(card.scope==='local'?query.country:'Tendencias globales'):'Tendencias globales')+'</h2><p>'+(fortnightly&&card.scope==='local'?message('Trending topics en {country}.',{country:t(query.country)}):label(fortnightly?'Señales del conjunto del sector para ampliar la perspectiva.':editorial.focused?(card.scope==='local'?'Actividad en la geografía seleccionada.':'Señales del conjunto del sector para ampliar la perspectiva.'):'Ejemplos de los bloques funcionales con más actividad registrada durante el trimestre.'))+'</p></div>':'';previousScope=card.scope;return heading+cardHtml(card);
  }).join(''):'';
  const scopeText=formatText(editorial.focused?'Noticias en {country}: {local} · Mirada global: {global}':"Noticias en la selección: {count} · Bloques funcionales destacados: {themes}",{local:editorial.localCount,country:t(query.country),global:editorial.globalCount,count:evidence.length,themes:editorial.cards.length},language);
  const emptyLocalText=editorial.focused&&!editorial.localCount?formatText('Sin noticias en {country} con estos filtros. La mirada internacional recoge la actividad disponible.',{country:t(query.country)},language):'';
  const scopeSummary=scopeText?'<p class="newsletter-summary">'+escape(scopeText)+'</p>':'',noLocal=emptyLocalText?'<p class="newsletter-empty-local">'+escape(emptyLocalText)+'</p>':'';
  const editionLink=newsletterExploreLink_(links.app,'news','','','','','',query.country?applicationGeography(editorial.scope,query.segment)({pais:query.country}):'');
  const report=newsletterExecutiveReport_(editorial,query,language,t,escape,{...links,edition:editionId},images,cardHtml);
  const footer='<footer><p>'+label('Has recibido esta selección por tu suscripción a News Radar.')+'</p>'+(links.manage?'<p><a href="'+escape(links.manage)+'">'+label('Gestiona tu suscripción')+'</a> · <a href="'+escape(links.unsubscribe)+'">'+label('Dar de baja')+'</a></p>':'')+(editionId&&links.app?'<p>'+label('Valorar esta edición (opcional)')+' <a href="'+escape(newsletterExploreLink_(links.app,'news','')+'&feedback=positive')+'">👍 '+label('Útil')+'</a> · <a href="'+escape(newsletterExploreLink_(links.app,'news','')+'&feedback=negative')+'">👎 '+label('Mejorable')+'</a></p>':'')+'<table role="presentation" class="newsletter-brand"><tr><td><img src="cid:bia-logo" width="80" alt="bIA"></td><td>'+label('Impulsado por')+'<br><strong>'+label('Banca Inteligente y Autónoma')+'</strong></td></tr></table></footer>';
  const html='<!doctype html><html lang="'+language+'"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><meta name="color-scheme" content="light only"><title>'+escape(title)+'</title><style>'+NEWSLETTER_STYLE+'</style></head><body><header><p class="newsletter-eyebrow">BBVA '+label('Banca de Empresas e Instituciones')+' · News Radar</p><h1>'+escape(editorial.heading)+'</h1><p class="newsletter-period">'+escape(period)+'</p></header><p class="newsletter-selection">'+escape(selection)+'</p><p class="newsletter-intro">'+escape(editorial.intro)+'</p>'+scopeSummary+noLocal+report.html+sections+(editorial.cards.length?'':'<p>'+label('No hay novedades detectadas en esta selección.')+'</p>')+(editionId&&evidence.length&&links.app?'<p class="newsletter-more"><a class="newsletter-cta" href="'+escape(editionLink)+'">'+label('Ver esta edición')+' ↗</a></p>':'')+footer+'</body></html>';
  const text=[title,editorial.heading,period,selection,editorial.intro,scopeText,emptyLocalText,report.text,...editorial.cards.flatMap(card=>[t(fortnightly?(card.scope==='local'?query.country:'Tendencias globales'):editorial.focused?(card.scope==='local'?query.country:'Tendencias globales'):'MIRADA GLOBAL'),card.topicLabel+': '+t(card.category||'Noticias del sector'),formatText('Noticias: {count} · Entidades: {entities}',{count:card.relatedCount,entities:card.entityCount},language),t(fortnightly?"Noticia seleccionada":"Un ejemplo de este bloque funcional"),card.entity+' · '+t(geographyLabel(card.country)),...(fortnightly?[t("Bloque funcional")+': '+t(card.category)]:card.subcategories.filter(Boolean).map(value=>t("Funcionalidad / Sub Operativa")+': '+t(value))),card.title,card.fact,card.relevance,card.publisher,card.url,card.related?relatedLabel(card)+': '+card.related:relatedLabel(card)]),editionId&&evidence.length?editionLink:'',links.manage?t('Gestiona tu suscripción')+': '+links.manage:'',links.unsubscribe?t('Dar de baja')+': '+links.unsubscribe:''].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');
  return {subject:newsletterSubject_(query,language,t),html:newsletterInline_(html,escape),text,images:[...images.values()],editionId,count:items.length,total:evidence.length,items,evidence,editorial,translationReady:localized.every(row=>row.translation.state!=='pending')};
}
function newsletterInline_(html,escape){
  return html.replace(/<([a-z][\w-]*)(\s[^>]*|)>/g,(tag,name,attributes)=>{
    const classes=attributes.match(/class="([^"]*)"/)?.[1].split(/\s+/)||[],style=(NEWSLETTER_INLINE[name]||'')+classes.map(value=>NEWSLETTER_INLINE['.'+value]||'').join('');
    const existing=attributes.match(/style="([^"]*)"/)?.[1]||'';
    return style?'<'+name+' style="'+escape(style+existing)+'"'+attributes.replace(/\sstyle="[^"]*"/,'')+'>':tag;
  });
}
function newsletterLinks_(subscriptionId,editionId,view='briefing',period={}){
  const configured=settings_().newsletterAppUrl,url=configured||(typeof ScriptApp!=='undefined'&&ScriptApp.getService?ScriptApp.getService().getUrl():'');
  const app=canonicalUrl_(url);if(!app)return {app:'',manage:'',unsubscribe:''};
  const base=app.split('?')[0],manage=base+'?view=subscriptions';
  return {app:editionId?base+'?edition='+encodeURIComponent(editionId)+'&view='+encodeURIComponent(view)+(period.from?'&from='+encodeURIComponent(period.from):'')+(period.to?'&to='+encodeURIComponent(period.to):''):base+'?view='+encodeURIComponent(view),manage,unsubscribe:subscriptionId?manage+'&unsubscribe='+encodeURIComponent(subscriptionId):manage};
}

function newsletterExploreLink_(app,view,country,entity='',palanca='',subpalanca='',benchmark='',newsGeography=''){if(!app)return '';return app.replace(/([?&])view=[^&]*&?/,'$1').replace(/[?&]$/,'')+(app.includes('?edition=')?'&':'?')+'view='+encodeURIComponent(view)+'&country='+encodeURIComponent(country)+'&entity='+encodeURIComponent(entity)+(benchmark?'&benchmark='+encodeURIComponent(benchmark):'')+(newsGeography?'&newsGeography='+encodeURIComponent(newsGeography):'')+(palanca?'&palanca='+encodeURIComponent(palanca):'')+(subpalanca?'&subpalanca='+encodeURIComponent(subpalanca):'');}

function calendarDate_(now){return new Date(recordDay(now,settings_().timezone)+'T00:00:00Z');}
function dashboardPeriod_(view,now=new Date(),closed=false){if(view==='radar'){const year=Number(recordDay(now,settings_().timezone).slice(0,4))-(closed?1:0);return {from:year+'-01-01',to:year+'-12-31'};}const {from,to}=readingWindow(view,recordDay(now,settings_().timezone),closed);return {from,to};}
function dashboardQuery_(query={},now=new Date(),currentScope=true){
  const view=query.view||'news',initial=query.initial,filters=Object.fromEntries([...subscriptionFilterKeys,'from','to','page','newsGeography','benchmark'].filter(key=>Object.hasOwn(query,key)).map(key=>[key,query[key]]));
  if(currentScope&&filters.coverage&&!Object.hasOwn(coverageOptions,filters.coverage))throw Error('Filtro de cobertura no válido.');
  if(!readingViews.includes(view))return filters;
  if(currentScope&&view==='briefing')return {...sectorNewsDefaults,...dashboardPeriod_(view,now)};
  if(currentScope&&view==='radar'){const year=String(query.year||query.from?.slice(0,4)||dashboardPeriod_(view,now).from.slice(0,4));if(!/^\d{4}$/.test(year)||Number(year)<2000||Number(year)>Number(recordDay(now,settings_().timezone).slice(0,4)))throw Error('Año no válido.');return {...sectorNewsDefaults,...Object.fromEntries(['entity','palanca','subpalanca'].filter(key=>filters[key]).map(key=>[key,filters[key]])),country:filters.country||'',from:year+'-01-01',to:year+'-12-31'};}
  const defaults={...(view==='radar'?{entity:''}:{}),...sectorNewsDefaults};
  return {...(initial?{...defaults,...(filters.newsGeography?{newsGeography:filters.newsGeography}:{})}:currentScope?{...filters,...sectorNewsDefaults}:filters),...(initial||!filters.from&&!filters.to?dashboardPeriod_(view,now):{})};
}

function candidateRecord_(item,feed,now,reason){
  const row={id:sha256_(newsUrlIdentity_(item.url)).slice(0,32),fecha:recordDay(item.date,settings_().timezone),pais:item.country,entidad:item.entity,titular:item.title.slice(0,1000),extracto:item.excerpt.slice(0,CANDIDATE_POLICY.excerptChars),url:item.url,fuente:feed.name,idioma:item.language,capturada:now.toISOString(),estado:item.labels.estado,motivo:reason,procedencia:JSON.stringify({fuente:feed.url,tipo:feed.kind||'rss',dominio:feed.domain,capacidad:Boolean(feed.capabilitySearch),medio:item.publisher||(feed.kind==='rss'?feed.name:''),extracto:item.provenance,...(item.sourceUrl?{medioUrl:item.sourceUrl}:{}),consulta:feed.range||null}),clasificacion:JSON.stringify(item.labels)};
  return RADAR.sheets.Candidatos.map(key=>row[key]||'');
}
function candidateSheet_(){
  let sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Candidatos');if(!sheet){sheet=book_().insertSheet('Candidatos');sheet.getRange(1,1,1,RADAR.sheets.Candidatos.length).setValues([RADAR.sheets.Candidatos]);}return sheet;
}
// A bounded identity column is read once per collection batch, never per article.
function persistCandidates_(records,now=new Date()){
  const p=properties_(),day=recordDay(now,settings_().timezone);
  if(!records.length&&(!book_().getSheetByName('Candidatos')||p.getProperty('CANDIDATE_RETENTION_DAY')===day))return;
  const sheet=candidateSheet_(),count=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),cutoff=new Date(now.getTime()-CANDIDATE_POLICY.retentionDays*86400000).toISOString();
  let expired=0;
  if(count&&p.getProperty('CANDIDATE_RETENTION_DAY')!==day)for(const [captured] of sheet.getRange(2,10,count,1).getDisplayValues()){if(captured>=cutoff)break;expired++;}
  if(expired)sheet.deleteRows(2,expired);
  const size=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),known=new Set(size?sheet.getRange(2,1,size,1).getDisplayValues().flat():[]),added=[];
  for(const record of records)if(!known.has(record[0])){known.add(record[0]);added.push(record);}
  // Keep the newest bounded recoverable corpus; expired/displaced records are counted explicitly.
  const overflow=Math.max(0,size+added.length-CANDIDATE_POLICY.maxRows),removed=Math.min(size,overflow),discarded=Math.max(0,overflow-size);
  if(removed)sheet.deleteRows(2,removed);
  append_('Candidatos',added.slice(discarded));
  p.setProperty('CANDIDATE_RETENTION_DAY',day);
  if(added.length||expired||removed)properties_().setProperty('CANDIDATES_REVISION',Utilities.getUuid());
  telemetry_('candidatos',0,'OK',JSON.stringify({recibidos:records.length,nuevos:added.length-discarded,duplicados:records.length-added.length,expirados:expired,limite:removed+discarded}));
}
function appendCoverage_(records){
  if(!records.length)return;
  let sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Cobertura');if(!sheet){sheet=book_().insertSheet('Cobertura');sheet.getRange(1,1,1,RADAR.sheets.Cobertura.length).setValues([RADAR.sheets.Cobertura]);}
  const overflow=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1+records.length-20000);if(overflow)sheet.deleteRows(2,Math.min(overflow,sheet.getLastRow()-1));append_('Cobertura',records);
}

function reclassifyCandidates_(first,limit,maxMs){
 const sheet=candidateSheet_(),keys=RADAR.sheets.Candidatos,total=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),count=Math.min(limit,Math.max(0,total-first+2)),started=Date.now(),updates=[];let read=0;
 if(maxMs<=0)return {next:first,total,changed:0,done:first>total+1};
 const rows=count?sheet.getRange(first,1,count,keys.length).getDisplayValues():[];
 for(const values of rows){
  if(Date.now()-started>=maxMs||backgroundPaused_(true))break;
  const row=Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,i)=>[key,values[i]])),provenance=JSON.parse(row.procedencia||'{}'),saved=savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion),title=searchText_(row.titular),text=searchText_(row.titular+' '+row.extracto),hash=sha256_(JSON.stringify([title,text])),country=newsCountry_({...row,medio:provenance.medio,sourceUrl:provenance.medioUrl}),entity=entityKey_(row.entidad);
  const current=saved.schema===1&&saved.version===CLASSIFICATION_WORK.rulesVersion&&saved.revision===newsClassificationRevision_()&&saved.contentHash===hash;
  if(!current||country!==row.pais||entity!==row.entidad){const labels=current?saved:classification_(title,text).labels,changed={...row,pais:country,entidad:entity,clasificacion:JSON.stringify(labels),estado:labels.estado};updates.push({row:first+read,values:keys.map(key=>String(changed[key]||''))});}
  read++;
 }
 writeVerifiedRows_(sheet,updates);if(updates.length)properties_().setProperty('CANDIDATES_REVISION',Utilities.getUuid());
 return {next:first+read,total,changed:updates.length,done:first+read>total+1};
}

function businessNews_(row){
  const labels=row.etiquetas||savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion);
  return labels.digital&&labels.capacidades.some(name=>name.startsWith('Empresas: '));
}
function newsLabels_(assessment){
  const state=assessment.relevant?'relevante':assessment.excluded||assessment.editorial?'no relevante':'indeterminado';
  return {digital:assessment.relevant,capacidades:[...new Set(assessment.capabilities.map(row=>row.segment+': '+row.name))],schema:1,version:CLASSIFICATION_WORK.rulesVersion,revision:newsClassificationRevision_(),estado:state,segmento:assessment.business?sectorNewsDefaults.segment:'indeterminado',segmentos:assessment.relevant||assessment.business?[sectorNewsDefaults.segment]:[],canal:assessment.channel?'digital':'indeterminado',evento:assessment.signals.includes(INCIDENT_SIGNAL)?INCIDENT_SIGNAL:assessment.signals[0]||'indeterminado',senales:assessment.excluded?[]:assessment.signals,score:assessment.score,evidencia:assessment.evidence};
}
function savedNewsLabels_(value){
  if(!value)return {digital:false,capacidades:[]};
  try{const labels=JSON.parse(value);return {...labels,digital:labels.digital===true,capacidades:Array.isArray(labels.capacidades)?labels.capacidades:[]};}
  catch(_){return {digital:false,capacidades:[]};}
}
let classificationRevisionMemory_;
function newsClassificationRevision_(){const config=configuration_();if(classificationRevisionMemory_?.config===config)return classificationRevisionMemory_.revision;const revision=classificationRulesRevision_(config);classificationRevisionMemory_={config,revision};return revision;}
function classificationRulesRevision_(config=configuration_()){return sha256_(JSON.stringify([CLASSIFICATION_WORK.rulesVersion,config.capabilities,config.taxonomy.flatMap(block=>block.functions),config.relevanceRules,config.signals,config.entities,config.segments,config.geographies,config.feeds.map(({name,country,url})=>({name,country,url}))]));}
function classificationJob_(){const raw=properties_().getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_JOB');return raw?JSON.parse(raw):null;}
function classificationPending_(){const job=classificationJob_();return Boolean(job&&job.state!=='Completada');}
function classificationReadyAt_(){const job=classificationJob_();return job&&!['Completada','Publicando'].includes(job.state)?Math.max(Date.now(),Number(job.pausedUntil||0)):Infinity;}
function writeClassificationJob_(job){progressContextMemory_=undefined;properties_().setProperty('CLASSIFICATION_JOB',JSON.stringify(snapshotJob_('CLASSIFICATION_JOB',job)));}
function requestNewsClassification_(force=false){
  const job=classificationJob_(),revision=newsClassificationRevision_(),source=newsStorageKey_(),total=Math.max(0,newsSheet_().getLastRow()-1),recordsRevision=properties_().getProperty('NEWS_RECORDS_REVISION')||'0';
  if(!force&&job&&job.revision===revision&&(job.state!=='Completada'||job.source===source&&job.total===total&&job.recordsRevision===recordsRevision))return;
  const now=new Date();
  writeClassificationJob_({source,recordsRevision,next:2,total,revision,version:CLASSIFICATION_WORK.rulesVersion,force,state:total?'Pendiente':'Completada',started:now.toISOString(),updated:now.toISOString(),day:recordDay(now,settings_().timezone),classified:0,digital:0});
  if(total)ensureBackgroundWorker_();
}
function drainClassificationRequest_(){
  const p=properties_();if(!p.getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')||classificationPending_())return;
  requestNewsClassification_();p.deleteProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST');
}
function getClassificationStatus(){
  authorize_(true);const job=classificationJob_(),queued=Boolean(properties_().getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST'));
  return {newsRevision:publishedNewsRevision_(),queued,scheduled:dailyScheduleStatus_(),timezone:settings_().timezone,job:withJobProgress_('classification',job?{...job,processed:Math.min(job.total,job.next-2)}:null,queued)};
}
function startClassification(){
  authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
    if(!classificationPending_())requestNewsClassification_(true);
    else{const job=classificationJob_();if(job.state==='En pausa'){job.state='Pendiente';job.pausedUntil=0;writeClassificationJob_(job);}ensureBackgroundWorker_();}
    return getClassificationStatus();
  });
}
function newsClassificationBatch_(maxMs=CLASSIFICATION_WORK.maxMs){
 const job=classificationJob_();if(!job||['Completada','Publicando'].includes(job.state))return;
 const started=Date.now();let read=0,classified=0,digital=0;
 try{
  const revision=newsClassificationRevision_();if(job.revision!==revision){requestNewsClassification_(true);return;}
  const sheet=newsSheet_(),keys=RADAR.sheets.Noticias,total=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),size=Math.min(CLASSIFICATION_WORK.batchRows,total-job.next+2),updates=[],items=taxonomyCatalog_();
  const rows=size>0?sheet.getRange(job.next,1,size,keys.length).getDisplayValues():[];
  for(const values of rows){
   if(Date.now()-started>=maxMs||backgroundPaused_(true))break;
   const row=Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,i)=>[key,values[i]])),position=job.next+read,cleanTitle=plainText_(row.titular),cleanExcerpt=plainText_(row.extracto),title=searchText_(cleanTitle),text=searchText_(cleanTitle+' '+cleanExcerpt),hash=sha256_(JSON.stringify([title,text])),saved=savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion),taxonomy=taxonomySaved_(row.taxonomia);
   read++;
   let taxonomyValid=true;try{validateTaxonomyAssignment_(taxonomy,items,row.id,true,row);}catch(_){taxonomyValid=false;}
   const current=saved.schema===1&&saved.version===CLASSIFICATION_WORK.rulesVersion&&saved.revision===revision&&saved.contentHash===hash;
   const nextCountry=newsCountry_(row),nextEntity=entityKey_(row.entidad);
   if(!job.force&&current&&taxonomyValid&&nextEntity===row.entidad&&nextCountry===row.pais&&cleanTitle===row.titular&&cleanExcerpt===row.extracto)continue;
   const labels=current&&!job.force?saved:{...classification_(title,text).labels,...(saved.procedencia?{procedencia:saved.procedencia}:{})};
   const changed={titular:cleanTitle,extracto:cleanExcerpt,clasificacion:JSON.stringify(labels),pais:nextCountry,entidad:nextEntity,taxonomia:JSON.stringify(necessaryTaxonomyRecord_(row,items))};
   for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(changed))if(value!==row[key])updates.push({row:position,column:keys.indexOf(key)+1,value});
   if(changed.clasificacion!==row.clasificacion)classified++;if(labels.digital)digital++;
  }
  writeNewsCells_(updates);if(updates.length)invalidateNews_(false);
  job.total=total;job.next+=read;Object.assign(job,{state:job.next>total+1?'Completada':'En curso',updated:new Date().toISOString(),classified:job.classified+classified,digital:job.digital+digital,error:'',pausedUntil:0});if(job.state==='Completada')job.recordsRevision=properties_().getProperty('NEWS_RECORDS_REVISION')||'0';writeClassificationJob_(job);if(job.state==='Completada')requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);
  telemetry_('clasificacion',Date.now()-started,'OK',read+' leídas; '+classified+' clasificadas; '+updates.length+' celdas modificadas');
 }catch(error){Object.assign(job,{state:'En pausa',error:String(error.message).slice(0,180),pausedUntil:Date.now()+(serviceQuotaPause_(error)||settings_().retryMinutes*60000)});writeClassificationJob_(job);telemetry_('clasificacion',Date.now()-started,'Error',job.error);}
}

function necessaryTaxonomyRecord_(row,items=taxonomyCatalog_()){
 const saved=taxonomySaved_(row.taxonomia);
 try{validateTaxonomyAssignment_(saved,items,row.id,true,row);return JSON.parse(row.taxonomia);}catch(_){return taxonomyRecord_(row.titular,row.extracto,items);}
}

  function llmUtf8(text) {
    return Array.from(unescape(encodeURIComponent(text)), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
  }
  function llmCrc(bytes, previous = 0) {
    let crc = previous ^ -1;
    for (let byte of bytes) {
      crc ^= byte;
      for (let n = 0; n < 8; n++) crc = crc >>> 1 ^ (crc & 1 ? 3988292384 : 0);
    }
    return (crc ^ -1) >>> 0;
  }

        if (offset + 30 + name.length + length > 4294967295) throw Error("Cat\xE1logo o noticia demasiado grande para exportar.");
        push(header, 67324752, 4);
        for (let [v, n] of [[20, 2], [2048, 2], [0, 2], [0, 2], [33, 2], [crc, 4], [length, 4], [length, 4], [name.length, 2], [0, 2]]) push(header, v, n);
        header.push(...name), local.push(Uint8Array.from(header), ...parts);
        let directory = [];
        push(directory, 33639248, 4);
        for (let [v, n] of [[20, 2], [20, 2], [2048, 2], [0, 2], [0, 2], [33, 2], [crc, 4], [length, 4], [length, 4], [name.length, 2], [0, 2], [0, 2], [0, 2], [0, 2], [0, 4], [offset, 4]]) push(directory, v, n);
        directory.push(...name), central.push(Uint8Array.from(directory)), offset += header.length + length;
      },
      finish() {
        let end = [];
        for (let [v, n] of [[101010256, 4], [0, 2], [0, 2], [names.size, 2], [names.size, 2], [central.reduce((sum, part) => sum + part.length, 0), 4], [offset, 4], [0, 2]]) push(end, v, n);
        return [...local, ...central, Uint8Array.from(end)];
      }
    };
  }
  function llmBundleWriter(encode) {
    let packages = [], manifest, instructions, review;
    return {
      add(result) {
        if (manifest || (manifest = JSON.parse(result.files.find((file) => file.name === "manifest.json").text), instructions = result.files.find((file) => file.name === "instructions.md"), review = result.review), !result.count) return;
        let zip = llmZipWriter(encode);
        for (let file of result.files) zip.add(file);
        packages.push({ count: result.count, parts: zip.finish() });
      },
      finish() {
        let zip = llmZipWriter(encode), entries = packages.map((item, index) => ({ name: index + 1 + "_" + packages.length + ".zip", articles: item.count }));
        return zip.add({ name: "manifest.json", text: JSON.stringify({ ...manifest, packages: entries }) }), zip.add(instructions), zip.add(review), packages.forEach((item, index) => zip.add({ name: entries[index].name, parts: item.parts })), zip.finish();
      }
    };
  }

  function call(method, ...args) {
    if (initialDashboard && secondaryMethods.has(method)) return initialDashboard.then(() => call(method, ...args));
    let key = method.startsWith("get") ? JSON.stringify([method, ...args]) : null;
    if (key && requests.has(key)) return requests.get(key);
    let finishLoading = beginLoading(method, args), response, started = performance.now();
    try {
      response = send(method, ...args), method === "getDashboard" && (response = response.then((data) => ({ ...data, performance: { ...data.performance, transportMs: Math.round(performance.now() - started) } })));
    } catch (error) {
      throw finishLoading(), error;
    }
    key && requests.set(key, response);
    let complete = () => {
      key && requests.delete(key), finishLoading();
    };
    return response.then(complete, complete), response;
  }
  function send(method, ...args) {
    if (window.RADAR_PREVIEW) {
      let response = window.RADAR_PREVIEW.call(method, ...args);
      return response.then(receive, () => {
      }), response;
    }
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => google.script.run.withSuccessHandler((data) => resolve(receive(data))).withFailureHandler((error) => reject(Error(t(error.message || String(error)))))[method](...args));
  }

  function progressState({ state: state2 = "Pendiente", queued = !1, running = !1, lastExecutedAt = "", pausedUntil = 0, quotaUntil = 0, nextAt = 0, waitingFor = "", error = "" }, now = Date.now()) {

  }

  // src/client/core/browser-country.js
  var zoneCountries = Object.freeze({ "Europe/Madrid": "ES", "Atlantic/Canary": "ES", "America/Mexico_City": "MX", "America/Lima": "PE", "America/Bogota": "CO", "America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires": "AR", "Europe/Istanbul": "TR", "America/Montevideo": "UY", "America/Caracas": "VE", "America/Sao_Paulo": "BR", "America/Toronto": "CA", "America/Vancouver": "CA", "America/Montreal": "CA", "Asia/Dubai": "AE", "Europe/London": "GB", "Europe/Paris": "FR", "Europe/Berlin": "DE", "Europe/Rome": "IT", "Europe/Lisbon": "PT", "Asia/Singapore": "SG", "Asia/Tokyo": "JP", "Asia/Kolkata": "IN" });
  function inferredCountryCode(languages = [], timeZone = "") {
    if (zoneCountries[timeZone]) return zoneCountries[timeZone];
    for (let language2 of languages) {
      let match = String(language2).match(/^[a-z]{2,3}(?:-[a-z]{4})?-([a-z]{2})(?:-|$)/i);
      if (match) return match[1].toUpperCase();
    }
    return "";
  }
  function browserCountry(available = []) {
    let code = inferredCountryCode(navigator.languages || [navigator.language], Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone);
    if (!code) return "";
    let name = new Intl.DisplayNames(["es"], { type: "region" }).of(code);
    return !available.length || available.includes(name) ? name : "";
  }

      rows = geographies, active = selected, tabs.hidden = !rows.length, tabs.innerHTML = rows.map((row, index2) => `<button type="button" class="button" role="tab" id="${id}-${index2}" aria-controls="${panelId}" aria-selected="${row.name === active}" tabindex="${row.name === active ? 0 : -1}" data-geography="${escape2(row.name)}">${identityMark("countries", row.name, escape2)}${escape2(t(geographyLabel(row.name)))}<span class="geography-count">${row.total}</span></button>`).join("");
      let index = rows.findIndex((row) => row.name === active);
      index >= 0 ? panel2.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", id + "-" + index) : panel2.removeAttribute("aria-labelledby"), focus && (tabs.querySelector('[aria-selected="true"]')?.focus(), focus = !1);
    } };
  }

  // src/client/features/heatmap-model.js
  var HEATMAP_PAGE = Object.freeze({ rows: 12, columns: 8 });
  function heatmapPage(data, axis, level, rowPage, columnPage) {
    let columns = data.nodes.map((node, index) => ({ ...node, index })).filter((node) => node.level === level).sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count || a.palanca.localeCompare(b.palanca) || a.subpalanca.localeCompare(b.subpalanca)), rows = data[axis] || [], indices = new Set(columns.map((node) => node.index)), max = 1;
    for (let row of rows) for (let [index, count] of row.counts) indices.has(index) && (max = Math.max(max, count));
    let pages = { rows: Math.ceil(rows.length / HEATMAP_PAGE.rows), columns: Math.ceil(columns.length / HEATMAP_PAGE.columns) };
    return rowPage = Math.min(Math.max(0, rowPage), Math.max(0, pages.rows - 1)), columnPage = Math.min(Math.max(0, columnPage), Math.max(0, pages.columns - 1)), { rows: rows.slice(0, (rowPage + 1) * HEATMAP_PAGE.rows).map((row) => ({ ...row, counts: new Map(row.counts) })), columns: columns.slice(columnPage * HEATMAP_PAGE.columns, (columnPage + 1) * HEATMAP_PAGE.columns), pages, rowPage, columnPage, max };
  }
  function heatmapValue(count, total, mode, max) {
    let share = total ? Math.round(count / total * 100) : 0;
    return { share, level: count ? Math.min(4, Math.max(1, Math.ceil((mode === "share" ? share / 100 : count / max) * 4))) : 0 };
  }

  // src/client/features/taxonomy-heatmap.js
  function createTaxonomyHeatmap({ onExplore }) {
    let data, selection = {}, rowPage = 0, columnPage = 0, signature = "";
    function render() {
      if (!data) return;
      let axis = $("heatmap-axis").value, level = $("heatmap-level").value, mode = $("heatmap-measure").value, page = heatmapPage(data, axis, level, rowPage, columnPage);
      rowPage = page.rowPage, columnPage = page.columnPage;
      let label = (node) => node.level === "palanca" ? t(node.palanca) : t(node.subpalanca), number = new Intl.NumberFormat(language);
      $("heatmap-summary").textContent = t("{tagged}/{total} noticias con cat\xE1logo global de funcionalidades; {missing} sin catalogar.", { tagged: data.tagged, total: data.total, missing: data.total - data.tagged }), $("heatmap-table").innerHTML = page.columns.length ? "<table><caption>" + t("Bloques funcionales y funcionalidades / sub operativas por entidad y geograf\xEDa") + '</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">' + t(axis === "entities" ? "Entidad" : "Geograf\xEDa") + "</th>" + page.columns.map((node) => '<th scope="col" data-original>' + escape2(label(node)) + "</th>").join("") + "</tr></thead><tbody>" + page.rows.map((row, index) => '<tr><th scope="row" data-original>' + identityMark(axis, row.name, escape2) + escape2(t(row.name)) + "<small>" + escape2(t("{count} noticias", { count: row.total })) + "</small></th>" + page.columns.map((node) => {
        let count = row.counts.get(node.index) || 0, value = heatmapValue(count, row.total, mode, page.max), text = t("{group} \xB7 {topic}: {count} noticias ({share} %). Ver noticias.", { group: t(row.name), topic: label(node), count, share: value.share });
        return '<td><button type="button" class="heat-cell heat-' + value.level + '" data-row="' + index + '" data-node="' + node.index + '" aria-label="' + escape2(text) + '" title="' + escape2(text) + '"' + (count ? "" : " disabled") + '><span class="heat-cell-topic" aria-hidden="true">' + escape2(label(node)) + "</span><span>" + escape2(mode === "share" ? value.share + " %" : number.format(count)) + "</span></button></td>";
      }).join("") + "</tr>").join("") + "</tbody></table>" : '<p class="muted">' + t("No hay noticias catalogadas en esta selecci\xF3n.") + "</p>", $("heatmap-rows-label").textContent = t("{visible} de {total} grupos", { visible: page.rows.length, total: data[axis].length }), $("heatmap-columns-label").textContent = t("Categor\xEDas {page}/{pages}", { page: page.pages.columns ? columnPage + 1 : 0, pages: page.pages.columns }), $("heatmap-rows-next").disabled = rowPage + 1 >= page.pages.rows;
      for (let [id, value, max] of [["columns", columnPage, page.pages.columns]])
        $("heatmap-" + id + "-previous").disabled = !value, $("heatmap-" + id + "-next").disabled = value + 1 >= max;
      let top = data.nodes.filter((node) => node.level === level).sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)[0];
      $("heatmap-focus").textContent = top ? t("La categor\xEDa m\xE1s presente es {topic}, en {count} noticias.", { topic: label(top), count: top.count }) : "";
    }
    for (let id of ["axis", "level", "measure"]) $("heatmap-" + id).addEventListener("change", () => {
      rowPage = 0, columnPage = 0, render();
    });
    $("heatmap-rows-next").addEventListener("click", () => {
      rowPage++, render();
    });
    for (let id of ["columns"]) for (let direction of ["previous", "next"]) $("heatmap-" + id + "-" + direction).addEventListener("click", () => {
      let step = direction === "next" ? 1 : -1;
      id === "rows" ? rowPage += step : columnPage += step, render();
    });
    return $("heatmap-table").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      let button = event.target.closest("[data-node]");
      if (!button) return;
      let axis = $("heatmap-axis").value, page = heatmapPage(data, axis, $("heatmap-level").value, rowPage, columnPage), row = page.rows[Number(button.dataset.row)], node = data.nodes[Number(button.dataset.node)];
      !row || !node || onExplore({ ...selection, [axis === "entities" ? "entity" : "country"]: row.name, palanca: node.palanca, subpalanca: node.level === "subpalanca" ? taxonomyPath(node) : "", page: 0 });
    }), { render(value) {
      let next = JSON.stringify([value.heatmap, value.selection, language]);
      next !== signature && (signature = next, data = value.heatmap, selection = value.selection || {}, rowPage = 0, columnPage = 0, render());
    } };
  }

  // src/shared/record-filters.js
  function recordText(value) {
    return String(value ?? "").normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/ı/g, "i").trim();
  }
  function recordQuery(input2 = {}, fields = []) {
    let query = {};
    for (let key of ["search", "from", "to", ...fields]) {
      let value = String(input2[key] ?? "").trim();
      if (value.length > 160) throw Error("Filtro demasiado largo.");
      value && (query[key] = value);
    }
    for (let key of ["from", "to"]) if (query[key] && (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(query[key]) || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(query[key])) || new Date(query[key]).toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== query[key])) throw Error("Fecha no v\xE1lida.");
    if (query.from && query.to && query.from > query.to) throw Error("La fecha desde debe ser anterior o igual a la fecha hasta.");
    return query.page = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(input2.page) || 0)), query;
  }
  var recordDateFormatter;
  function filterRecords(rows, input2, fields, searchFields, dateKey = "fecha", timezone2 = "UTC") {
    let query = recordQuery(input2, fields), term = recordText(query.search);
    return rows.filter((row) => {
      if (fields.some((key) => query[key] && String(row[key]) !== query[key]) || term && !recordText(searchFields.map((key) => row[key] ?? "").join(" ")).includes(term)) return !1;
      if (!query.from && !query.to) return !0;
      let date2 = new Date(row[dateKey]);
      if (!Number.isFinite(date2.getTime())) return !1;
      let day2 = recordDay(date2, timezone2);
      return (!query.from || day2 >= query.from) && (!query.to || day2 <= query.to);
    });
  }
  function recordOptions(rows, fields) {
    return Object.fromEntries(fields.map((key) => [key, [...new Set(rows.map((row) => String(row[key] ?? "")).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, "es"))]));
  }
  function recordPage(rows, input2 = {}, pageSize = 30) {
    let page = Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(input2.page) || 0)), Math.max(0, Math.ceil(rows.length / pageSize) - 1));
    return { items: rows.slice(page * pageSize, (page + 1) * pageSize), total: rows.length, page, pageSize };
  }
  function recordDay(value, timezone2 = "UTC") {
    recordDateFormatter?.timezone !== timezone2 && (recordDateFormatter = { timezone: timezone2, formatter: new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone: timezone2, year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }) });
    let parts = Object.fromEntries(recordDateFormatter.formatter.formatToParts(new Date(value)).map((part) => [part.type, part.value]));
    return parts.year + "-" + parts.month + "-" + parts.day;
  }

  // src/client/features/record-filters.js
  function createRecordFilters(id, fields, onChange, { dates = !1, placeholder = "Buscar" } = {}) {
    let page = 0, timer, keys = ["search", ...fields.map(([key]) => key), ...dates ? ["from", "to"] : []];
    $(id + "-filters").innerHTML = '<div class="record-filters"><label>Buscar<input type="search" id="' + id + '-search" placeholder="' + escape2(placeholder) + '"></label>' + fields.map(([key, label, values]) => "<label>" + escape2(label) + '<select id="' + id + "-" + key + '"><option value="">Todos</option>' + options(values || []) + "</select></label>").join("") + (dates ? ["from", "to"].map((key, i) => "<label>" + ["Desde", "Hasta"][i] + '<input type="date" id="' + id + "-" + key + '"></label>').join("") : "") + '<button class="button" type="button" id="' + id + '-clear">Limpiar filtros</button></div>';
    function options(values) {
      return values.map((value) => {
        let [key, label] = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value, value];
        return "<option" + (/^\d{2}\./.test(label) ? ' data-catalog-name="' + escape2(label) + '"' : "") + ' value="' + escape2(key) + '">' + escape2(/^\d{2}\./.test(label) ? taxonomyDisplayLabel(t(label)) : displayRecord(label, language)) + "</option>";
      }).join("");
    }
    function change() {
      clearTimeout(timer), page = 0;
      try {
        query(), Promise.resolve(onChange()).catch((error) => message(error.message, !0));
      } catch (error) {
        message(error.message, !0);
      }
    }
    function query() {
      return recordQuery(Object.fromEntries([...keys.map((key) => [key, $(id + "-" + key).value]), ["page", page]]), fields.map(([key]) => key));
    }
    for (let key of keys) $(id + "-" + key).addEventListener(key === "search" ? "input" : "change", () => {
      key === "search" ? (clearTimeout(timer), timer = setTimeout(change, 250)) : change();
    });
    return $(id + "-clear").addEventListener("click", () => {
      keys.forEach((key) => $(id + "-" + key).value = ""), change();
    }), $(id + "-pagination").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      let button = event.target.closest("[data-page]");
      !button || button.disabled || (page += Number(button.dataset.page), Promise.resolve(onChange()).catch((error) => message(error.message, !0)));
    }), { query, reset() {
      clearTimeout(timer), page = 0;
    }, options(values) {
      for (let [key, list] of Object.entries(values)) {
        if (!fields.some(([field]) => field === key)) continue;
        let input2 = $(id + "-" + key), value = input2.value;
        input2.innerHTML = '<option value="">Todos</option>' + options([...list].sort((a, b) => taxonomyDisplayLabel(t(String(Array.isArray(a) ? a[1] : a))).localeCompare(taxonomyDisplayLabel(t(String(Array.isArray(b) ? b[1] : b))), language))), input2.value = list.some((item) => String(Array.isArray(item) ? item[0] : item) === value) ? value : "";
      }
    }, page(data) {
      page = data.page;
      let pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(data.total / data.pageSize));
      $(id + "-pagination").innerHTML = '<button class="button" type="button" data-page="-1" ' + (page === 0 ? "disabled" : "") + '>Anterior</button><span class="small muted" role="status">' + t("{total} resultados \xB7 p\xE1gina {page} de {pages}", { total: data.total, page: page + 1, pages }) + '</span><button class="button" type="button" data-page="1" ' + (page >= pages - 1 ? "disabled" : "") + ">Siguiente</button>";
    } };
  }

  // src/client/features/taxonomy.js
  function createTaxonomy({ run, isActive, onRevision }) {
    let items = [], pageSize, signature = "", sourceSignature = "", revision;
    $("taxonomy-source-form").addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault(), run(async () => {

      });
    });
    let filters5 = createRecordFilters("taxonomy", [["palanca", "Bloque funcional"]], render, { placeholder: "Bloque funcional, funcionalidad / sub operativa o t\xE9rmino" });
    function render() {
      let query = filters5.query(), page = recordPage(filterRecords(items, query, ["palanca"], ["palanca", "subpalanca", "terminos", "segmentos", "descripcion"]), query, pageSize);
      $("taxonomy-body").innerHTML = page.items.map((row) => `<tr><td data-original>${escape2(row.palanca)}</td><td><strong data-original>${escape2(row.subpalanca)}</strong></td><td>${escape2(row.segmentos.join(" \xB7 "))}</td><td>${row.noticias}</td><td data-original>${escape2(row.terminos.join(" \xB7 "))}</td><td data-original>${row.descripcion ? `<details><summary>${escape2(t("Descripci\xF3n"))}</summary>${escape2(row.descripcion)}</details>` : ""}</td><td>${escape2(row.origen === "local" ? t("Clasificaci\xF3n local") : row.origen === "tf-idf" ? "TF-IDF" : t("Cat\xE1logo maestro (Drive)"))}</td></tr>`).join("") || '<tr><td colspan="7">' + t("Sin cat\xE1logo global de funcionalidades disponible. Ejecuta el job para generarlo.") + "</td></tr>", filters5.page(page), $("taxonomy-count").textContent = t("{blocks} bloques funcionales \xB7 {functions} funcionalidades / sub operativas", { blocks: new Set(items.map((row) => row.palanca)).size, functions: items.filter((row) => row.subpalanca).length });
    }
    let monitor = createJobMonitor({ id: "taxonomy", get: "getTaxonomyStatus", start: "startTaxonomy", run, isActive, onRevision, render(data) {
      let source = JSON.stringify([data.configurationRevision, data.catalogUrl]);
      source !== sourceSignature && (sourceSignature = source, revision = data.configurationRevision, $("taxonomy-catalog-url").value = data.catalogUrl || ""), $("taxonomy-catalog-status").textContent = data.job?.catalog?.error ? t("No se pudo revisar Drive; se utiliza el cat\xE1logo guardado. ") + data.job.catalog.error : data.synced ? t("\xDAltima lectura del maestro: {date}", { date: date(data.synced) }) : data.catalogUrl ? t("Se revisar\xE1 Drive al iniciar la actualizaci\xF3n.") : t("Se utiliza el cat\xE1logo guardado.");
      let job = data.job, total = Number(job?.workTotal ?? Number(job?.total || 0) * 2), done = Number(job?.processed || 0);
      $("taxonomy-progress").innerHTML = job ? jobProgressHtml(job, { total, done, label: "Progreso de cat\xE1logo global de funcionalidades", queued: data.queued, summary: t("{done}/{total} pasos de an\xE1lisis y etiquetado; {tagged} etiquetas actualizadas.", { done, total, tagged: job.tagged }) }) : '<p class="muted">' + t(data.queued ? "En cola" : "Sin actualizaciones del cat\xE1logo ejecutadas.") + "</p>";
      let next = JSON.stringify([data.items, data.pageSize, data.taxonomyTranslations, language]);
      next !== signature && (signature = next, items = data.items.filter((row) => row.subpalanca), pageSize = data.pageSize, filters5.options(recordOptions(items, ["palanca"])), render());
    } });
    return monitor;
  }

  // src/client/features/runs.js
  var filters, request = 0, syncRecovery = () => {
  };
  async function loadRuns() {
    filters ||= createRecordFilters("runs", [["estado", "Estado"], ["id", "Recarga"]], loadRuns, { dates: !0, placeholder: "Estado o error" });
    let current = ++request;
    try {
      let data = await call("getRuns", filters.query());
      return current !== request ? void 0 : (renderCollectionJobs(data.collection), filters.options(data.options), filters.page(data), $("runs-body").innerHTML = data.items.map((r) => `<tr><td>${escape2(displayRecord(r.tipo, language))} ${escape2(r.desde)} \u2014 ${escape2(r.hasta)}</td><td>${escape2(date(r.inicio))}</td><td>${escape2(r.estado)}</td><td>${escape2(r.evaluadas)}</td><td>${escape2(r.nuevas)}</td><td>${escape2(r.errores || "\u2014")}</td></tr>`).join("") || '<tr><td colspan="6">Sin ejecuciones con estos filtros.</td></tr>', data);
    } catch (error) {
      current === request && message(error.message, !0);
    }
  }
  function renderCollectionJobs(status) {
    syncRecovery(status);
    let total = Number(status?.total || 0), done = Number(status?.processed || 0) + Number(status?.skipped || 0) + Number(status?.failed || 0);

      return `<article class="collection-job" data-collection-kind="${escape2(job.tipo)}"><div class="panel-header"><h3>${escape2(displayRecord(job.tipo, language))}</h3><span>${escape2(t(progress.state))}</span></div>${job.desde ? `<p class="small muted">${escape2(formatCalendarDay(job.desde, language))} \u2014 ${escape2(formatCalendarDay(job.hasta, language))}</p>` : ""}<progress max="${Math.max(1, total2)}" value="${done2}" aria-label="${escape2(displayRecord(job.tipo, language))}"></progress><p>${escape2(t("{done}/{total} consultas; {added} noticias incorporadas.", { done: done2, total: total2, added: job.nuevas || 0 }))}</p><p class="small muted">${Number(job.pendientes || 0)} ${escape2(t("Pendientes"))} \xB7 ${Number(job.fallidas || 0)} ${escape2(t("Errores"))}</p>${progressDetailsHtml(progress)}</article>`;
    }).join("");
  }
  function createRecoveryControls({ getData, run }) {
    let busy = !1, status = {}, radios = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[name="recovery-range"]')];
    function render(next = status) {
      status = next || {};
      for (let radio of radios) radio.disabled = busy;
      let range = document.querySelector('input[name="recovery-range"]:checked').value, blocked = !!status.blocked?.[range];
      $("collect").disabled = busy || blocked, $("recovery-status").textContent = blocked ? t(range === "year" ? "Ya hay una recuperaci\xF3n anual en curso." : "Ya hay una recuperaci\xF3n diaria en curso.") : "", $("continue-collection").hidden = !blocked, $("continue-collection").disabled = busy, $("retry-collection").disabled = busy, $("toggle-daily").disabled = busy, $("toggle-daily").textContent = t(getData()?.daily ? "Desactivar recopilaci\xF3n diaria" : "Activar recopilaci\xF3n diaria"), $("recovery-schedule").textContent = getData()?.schedule || "";
    }
    async function recover(method, range) {
      return run(async () => {
        let result = await call(method, ...range ? [range] : []);
        message(result.notice, result.errors.length > 0);
      });
    }
    return $("collect").addEventListener("click", () => recover("collectNow", document.querySelector('input[name="recovery-range"]:checked').value)), $("continue-collection").addEventListener("click", () => recover("resumeCollection", document.querySelector('input[name="recovery-range"]:checked').value)), radios.forEach((radio) => radio.addEventListener("change", () => render())), $("toggle-daily").addEventListener("click", () => run(async () => {
      let enabled = getData().daily, result = await call(enabled ? "disableDaily" : "enableDaily");
      message(enabled ? "Recopilaci\xF3n diaria desactivada." : result);
    })), $("retry-collection").addEventListener("click", () => run(async () => message(await call("retryCollectionErrors")))), syncRecovery = render, { setBusy(value) {
      busy = value, render();
    } };
  }

  // src/client/features/collection-progress.js
  function createCollectionProgress({ isActive, isBusy, onStatus }) {
    let timer, polling = !1;
    function render(status) {
      let node = $("collection-progress");
      node.hidden = !isActive() || !(status?.total || status?.queued), onStatus(status), !node.hidden && (node.textContent = t("Recuperaci\xF3n: {processed}/{total} consultas; {pending} pendientes; {added} noticias incorporadas.", status) + (status.lastActivity ? " " + t("\xDAltima actividad") + ": " + date(status.lastActivity) + "." : "") + (status.queued ? " " + t("{queued} recargas en cola.", status) : "") + (status.failed ? " " + status.failed + " " + t("Errores") + "." : ""));
    }
    function update(data) {
      render(data.collection), clearTimeout(timer), isActive() && (data.collection?.pending || data.collection?.queued) && (timer = setTimeout(poll, 3e4));
    }
    async function poll() {
      if (!isActive()) {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        return;
      }
      if (document.hidden || isBusy() || polling) {
        timer = setTimeout(poll, 3e4);
        return;
      }
      polling = !0;
      try {
        let data = await call("getCollectionProgress");
        update(data);
      } catch {
        timer = setTimeout(poll, 6e4);
      } finally {
        polling = !1;
      }
    }
    return { update };
  }

  // src/client/features/filter-panel.js
  function createFilterPanel() {
    let dialog2 = $("filters-dialog"), panels = { administration: $("admin-tabs"), news: $("filters-section") };
    for (let panel2 of Object.values(panels)) $("mobile-filters").appendChild(panel2);
    $("mobile-filters").appendChild($("sidebar-context")), $("mobile-filters").appendChild(document.querySelector(".sidebar-foot"));
    let media = window.matchMedia("(max-width:767px)");
    function administrationLayout() {
      let tabs = panels.administration, admin = !$("administration-section").hidden;
      (media.matches ? $("mobile-filters") : $("administration-tools")).appendChild(tabs), tabs.setAttribute("aria-orientation", media.matches ? "vertical" : "horizontal"), admin && (document.querySelector(".selection-toolbar").hidden = !media.matches), dialog2.open && !media.matches && admin && dialog2.close();
    }
    return media.addEventListener("change", administrationLayout), $("open-filters").addEventListener("click", () => dialog2.showModal()), $("close-filters").addEventListener("click", () => dialog2.close()), dialog2.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      (event.target === dialog2 || event.target.closest("[data-admin-view]")) && dialog2.close();
    }), { show(view) {
      dialog2.open && dialog2.close();
      let toolbar = document.querySelector(".selection-toolbar"), freshness = $("selection-freshness"), host = document.querySelector("#" + view + "-section .reading-hero");
      $("open-filters").hidden = view === "briefing", toolbar.hidden = view === "subscriptions" || view === "administration" && !media.matches, view === "administration" ? $("administration-tools").appendChild(toolbar) : host ? (host.appendChild(freshness), host.appendChild(toolbar)) : (document.querySelector(".content").prepend(toolbar), toolbar.after(freshness));
      let active = panels[view] || panels.news, admin = view === "administration", reading2 = !admin && view !== "subscriptions";
      for (let panel2 of Object.values(panels)) panel2.hidden = view === "subscriptions" || panel2 !== active;
      $("panel-button-label").textContent = admin ? "Men\xFA" : "Filtros", $("panel-dialog-title").textContent = admin ? "Administraci\xF3n" : "Filtros", dialog2.setAttribute("aria-label", admin ? "Herramientas de administraci\xF3n" : "Configurar filtros"), $("filter-dialog-actions").hidden = !reading2, administrationLayout();
    } };
  }

  // src/client/features/subscription-templates.js
  function subscriptionForm(options, admin, row) {
    let country = row?.filtros.country ?? browserCountry(options.countries), newsletterLanguage = row?.idioma || language;
    return `<form data-subscription-form data-admin="${admin}" data-id="${escape2(row?.id || "")}"><h3>${row ? "Mi suscripci\xF3n" : "Recibe Mi Newsletter"}</h3>${admin ? `<label>Correo corporativo<input name="email" type="email" required value="${escape2(row?.correo || "")}" placeholder="nombre@bbva.com"></label>` : `<p>${escape2(options.email)}</p>`}<div class="subscription-fields"><label>Geograf\xEDa<select name="country"><option value="">Sin personalizar</option>${options.countries.map((name) => `<option value="${escape2(name)}"${name === country ? " selected" : ""}>${escape2(name)}</option>`).join("")}</select></label><label>Idioma<select name="language">${Object.entries(languageNames).map(([code, name]) => `<option value="${code}"${code === newsletterLanguage ? La suscripci\xF3n no cambia tus pantallas.</p><div class="actions"><button type="submit" class="button primary">${row ? "Guardar cambios" : "Suscribirme"}</button>${admin || row ? '<button type="button" class="button" data-close-editor>Cancelar</button>' : ""}</div></form>`;
  }
  function subscriptionCards(rows, admin) {
    return rows.map((row) => `<article class="panel selection-card"><div class="panel-header"><div><h3>${admin ? escape2(row.correo) : "Mi Newsletter"}</h3><p>${escape2(row.filtros.country || "Sin personalizar")} \xB7 ${escape2(languageNames[row.idioma])}</p></div><span class="status-pill" data-state="${row.activa ?
