"\xDAltimo env\xEDo: " + escape2(date(row.ultimaEntrega.fecha)) + " \xB7 " + escape2(row.ultimaEntrega.estado) : "Sin env\xEDos registrados"}</p><div class="actions"><button class="button" data-action="edit" data-id="${escape2(row.id)}">Editar</button><button class="button" data-action="delete" data-id="${escape2(row.id)}">Dar de baja</button></div></article>`).join("") || '<div class="panel empty"><p>Sin suscripciones.</p></div>';
  }
  function newsletterHistoryCards(rows) {
    return rows.map((row) => `<article class="newsletter-history-item"><p class="small"><time>${escape2(date(row.fecha))}</time> \xB7 ${escape2(row.estado)} \xB7 ${escape2(row.desde)} / ${escape2(row.hasta)}</p>${row.edition ? `<details data-newsletter-summary="${escape2(row.edition)}"><summary>Resumen de lo recibido</summary><div data-summary-content></div></details>` : ""}</article>`).join("") || '<p class="muted">Todav\xEDa no has recibido newsletters.</p>';
  }

  // src/client/features/newsletter-summary.js
  function attachNewsletterSummaries(container) {
    container.addEventListener("toggle", async (event) => {
      let details = event.target;
      if (!details.matches("[data-newsletter-summary]") || !details.open || details.dataset.loaded) return;
      let content = details.querySelector("[data-summary-content]");
      content.textContent = "Cargando resumen\u2026", details.dataset.loaded = "pending";
      try {
        let data = await call("getNewsletterSummary", details.dataset.newsletterSummary);
        content.innerHTML = '<p class="small">' + escape2(data.from) + " / " + escape2(data.to) + " \xB7 " + data.count + " publicaciones \xB7 " + escape2(data.country || "Sin personalizar") + "</p><ul>" + (data.cards?.length ? data.cards.map((card) => "<li><strong>" + escape2(card.category) + "</strong> \xB7 " + escape2(card.scope) + "<br>" + (card.url ? '<a href="' + escape2(card.url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + escape2(card.title) + "</a>" : escape2(card.title)) + "</li>") : data.topics.map((topic) => "<li>" + escape2(topic) + "</li>")).join("") + "</ul>", details.dataset.loaded = "true";
      } catch (error) {
        content.textContent = error.message, delete details.dataset.loaded;
      }
    }, !0);
  }

  // src/client/features/subscriptions.js
  function createSubscriptions({ run }) {
    let options, own = [], all = [], request3 = 0, historyLimit = 3, filters5 = {}, editorId = (admin) => admin ? "admin-subscription-editor" : "personal-editor";
    function edit(admin, row) {
      let target = $(editorId(admin));
      target.hidden = !1, target.innerHTML = subscriptionForm(options, admin, row);
    }
    function render(admin) {
      if (!admin) {
        $("subscriptions-list").innerHTML = subscriptionCards(own, !1);
        return;
      }
      let id = "subscribers", rows = all;
      filters5[id] ||= createRecordFilters(id, [...admin ? [["correo", "Suscriptor"]] : [], ["activa", "Estado", [["true", "Activa"], ["false", "Pausada"]]]], () => render(admin), { placeholder: "Correo o geograf\xEDa" }), filters5[id].options(recordOptions(rows, admin ? ["correo"] : []));
      let selected = filterRecords(rows, filters5[id].query(), admin ? ["correo", "activa"] : ["activa"], ["correo", "nombre"]), page = recordPage(selected, filters5[id].query());
      $(admin ? "admin-subscriptions-list" : "subscriptions-list").innerHTML = subscriptionCards(page.items, admin), filters5[id].page(page);
    }
    async function open(admin = !1) {
      let current = ++request3, [settings, rows, history] = await Promise.all([call("getNewsletterOptions"), call(admin ? "getAdminSubscriptions" : "getSubscriptions"), admin ? null : call("getMyNewsletterHistory", { limit: historyLimit })]);
      if (current === request3) {
        if (options = settings, admin)
          all = rows, $("subscribers-count").textContent = t("{subscribers} suscriptores \xB7 {subscriptions} suscripciones", { subscribers: rows.length, subscriptions: rows.length });
        else {
          own = rows;
          let count = rows.filter((row) => row.activa).length;
          $("subscriptions-count").textContent = t(count === 1 ? "1 suscripci\xF3n" : "{count} suscripciones", { count }), $("newsletter-delivery-status").textContent = settings.enabled ? "Entrega autom\xE1tica activa." : "Las entregas comenzar\xE1n cuando la programaci\xF3n est\xE9 activada.", renderHistory(history);
        }
        render(admin), admin || rows.length ? $(editorId(admin)).hidden = !0 : edit(!1);
      }
    }
    for (let admin of [!1, !0]) {
      let target = $(editorId(admin));
      target.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        event.target.closest("[data-close-editor]") && (target.hidden = !0);
      }), target.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        let form = event.target, data = new FormData(form), row = (admin ? all : own).find((row2) => row2.id === form.dataset.id);
        run(async () => {
          message(await call(admin ? "saveAdminSubscription" : "saveSubscription", { id: row?.id, email: data.get("email"), country: data.get("country"), language: data.get("language"), active: !0 })), await open(admin);
        }, !1);
      }), admin && $("new-admin-subscription").addEventListener("click", () => edit(!0)), $(admin ? "admin-subscriptions-list" : "subscriptions-list").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        let button = event.target.closest("[data-action]");
        if (!button) return;
        let row = (admin ? all : own).find((row2) => row2.id === button.dataset.id);
        row && (button.dataset.action === "edit" ? edit(admin, row) : button.dataset.action === "delete" && run(async () => {
          message(await call(admin ? "deleteAdminSubscription" : "deleteSubscription", row.id)), await open(admin);
        }, !1));
      });
    }
    function renderHistory(history) {
      $("personal-history").innerHTML = newsletterHistoryCards(history.items), $("personal-history-pages").innerHTML = history.items.length < history.total ? '<button class="button" data-history-more>Mostrar m\xE1s</button>' : "";
    }
    return $("personal-history-pages").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      event.target.closest("[data-history-more]") && run(async () => {
        historyLimit += 3, renderHistory(await call("getMyNewsletterHistory", { limit: historyLimit }));
      }, !1);
    }), attachNewsletterSummaries($("personal-history")), { open };
  }

  // src/client/features/newsletter-delivery.js
  function createNewsletterDelivery({ run, isActive }) {
    function feedback(text, error = !1) {
      let target = $("newsletter-test-result");
      target.hidden = !1, target.textContent = text, target.classList.toggle("error", error);
    }
    let monitor = createJobMonitor({ id: "newsletter-delivery", get: "getNewsletterProgress", isActive, render({ job }) {
      $("newsletter-delivery-progress").innerHTML = jobProgressHtml(job, { total: job.total, done: job.processed, label: "Progreso de env\xEDos planificados", summary: t("{done}/{total} entregas; {accepted} aceptadas; {empty} sin novedades; {pending} pendientes; {review} por revisar.", { ...job, done: job.processed }) });
    } }), historyFilters, historyRequest = 0;
    async function history() {
      historyFilters ||= createRecordFilters("delivery", [["correo", "Suscriptor"], ["estado", "Estado"], ["suscripcion", "Suscripci\xF3n"]], history, { dates: !0, placeholder: "Gmail ID, correo o motivo" });
      let request3 = ++historyRequest, data = await call("getNewsletterHistory", historyFilters.query());
      request3 === historyRequest && (historyFilters.options(data.options), historyFilters.page(data), $("delivery-history-body").innerHTML = data.items.map((row) => `<tr><td>${escape2(date(row.fecha))}</td><td>${escape2(row.correo)}</td><td>${escape2(row.estado)}</td><td>${row.noticias ?? "Sin detalle"}</td><td>${escape2(row.detalle)}${row.edition ? `<details data-newsletter-summary="${escape2(row.edition)}"><summary>Resumen enviado</summary><div data-summary-content></div></details>` : ""}</td></tr>`).join("") || '<tr><td colspan="5">Sin env\xEDos con estos filtros.</td></tr>', $("delivery-history-note").textContent = data.total + " coincidencias." + (data.limited ? " Hist\xF3rico visible limitado a " + data.limit + " registros; el control de duplicados conserva el historial completo." : ""));
    }
    async function open() {
      let [status, options] = await Promise.all([call("getNewsletterDeliveryStatus"), call("getNewsletterOptions"), history(), monitor.open()]), form = $("newsletter-test-form"), selected = form.elements.country.value;
      form.elements.email.placeholder = options.email, form.elements.country.innerHTML = '<option value="">Sin personalizar</option>' + options.countries.map((name) => "<option>" + escape2(name) + "</option>").join(""), form.elements.country.value = selected, $("newsletter-sender").textContent = status.name + " <" + status.address + ">", $("newsletter-checks").innerHTML = [["Remitente", status.available ? "Configurado" : "Pendiente"], ["Entrega", status.enabled ? "Activada" : "Desactivada"], ["Programaci\xF3n", status.scheduled ? "Instalada" : "Sin activador"]].map(([name, value]) => `<div class="delivery-check"><strong>${name}</strong><span>${value}</span></div>`).join(""), $("newsletter-sender-status").textContent = status.available ? "El remitente se utiliza en los env\xEDos autom\xE1ticos y las pruebas." : status.error, $("newsletter-budget").textContent = status.remaining + " env\xEDos disponibles dentro del l\xEDmite configurado de 24 horas.", $("newsletter-content-note").textContent = status.untracked ? status.untracked + " env\xEDos anteriores no registraron las noticias incluidas. El control de contenido se aplica a los env\xEDos con inventario; los anteriores requieren contrastar los correos originales." : "El contenido de los nuevos env\xEDos queda registrado por suscriptor. Las pruebas se excluyen del control de duplicados.";
      let last = status.last;
      $("newsletter-history").innerHTML = last ? `<strong>\xDAltimo intento \xB7 ${escape2(date(last.fecha))}</strong><span>${escape2(last.estado)} \xB7 ${escape2(last.correo)}</span><span>${escape2(last.detalle)}</span>` : "<span>No hay intentos de env\xEDo registrados.</span>";
    }
    return attachNewsletterSummaries($("delivery-history-body")), $("newsletter-test-form").addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      let form = event.target;
      if (!form.reportValidity()) return;
      let data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));
      run(async () => {
        feedback("Procesando solicitud\u2026");
        try {
          let result = await call("sendNewsletterTest", data);
          feedback(result.accepted ? t("Gmail ha aceptado la prueba para {recipient} \xB7 {count} novedades.", result) : "No hay noticias para esta edici\xF3n y geograf\xEDa.");
        } catch (error) {
          feedback(error.message, !0);
        }
        await open();
      }, !1);
    }), { open, close: monitor.close };
  }

  // src/client/features/configuration.js
  function createConfiguration({ run }) {
    let config, revision, category = "entities", capabilityDefaults, entries = () => category === "capabilities" ? config.capabilities.Empresas : config[category], setEntries = (rows) => {
      category === "capabilities" ? config.capabilities.Empresas = rows : config[category] = rows;
    };
    async function fetchConfig() {
      let snapshot = await call("getConfiguration");
      config = snapshot.config, revision = snapshot.revision, capabilityDefaults = snapshot.capabilityDefaults;
    }
    function readFields() {
      if (config)
        if (category === "applicationScope")
          config.applicationScope = [...$("catalog-fields").querySelectorAll("[data-scope]")].map((group) => ({ name: group.dataset.scope, countries: [...group.querySelectorAll("[data-country]:checked")].map((input2) => input2.dataset.country) }));
        else if (category === "taxonomy") {
          let list = (input2) => input2.value.split(";").map((value) => value.trim()).filter(Boolean), records = (block, selector) => [...block.querySelectorAll(selector)].map((row) => Object.fromEntries([...row.querySelectorAll("[data-key]")].map((input2) => [input2.dataset.key, input2.dataset.key === "primary" ? input2.checked : input2.dataset.list === "true" ? list(input2) : input2.value.trim()])));
          config.taxonomy = [...$("catalog-fields").children].map((block) => ({ name: block.querySelector('[data-key="name"]').value.trim(), terms: list(block.querySelector('[data-key="terms"]')), emerging: records(block, "[data-emerging]"), functions: records(block, "[data-function]") }));
        } else if (category === "settings")
          for (let input2 of $("catalog-fields").querySelectorAll("[data-key]")) config.settings[input2.dataset.key] = input2.type === "checkbox" ? input2.checked : input2.type === "number" ? Number(input2.value) : input2.dataset.list === "true" ? input2.value.split(";").map((value) => value.trim()).filter(Boolean) : input2.value;
        else setEntries([...$("catalog-fields").children].map((row) => Object.fromEntries([...row.querySelectorAll("[data-key]")].map((input2) => [input2.dataset.key, input2.type === "checkbox" ? input2.checked : input2.dataset.list === "true" ? input2.value.split(";").map((value) => value.trim()).filter(Boolean) : input2.value]))));
    }
    function fields(fields2, row) {
      return fields2.map(([key, label, type, choices]) => `<label>${escape2(label)}${type === "choice" ? `<select data-key="${key}">${choices.map(([value, label2]) => `<option value="${escape2(value)}" ${row[key] === value ? "selected" : ""}>${escape2(label2)}</option>`).join("")}</select>` : type === "boolean" ? `<input type="checkbox" data-key="${key}" ${row[key] ? "checked" : ""}>` : `<input data-key="${key}" ${type === "list" ? 'data-list="true"' : ""} type="${type === "number" ? "number" : "text"}" ${type === "readonly" ? "readonly" : ""} value="${escape2(type === "list" ? (row[key] || []).join("; ") : row[key] ?? "")}">`}</label>`).join("");
    }
    function render() {
      let meta = admin_schema_default[category];
      if ($("capability-toolbar").hidden = category !== "capabilities", $("catalog-help").textContent = meta.help, $("catalog-add").hidden = ["settings", "applicationScope", "taxonomy"].includes(category), category === "taxonomy") {
        $("catalog-fields").innerHTML = config.taxonomy.map((block, index) => `<details class="catalog-row"><summary><strong>${escape2(block.name)}</strong><span>${block.functions.length}</span></summary><div class="catalog-grid">${fields([["name", "Bloque funcional", "readonly"], ["terms", "Equivalencias del bloque", "list"]], block)}</div>${block.functions.map((row) => `<div class="catalog-grid" data-function>${fields([["id", "C\xF3digo", "readonly"], ["name", "Funcionalidad / Sub Operativa", "readonly"], ["terms", "Equivalencias de b\xFAsqueda", "list"], ["context", "Contexto operativo requerido", "list"], ["exclude", "Excluir coincidencias", "list"]], row)}</div>`).join("")}<h3>${t("Conceptos emergentes admitidos")}</h3><button type="button" class="button" data-add-emerging="${index}">${t("A\xF1adir concepto emergente")}</button>${block.emerging.map((row) => `<div class="catalog-grid" data-emerging>${fields([["name", "Funcionalidad / Sub Operativa", "text"], ["terms", "Equivalencias de b\xFAsqueda", "list"], ["context", "Contexto operativo requerido", "list"], ["exclude", "Excluir coincidencias", "list"], ["primaryTerms", "Productos concretos de fuente oficial", "list"], ["primary", "Producto concreto respaldado por fuente oficial", "boolean"]], row)}<button type="button" class="button" data-remove-emerging>${t("Eliminar")}</button></div>`).join("")}</details>`).join("");
        return;
      }
      $("catalog-fields").innerHTML = category === "applicationScope" ? config.applicationScope.map((scope) => `<fieldset class="catalog-group scope-group" data-scope="${escape2(scope.name)}"><legend>${escape2(scope.name)}</legend><div class="scope-countries">${config.geographies.map((country) => `<label class="scope-country"><input type="checkbox" data-country="${escape2(country.name)}" ${scope.countries.includes(country.name) ? "checked" : ""}><span>${escape2(country.name)}</span></label>`).join("")}</div></fieldset>`).join("") : category === "settings" ? admin_schema_default.settings.groups.map((group) => `<fieldset class="catalog-group"><legend>${escape2(group.label)}</legend><div class="catalog-settings">${group.keys.map((key) => {
        let value = config.settings[key];
        return fields([[key, admin_schema_default.settings.labels[key], Array.isArray(value) ? "list" : typeof value == "number" ? "number" : typeof value == "boolean" ? "boolean" : "text"]], config.settings);
      }).join("")}</div></fieldset>`).join("") : entries().map((row) => `<details class="catalog-row" ${row.name ? "" : "open"}><summary><strong>${escape2(row.name || "Nueva entrada")}</strong><span>${escape2(row.type || "")} \xB7 ${row.enabled ? "Activa" : "Inactiva"}</span></summary><div class="catalog-grid">${fields(meta.fields, row)}</div><div class="actions"><button type="button" class="button" data-move="-1">Subir</button><button type="button" class="button" data-move="1">Bajar</button><button type="button" class="button" data-remove>Eliminar</button></div></details>`).join("");
    }
    return $("catalog-category").innerHTML = Object.entries(admin_schema_default).map(([key, meta]) => `<option value="${key}">${escape2(meta.label)}</option>`).join(""), $("catalog-category").addEventListener("change", () => {
      readFields(), category = $("catalog-category").value, render();
    }), $("catalog-fields").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      let add = event.target.closest("[data-add-emerging]");
      if (add) {
        readFields(), config.taxonomy[Number(add.dataset.addEmerging)].emerging.push({ name: "", terms: [] }), render();
        return;
      }
      let emerging = event.target.closest("[data-remove-emerging]");
      if (emerging) {
        emerging.closest("[data-emerging]").remove();
        return;
      }
      let remove = event.target.closest("[data-remove]");
      remove && remove.closest(".catalog-row").remove();
      let move = event.target.closest("[data-move]");
      if (move) {
        let row = move.closest(".catalog-row"), index = [...$("catalog-fields").children].indexOf(row), target = index + Number(move.dataset.move);
        readFields(), target >= 0 && target < entries().length && ([entries()[index], entries()[target]] = [entries()[target], entries()[index]], render());
      }
    }), $("capability-restore").addEventListener("click", () => {
      readFields(), config.capabilities.Empresas = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(capabilityDefaults.Empresas)), render();
    }), $("catalog-add").addEventListener("click", () => {
      readFields(), entries().push(Object.fromEntries(admin_schema_default[category].fields.map(([key, , type]) => [key, type === "list" ? [] : type === "boolean" ? !0 : type === "choice" ? admin_schema_default[category].fields.find((field) => field[0] === key)[3][0][0] : ""]))), render();
    }), $("catalog-form").addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
      event.preventDefault(), readFields(), run(async () => {
        message(await call("saveConfiguration", { config, revision })), await fetchConfig(), render();
      });
    }), $("catalog-reload").addEventListener("click", () => run(async () => {
      await fetchConfig(), render();
    }, !1)), { open: () => config ? Promise.resolve() : fetchConfig().then(render) };
  }

  // src/shared/novelty-groups.js
  function noveltyGroups(items, country = (row) => geographyLabel(row.pais)) {
    let geographies = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    for (let row of items) {
      let name = country(row), entity = row.entidad || "Entidad no identificada", segment = [...new Set(row.segmentos || [])].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, "es")).join(" \xB7 ") || "Segmento no identificado";
      geographies.has(name) || geographies.set(name, { name, items: [], entities: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map() });
      let geography = geographies.get(name);
      geography.items.push(row), geography.entities.has(entity) || geography.entities.set(entity, { name: entity, items: [], segments: /* @__PURE__ */ new Map() });
      let group = geography.entities.get(entity);
      group.items.push(row), group.segments.has(segment) || group.segments.set(segment, { name: segment, items: [] }), group.segments.get(segment).items.push(row);
    }
    return [...geographies.values()].map((row) => ({ ...row, entities: [...row.entities.values()].map((entity) => ({ ...entity, total: entity.items.length, segments: [...entity.segments.values()] })).sort(entityVolumeOrder) })).sort(geographyOrder);
  }
  function noveltyCount(count, singular, plural, translate = (value) => value) {
    return count + " " + translate(count === 1 ? singular : plural);
  }

  // src/client/features/article-text.js
  function articleOriginal(row) {
    let original = row.original;
    return original && (original.titular !== row.titular || (original.extracto || "") !== (row.extracto || "")) ? '<details class="article-original"><summary>Ver original</summary><p data-original><strong>' + escape2(original.titular) + "</strong></p>" + (original.extracto ? "<p data-original>" + escape2(original.extracto) + "</p>" : "") + "</details>" : "";
  }
  function articleHeader(row, content) {
    return '<div class="story-topline"><div class="story-heading">' + content + "</div>" + storyIdentity(row.entidad, row.pais, escape2) + "</div>";
  }
  function articleTags(row, selection = {}, novelty = !1) {
    let values = [...row.tipo ? [row.tipo] : [], ...row.segmentos || [], ...row.senales || []];
    return newsCoverage(row) + newsTaxonomy(row) + [...new Set(values)].map((value) => '<span class="badge" data-original>' + escape2(t(value === "Incidencia operativa" ? "Indisponibilidad / Incidencia operativa" : value)) + "</span>").join("");
  }
  function articleDate(row) {
    return '<time datetime="' + escape2(row.fecha) + '">' + escape2(t("Publicado")) + ": " + escape2(formatCalendarDay(row.fecha, language)) + "</time>";
  }
  function articleTitle(row) {
    return '<h3 class="story-title" data-original><a class="story-link" href="' + escape2(validUrl(row.url)) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">' + escape2(row.titular) + "</a></h3>";
  }
  function articleEvidence(row) {
    let evidence = row.functionalEvidence;
    return evidence?.terms?.length ? '<details class="article-original"><summary>' + escape2(t("Por qu\xE9 est\xE1 clasificada aqu\xED")) + "</summary><p>" + escape2(t(evidence.method === "external" ? "Evidencia web aportada" : evidence.method === "literal" ? "Coincidencia operativa directa" : "Contexto descriptivo del cat\xE1logo")) + " \xB7 " + escape2(t(evidence.location === "web" ? "Texto del editor" : evidence.location === "headline" ? "Titular" : "Titular y extracto")) + "</p><p data-original>" + evidence.terms.map(escape2).join(" \xB7 ") + "</p>" + (evidence.url ? '<p><a href="' + escape2(evidence.url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">' + escape2(evidence.url) + "</a> \xB7 " + escape2(evidence.retrievedAt) + "</p>" : "") + "</details>" : "";
  }
  function articleContent(row, selection = {}, novelty = !1) {
    return articleHeader(row, articleTitle(row)) + (row.extracto ? "<p data-original>" + escape2(row.extracto) + "</p>" : "") + articleOriginal(row) + articleEvidence(row) + '<div class="article-metadata"><div class="news-meta">' + articleTags(row, selection, novelty) + '</div><div class="news-meta">' + articleDate(row) + newsPublisher(row) + "</div></div>";
  }

  // src/client/features/briefing.js
  function createBriefing({ onExplore }) {
    let briefing2, groups = [], active = "", selection = {}, tabs = createGeographyTabs("briefing-geographies", "briefing-list", (name) => {
      active = name, paint2();
    });
    function paint2() {
      let group = groups.find((row) => row.name === active), stats = group || briefing2;
      tabs.render(groups, active), $("briefing-geography-summary").textContent = group ? t("{geography} \xB7 {updates} \xB7 {entities}", { geography: t(geographyLabel(group.name)), updates: noveltyCount(stats.total, "novedad", "novedades", t), entities: noveltyCount(group.entityCount, "entidad", "entidades", t) }) : "", $("briefing-count").textContent = t("{count} publicaciones", { count: briefing2.total }), $("briefing-signals").innerHTML = stats.bySignal.map((row) => `<button type="button" class="signal-card" ${row.total ? "" : "disabled"} data-signal="${escape2(row.name)}"><strong>${row.total}</strong><span>${escape2(t(row.name === "Incidencia operativa" ? "Indisponibilidad / Incidencia operativa" : row.name))}</span></button>`).join("");
      let rows = group?.entities.flatMap((entity) => entity.items) || [];
      $("briefing-list").innerHTML = rows.map((row) => `<article class="panel novelty-card">${articleContent(row, selection, !0)}</article>`).join("") || '<div class="panel empty"><h3>' + t("No hay novedades de producto en esta selecci\xF3n.") + "</h3></div>", $("briefing-limit").hidden = !group || stats.total <= group.items.length;
    }
    return $("briefing-signals").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      let button = event.target.closest("[data-signal]");
      button && onExplore({ ...selection, country: "", newsGeography: active, signal: button.dataset.signal, page: 0 });
    }), { render(data) {
      selection = data.selection || {}, briefing2 = data.briefing || { total: 0, bySignal: [], geographies: [], items: [] }, briefing2 = { ...briefing2, items: briefing2.items.filter(briefingAllowed), bySignal: briefing2.bySignal.filter((row) => BRIEFING_ALLOWED_SIGNALS.includes(row.name)) };
      let stats = new Map(briefing2.geographies.map((row) => [row.name, row]));
      groups = noveltyGroups(briefing2.items, applicationGeography(data.applicationScope, data.selection?.segment)).map((group) => ({ ...group, ...stats.get(group.name) })), groups.some((row) => row.name === active) || (active = browserCountry(groups.map((row) => row.name)) || groups[0]?.name || ""), paint2();
    } };
  }

  // src/client/features/trend-chart.js
  function trendChart({ buckets, series }, availableWidth = 900) {
    if (!buckets.length) return '<div class="chart-empty"><span class="empty-orbit" aria-hidden="true">\u25CE</span><p>La evoluci\xF3n aparecer\xE1 cuando haya publicaciones en esta selecci\xF3n.</p></div>';
    let width = Math.max(320, Math.min(900, availableWidth || 900)), height = 260, left = 38, right = 20, top = 24, bottom = 42, max = Math.max(1, ...series.flatMap((row) => row.values)), ceiling = Math.max(4, Math.ceil(max / 4) * 4), x = (index) => left + (buckets.length === 1 ? 0.5 : index / (buckets.length - 1)) * (width - left - right), y = (value) => height - bottom - value / ceiling * (height - top - bottom), ticks = Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => {
      let value = ceiling * i / 4;
      return `<line x1="${left}" x2="${width - right}" y1="${y(value)}" y2="${y(value)}" class="chart-grid"/><text x="${left - 12}" y="${y(value) + 4}" text-anchor="end">${value}</text>`;
    }).join(""), labels = [.../* @__PURE__ */ new Set([0, Math.floor((buckets.length - 1) / 2), buckets.length - 1])].map((i) => `<text x="${x(i)}" y="${height - 12}" text-anchor="${i === 0 ? "start" : i === buckets.length - 1 ? "end" : "middle"}">${formatTrendDay(buckets[i], language)}</text>`).join(""), lines = series.map((row, i) => {
      let points = row.values.map((value, index) => [x(index), y(value)]), path = points.map(([px, py], index) => (index ? "L" : "M") + px.toFixed(1) + "," + py.toFixed(1)).join(" "), color = "var(--chart-series-" + (i + 1) + ")", area = series.length === 1 ? `<path d="${path} L${x(buckets.length - 1)},${y(0)} L${x(0)},${y(0)} Z" class="chart-area"/>` : "";
      return `<g data-series="${i}">` + area + `<path d="${path}" stroke="${color}" class="chart-line"></path>` + points.map(([px, py], j) => `<circle class="chart-point" data-point="${j}" aria-label="${escape2(row.entity)} \xB7 ${buckets[j]} \xB7 ${row.values[j]} publicaciones" cx="${px}" cy="${py}" r="4" fill="${color}"></circle>`).join("") + "</g>";
    }).join(""), bands = buckets.map((day2, index) => {
      let start = index ? (x(index - 1) + x(index)) / 2 : left, end = index < buckets.length - 1 ? (x(index) + x(index + 1)) / 2 : width - right, label = day2 + " \xB7 " + series.map((row) => row.entity + ": " + row.values[index] + " publicaciones").join(" \xB7 ");
      return `<rect class="chart-band" data-bucket="${index}" tabindex="0" aria-label="${escape2(label)}" x="${start}" y="${top}" width="${end - start}" height="${height - top - bottom}"/>`;
    }).join(""), legend = series.map((row, i) => `<span><i style="background:var(--chart-series-${i + 1})"></i>${escape2(row.entity)}<strong>${row.total}</strong></span>`).join("");
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="group" aria-label="Evoluci\xF3n del n\xFAmero de publicaciones por entidad">${ticks}${labels}${bands}${lines}</svg><div class="chart-legend">${legend}</div>`;
  }

  // src/client/features/radar.js
  function createRadar({ onCountry, onEntity, onSource, onOutage }) {
    let outageSelection = {};
    $("radar-outage").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      let button = event.target.closest("[data-outage-explore]");
      button && onOutage({ ...outageSelection, ...button.dataset.entity ? { entity: button.dataset.entity } : {}, ...button.dataset.country ? { country: button.dataset.country } : {}, ...button.dataset.vector ? { palanca: button.dataset.vector } : {} });
    });
    let signature = "", geographySignature = "", trend, chartWidth = 0;
    function renderTrend(width) {
      !trend || !width || (chartWidth = width, $("trend-chart").innerHTML = trendChart(trend, width));
    }
    new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      let width = entries[0].contentRect.width;
      width && Math.abs(width - chartWidth) > 1 && renderTrend(width);
    }).observe($("trend-chart")), $("map-panel").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      let target = event.target.closest("[data-country]");
      target && target.dataset.count !== "0" && onCountry(target.dataset.country);
    }), $("world-map").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      if (["Enter", " "].includes(event.key)) {
        let target = event.target.closest("[data-country]");
        target && target.dataset.count !== "0" && (event.preventDefault(), onCountry(target.dataset.country));
      }
    }), $("entity-ranking").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      let target = event.target.closest("[data-entity]");
      target && onEntity(target.dataset.entity);
    }), $("publisher-chart").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      let button = event.target.closest("[data-source]");
      button && onSource(button.dataset.source);
    });
    function highlightCountry(event) {
      let target = event.target.closest("[data-country]"), country = target?.dataset.count !== "0" ? target?.dataset.country : null;
      $("map-panel").querySelectorAll("[data-country]").forEach((node) => node.classList.toggle("is-highlighted", !!(country && node.dataset.country === country)));
    }
    for (let name of ["pointerover", "focusin"]) $("map-panel").addEventListener(name, highlightCountry);
    for (let name of ["pointerout", "focusout"]) $("map-panel").addEventListener(name, (event) => {
      !event.relatedTarget || !$("map-panel").contains(event.relatedTarget) ? highlightCountry({ target: $("map-panel") }) : highlightCountry({ target: event.relatedTarget });
    });
    let tooltip = $("trend-tooltip");
    function highlightPoint(event) {
      let point = event.target.closest("[data-point],[data-bucket]"), index = point?.dataset.point ?? point?.dataset.bucket, band = index != null ? $("trend-chart").querySelector('[data-bucket="' + index + '"]') : null;
      if ($("trend-chart").querySelectorAll(".chart-band.is-highlighted").forEach((node) => node.classList.remove("is-highlighted")), band && band.classList.add("is-highlighted"), tooltip.hidden = !band, band) {
        tooltip.textContent = band.getAttribute("aria-label");
        let panel2 = tooltip.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect(), anchor = point.getBoundingClientRect(), x = event.clientX || anchor.x + anchor.width / 2, y = event.clientY || anchor.y;
        tooltip.style.left = Math.max(0, Math.min(x - panel2.x + 12, panel2.width - tooltip.offsetWidth)) + "px", tooltip.style.top = Math.max(0, Math.min(y - panel2.y + 16, panel2.height - tooltip.offsetHeight)) + "px";
      }
    }

  // src/client/features/activity-chart.js
  function activityChart(days) {
    if (!days.length) return '<div class="note">No hay actividad diaria registrada en este per\xEDodo.</div>';
    let maximum = Math.max(1, ...days.map((day2) => day2.users));
    return `<div class="activity-chart" role="img" aria-label="Usuarios activos por d\xEDa">${days.map((day2) => `<div class="activity-column" title="${escape2(day2.date)}: ${day2.users} usuarios"><span>${day2.users}</span><div class="activity-bar" style="--bar-height:calc(var(--activity-chart-height) * ${day2.users / maximum})"></div><span>${escape2(day2.date.slice(5))}</span></div>`).join("")}</div>`;
  }

  // src/client/features/administration.js
  function createAdministration({ isAdmin, track: track2, onConfiguration, onSubscribers, onLanguage, onLeaveLanguage, onRuns, onLeaveRuns, onLeaveSubscribers, onTaxonomy, onLeaveTaxonomy, onLlm, onLeaveLlm }) {
    let current = Object.keys(config_default.adminViews)[0];
    async function open(view = Object.keys(config_default.adminViews)[0]) {
      if (!(!isAdmin() || !(view in config_default.adminViews))) {
        current === "language" && view !== current && onLeaveLanguage(), current === "runs" && view !== current && onLeaveRuns(), current === "subscribers" && view !== current && onLeaveSubscribers(), current === "taxonomy" && view !== current && onLeaveTaxonomy(), current === "llm" && view !== current && onLeaveLlm(), current = view, track2("vista");
        for (let name of Object.keys(config_default.adminViews)) $(name + "-section").hidden = name !== view;
        if ($("admin-tabs").querySelectorAll("[data-admin-view]").forEach((button) => {
          button.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(button.dataset.adminView === view)), button.tabIndex = button.dataset.adminView === view ? 0 : -1;
        }), view === "subscribers" && await onSubscribers(), view === "configuration") try {
          await onConfiguration();
        } catch (error) {
          message(error.message || String(error), !0);
        }
        view === "llm" && await onLlm(), view === "taxonomy" && await onTaxonomy(), view === "language" && await onLanguage(), view === "runs" && await onRuns(), view === "audit" && await loadAudit(), (view === "telemetry" || view === "adoption" || view === "feedback") && await loadMetrics(view, () => current === view && !$("administration-section").hidden);
      }
    }
    return $("admin-tabs").addEventListener("click", (event) => {
      let button = event.target.closest("[data-admin-view]");
      button && button.dataset.adminView !== current && open(button.dataset.adminView).catch((error) => message(error.message, !0));
    }), $("admin-tabs").addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
      let views = Object.keys(config_default.adminViews), index = views.indexOf(current);
      if (!["ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight", "ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "Home", "End"].includes(event.key)) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      let next = event.key === "Home" ? 0 : event.key === "End" ? views.length - 1 : (index + (["ArrowRight", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key) ? 1 : -1) + views.length) % views.length;
      views[next] !== current && open(views[next]).catch((error) => message(error.message, !0)), $("admin-tabs").querySelector('[data-admin-view="' + views[next] + '"]').focus();
    }), { open, get current() {
      return current;
    } };
  }

  // src/client/features/taxonomy-controls.js
  function syncTaxonomyControls(form, paths, changed) {
    let parent = form.elements.palanca, child = form.elements.subpalanca;
    if (!parent || !child) return;
    let subpalanca = child.value;
    changed === "palanca" && subpalanca && (subpalanca = taxonomyChoices(paths, { palanca: parent.value }).subpalanca.find((value) => taxonomySubLabel(value) === taxonomySubLabel(subpalanca)) || ""), changed === "subpalanca" && parent.value && !taxonomyChoices(paths, { subpalanca: child.value }).palanca.includes(parent.value) && (parent.value = "");
    let choices = taxonomyChoices(paths, { palanca: parent.value, subpalanca });
    for (let [name, values] of Object.entries(choices)) {
      let label = (value) => taxonomyDisplayLabel(t(name === "subpalanca" ? taxonomySubLabel(value) : value));
      values.sort((a, b) => label(a).localeCompare(label(b), language));
      let input2 = form.elements[name], current = name === "subpalanca" ? subpalanca : input2.value, signature = JSON.stringify([language, values]);
      input2.dataset.options !== signature && (input2.dataset.options = signature, input2.innerHTML = '<option value="">' + t("Todos") + "</option>" + values.map((value) => '<option data-catalog-name="' + escape2(name === "subpalanca" ? taxonomySubLabel(value) : value) + '" value="' + escape2(value) + '">' + escape2(label(value)) + "</option>").join("")), input2.value = values.includes(current) ? current : "";
    }
  }

  // src/client/features/filters.js
  function createFilters({ onInvalidate, onChange }) {

  // src/shared/news-groups.js
  function newsEntityGroups(items) {
    let entities = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    for (let row of items) {
      let name = row.entidad || "Entidad no identificada";
      entities.has(name) || entities.set(name, { name, total: 0, items: [] });
      let group = entities.get(name);
      group.total++, group.items.push(row);
    }
    return [...entities.values()].sort(entityOrder);
  }

  // src/client/features/sources.js
  function createSources({ getData, run }) {

    function sourceFields(feeds) {

    }), $("save-source-settings").addEventListener("click", () => run(async () => message(await call("saveSourceSettings", catalog.selected())))), { render(data) {

  // src/client/features/usage.js
  function createUsage({ getView, isReady, getAttribution }) {
    let session = crypto.randomUUID(), events = [];
    function track2(event, duration = 0, performance2) {
      events.push({ event, view: getView(), session, duration, ...getAttribution() ? { id: crypto.randomUUID(), edition: getAttribution() } : {}, ...performance2 ? { performance: performance2 } : {} }), events.length > 20 && events.shift();
    }
    async function flush2() {
      if (!events.length || !isReady()) return;
      let batch = events.splice(0, 20);
      try {
        (await call("recordEvents", batch)).saved || events.unshift(...batch);
      } catch {
        events.unshift(...batch);
      }
      events.length > 20 && events.splice(0, events.length - 20);
    }
    return setInterval(flush2, 3e4), { track: track2, flush: flush2 };
  }

  // src/client/core/localization.js
  var observer, translateChanges;
  function flushLocalization() {
    observer && translateChanges(observer.takeRecords());
  }
  var originals = /* @__PURE__ */ new WeakMap();
  function localized(node, key, value) {
    let values = originals.get(node);
    values || (values = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map(), originals.set(node, values));
    let previous = values.get(key), source = previous?.output === value ? previous.source : translateText(value, "es", language), output = t(source);
    return values.set(key, { source, output }), output;
  }
  var attributes = ["placeholder", "title", "aria-label", "alt"], excluded = "[data-original],script,style,textarea";
  function localize(root) {
    if (root.nodeType === 3) {
      if (!root.parentElement?.closest(excluded)) {
        let output = localized(root, "text", root.textContent);
        output !== root.textContent && (root.textContent = output);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (root.nodeType === 1) {
      if (root.dataset.catalogName) {
        root.textContent = taxonomyDisplayLabel(t(root.dataset.catalogName));
        return;
      }
      if (!root.matches(excluded)) {
        if (root.tagName === "TABLE" && root.closest(".table-wrap") && root.setAttribute("role", "table"), root.tagName === "TR" && root.closest(".table-wrap") && root.parentElement.tagName === "TBODY") {
          let headings = root.closest("table").tHead?.rows[0]?.cells;
          for (let [index, cell] of [...root.cells].entries()) cell.colSpan === 1 && headings?.[index] && (cell.dataset.label = t(headings[index].textContent));
        }
        root.tagName === "OPTION" && !root.hasAttribute("value") && root.setAttribute("value", root.value);
        for (let key of attributes) if (root.hasAttribute(key)) {
          let value = root.getAttribute(key), translated = localized(root, key, value);

function collectionStatus_(tasks,jobs){
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache();if(!tasks&&!jobs){const cached=cache.get('collection-status');if(cached){const status=JSON.parse(cached);progressContext_(status.jobs);return status;}}
  jobs=jobs||collectionJobs_();if(tasks)collectionSnapshots_(tasks,jobs);
  const requests=collectionRequests_().filter(request=>!jobs.some(job=>job.id===request.id));
  const ordered=jobs.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.inicio.localeCompare(a.inicio)),active=ordered.filter(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando'),selected=active.length?active:ordered.slice(0,1);
  const status={blocked:recoveryAvailability(jobs,requests),total:0,processed:0,pending:0,skipped:0,failed:0,added:0,lastActivity:'',queued:requests.length,jobs:[]};
  for(const job of selected){
    for(const [key,column] of [['total','total'],['processed','procesadas'],['pending','pendientes'],['skipped','omitidas'],['failed','fallidas'],['added','nuevas']])status[key]+=Number(job[column]||0);
    if(job.actualizada>status.lastActivity)status.lastActivity=job.actualizada;
  }
  const fetchPause=Number(properties_().getProperty('FETCH_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0);
  status.jobs=recoveryProgressJobs(jobs.map(({row,...job})=>job).concat(requests.map(request=>({id:request.id,tipo:request.kind,desde:request.range.from,hasta:request.range.to,inicio:request.created,estado:'En cola',total:0,procesadas:0,pendientes:0,omitidas:0,fallidas:0,nuevas:0})))).map(job=>{const pause=Math.max(Number(job.pausa||0),fetchPause),stage=job.tipo==='daily'?'daily':'annual';return {...job,progress:jobProgressState_(stage,{state:job.estado,updated:job.actualizada},{jobs,queued:job.estado==='En cola',pausedUntil:pause})};});
  status.progress=(status.jobs.find(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando')||status.jobs[0])?.progress;
  cacheJson_('collection-status',status,15);return status;
}

function collectNow(mode='today'){
  authorize_(true);const now=new Date(),range=collectionRange_(mode,now),blocked=recoveryAvailability(collectionJobs_(),collectionRequests_());

  return {...collectionStatus_(),added:0,errors:[],notice:mode==='year'?'Recuperación anual en cola.':'Recuperación diaria en cola.'};
}

      try{

function retryCollectionErrors() {
  authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
    const tasks=rows_('Recopilacion');let count=0;
    const values=tasks.map(task=>{if(task.estado==='Error'){task.estado='Pendiente';task.intentos=0;task.error='';count++;}return [task.estado,task.intentos,task.actualizada,task.evaluadas,task.nuevas,task.error];});
    if(count){book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion').getRange(2,4,values.length,6).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(values.map(row=>row.map(safeCell_)));ensureBackgroundWorker_();}
    const jobs=collectionJobs_();for(const job of jobs)job.pausa='';collectionSnapshots_(tasks,jobs);for(const job of jobs)writeCollectionJob_(job);
    CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('collection-status');
    return count+' fuentes preparadas para reintentar.';
  });
}

function writeCollectionTasks_(pending,updates){
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion');let start=0;
  for(let end=1;end<=pending.length;end++){
    if(end<pending.length&&pending[end].row===pending[end-1].row+1)continue;
    const group=pending.slice(start,end);sheet.getRange(group[0].row,4,group.length,6).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(group.map(task=>updates.get(task.row).map(safeCell_)));start=end;
  }
}

function collectionWork_(started){
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion'),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1,keys=RADAR.sheets.Recopilacion.slice(3),jobs=collectionJobs_(),jobIndex=new Map(jobs.map(job=>[job.id,job]));
  const cycles=count>0?sheet.getRange(2,1,count,1).getDisplayValues():[];
  const active=new Set(jobs.filter(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando').map(job=>job.id)),positions=cycles.flatMap(([id],index)=>active.has(id)?[{id,row:index+2}]:[]),tasks=[];
  for(let start=0,end=1;end<=positions.length;end++){
    if(end<positions.length&&positions[end].row===positions[end-1].row+1)continue;
    const group=positions.slice(start,end);if(!group.length)break;
    sheet.getRange(group[0].row,4,group.length,7).getDisplayValues().forEach((values,index)=>tasks.push({...Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,i)=>[key,values[i]])),ciclo:group[index].id,row:group[index].row}));start=end;
  }
  const retryMs=settings_().retryMinutes*60000,batch=settings_().collectionBatch,fetchPausedUntil=Number(properties_().getProperty('FETCH_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0);
  const eligible=tasks.filter(task=>jobIndex.has(task.ciclo)&&Math.max(Number(jobIndex.get(task.ciclo).pausa||0),fetchPausedUntil)<=started&&(task.estado==='Pendiente'||(task.estado==='Reintento programado'&&started-Date.parse(task.actualizada)>=retryMs)))
    .sort((a,b)=>a.prioridad===b.prioridad?a.row-b.row:a.prioridad>b.prioridad?-1:1);
  const selected=eligible.find(task=>jobIndex.get(task.ciclo).tipo==='daily')||eligible[0],size=selected&&jobIndex.get(selected.ciclo).tipo==='annual'?Math.min(20,batch*4):batch;
  const pending=selected?eligible.filter(task=>task.ciclo===selected.ciclo).slice(0,size).sort((a,b)=>a.row-b.row):[];
  let start=0;
  for(let end=1;end<=pending.length;end++){
    if(end<pending.length&&pending[end].row===pending[end-1].row+1)continue;
    const group=pending.slice(start,end),sources=sheet.getRange(group[0].row,2,group.length,2).getDisplayValues();
    group.forEach((task,index)=>Object.assign(task,{fuente:sources[index][0],url:sources[index][1]}));start=end;
  }
  return {tasks,pending,jobs};
}

let configurationMemory_,configurationVersionMemory_;
function settings_(){return configuration_().settings;}
function configuration_(){
  if(configurationMemory_)return configurationMemory_;
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key='configuration:'+(configurationVersionMemory_=String(properties_().getProperty('CONFIG_REVISION')||'0')),cached=cache.get(key);
  if(cached)return configurationMemory_=functionalConfiguration_(JSON.parse(cached));
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Configuracion');
  if(!sheet)throw Error('Inicializa la configuración desde el editor: initializeConfiguration.');
  const count=sheet.getLastRow()-1,config=Object.fromEntries(count?sheet.getRange(2,1,count,2).getValues().map(([key,value])=>[key,JSON.parse(value)]):[]);
  const resolved=functionalConfiguration_(config);validateConfiguration_(resolved);cacheJson_(key,functionalConfigurationSettings_(resolved),21600);
  return configurationMemory_=resolved;
}
function invalidateConfiguration_(){invalidateDashboardSnapshots_();configurationMemory_=undefined;configurationVersionMemory_=undefined;properties_().setProperty('CONFIG_REVISION',Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));}
function configurationEdited_(event){const editedSheet=event?.range?.getSheet().getName();if(NEWSLETTER_ARCHIVE_TABLES.some(name=>editedSheet===newsletterStorageKey_(name))){markNewsletterArchiveEdited_();return;}const sheet=editedSheet===newsStorageKey_()?'Noticias':editedSheet;if(backgroundPaused_()&&['Configuracion','Noticias'].includes(sheet)){deferBackgroundWork_(sheet==='Configuracion'?'edited':'news');return;}if(sheet==='CatalogoFuncional'){properties_().deleteProperty('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_REVISION');functionalCatalogMemory_=undefined;invalidateConfiguration_();properties_().setProperty('TAXONOMY_REQUEST',recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone));ensureBackgroundWorker_();}else if(sheet==='Configuracion'){invalidateConfiguration_();requestNewsClassification_(true);}else if(sheet==='Noticias')invalidateNews_();else if(sheet==='Ejecuciones')CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('dashboard-runs:'+RADAR.version);}
function addVocabularyTerms_(config){
  let changed=false;
  for(const [key,rows] of [['relevanceRules',config.relevanceRules],['capabilities',config.capabilities.Empresas],['searchLanguages',config.searchLanguages]])for(const addition of CONFIGURATION_VOCABULARY_UPDATE[key]){
    const row=rows.find(item=>item.name===addition.name);if(!row)continue;
    const removed=new Set((addition.remove||[]).map(searchText_)),terms=[...new Set([...row.terms.filter(term=>!removed.has(searchText_(term))),...addition.terms])];if(JSON.stringify(terms)!==JSON.stringify(row.terms)){row.terms=terms;changed=true;}
  }
  for(const addition of CONFIGURATION_VOCABULARY_UPDATE.taxonomy||[]){
    const row=config.taxonomy.flatMap(block=>block.functions).find(row=>row.id===addition.id);if(!row)continue;
    const removed=new Set(addition.remove.map(searchText_)),terms=[...new Set([...row.terms.filter(term=>!removed.has(searchText_(term))),...addition.terms])];if(JSON.stringify(terms)!==JSON.stringify(row.terms)){row.terms=terms;changed=true;}
  }
  return changed;
}
function updateVocabulary_(sheet){
  if(properties_().getProperty('VOCABULARY_VERSION')===CONFIGURATION_VOCABULARY_UPDATE.version)return false;
  const values=sheet.getRange(2,1,sheet.getLastRow()-1,2).getValues(),config=Object.fromEntries(values.map(([key,value])=>[key,JSON.parse(value)])),changed=addVocabularyTerms_(config);
  if(changed)for(const key of ['relevanceRules','capabilities','searchLanguages','taxonomy'])sheet.getRange(values.findIndex(row=>row[0]===key)+2,2,1,1).setValues([[JSON.stringify(config[key])]]);
  properties_().setProperty('VOCABULARY_VERSION',CONFIGURATION_VOCABULARY_UPDATE.version);return changed;
}
function initializeConfiguration(){
  authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
    const refreshCatalog=properties_().getProperty('CATALOG_VERSION')!==CONFIGURATION_CATALOG_VERSION;
    for(const name of ['CategorizacionLLM','Candidatos','Cobertura','Configuracion','Suscripciones','NewsletterEnvios','NewsletterEdiciones','NewsletterContenido','NewsletterEventos','NewsletterFeedback','Noticias','Recopilacion','Recargas','Traducciones','CatalogoFuncional','Taxonomia','TaxonomiaTraducciones','Auditoria','Telemetria','Ejecuciones','Adopcion','DashboardSnapshots']){
      const physical=configurationStorageKey_(name);
      if(book_().getSheetByName(physical)){if(name!=='Configuracion')book_().getSheetByName(physical).getRange(1,1,1,RADAR.sheets[name].length).setValues([RADAR.sheets[name]]);continue;}
      const sheet=book_().insertSheet(physical);sheet.getRange(1,1,1,RADAR.sheets[name].length).setValues([RADAR.sheets[name]]).setFontWeight('bold').setBackground(SHEET_THEME.background).setFontColor(SHEET_THEME.foreground);sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
    }
    const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Configuracion'),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1,keys=new Set(count?sheet.getRange(2,1,count,1).getValues().flat():[]);
    // Add only absent defaults when the catalog version changes; preserve existing edits and activations.
    if(refreshCatalog){
      const data=count?sheet.getRange(2,1,count,2).getValues():[];
      for(const key of ['geographies','segments','signals','feeds','entities','capabilities','applicationScope']){
        const index=data.findIndex(row=>row[0]===key);if(index<0)continue;
        const value=JSON.parse(data[index][1]),defaults=CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS[key];
        if(key==='capabilities'){
          for(const segment of Object.keys(value))if(!Object.hasOwn(defaults,segment))delete value[segment];
          for(const segment of Object.keys(defaults)){
            const names=new Set(value[segment].map(row=>searchText_(row.name)));
            value[segment].push(...defaults[segment].filter(row=>!names.has(searchText_(row.name))).slice(0,Math.max(0,60-value[segment].length)));
          }
        }else{
          if(['segments','applicationScope'].includes(key))value.splice(0,value.length,...value.filter(row=>row.name===sectorNewsDefaults.segment));
          if(key==='applicationScope')for(const row of value){row.countries=[...new Set([...row.countries,...(defaults.find(seed=>seed.name===row.name)?.countries||[])])];}
          if(key==='signals')value.splice(0,value.length,...canonicalSignalRules_(value,defaults));
          const names=new Set(value.map(row=>key==='feeds'?canonicalUrl_(row.url):searchText_(row.name))),ids=new Set(value.map(row=>row.id));
          if(key==='geographies')for(const row of value){const seed=defaults.find(item=>item.code===row.code);if(seed)row.terms=[...new Set([...(row.terms||[]),...seed.terms])];}
          if(key==='segments')for(const row of value){const seed=defaults.find(item=>item.name===row.name);if(seed)row.terms=[...new Set([...row.terms,...seed.terms])];}
          if(key==='entities')for(const row of value){const seed=defaults.find(item=>searchText_(item.name)===searchText_(row.name));if(seed){row.countries=[...new Set([...row.countries,...seed.countries])];row.aliases=[...new Set([...row.aliases,...seed.aliases])];}}
          value.push(...defaults.filter(row=>!names.has(key==='feeds'?canonicalUrl_(row.url):searchText_(row.name))&&(key!=='feeds'||!ids.has(row.id))));
        }
        sheet.getRange(index+2,2,1,1).setValues([[JSON.stringify(value)]]);
      }
    }
    if(keys.has('taxonomy')){
      const rows=sheet.getRange(2,1,sheet.getLastRow()-1,2).getValues(),index=rows.findIndex(row=>row[0]==='taxonomy'),blocks=JSON.parse(rows[index][1]),defaults=new Map(CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS.taxonomy.flatMap(block=>block.functions.map(row=>[row.id,row])));
      if(book_().getSheetByName('CatalogoFuncional').getLastRow()<2&&blocks.every(block=>block.functions.every(row=>typeof row.name==='string')))writeFunctionalCatalog_(blocks);
      if(refreshCatalog)for(const block of blocks){
        const seed=CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS.taxonomy.find(row=>row.name===block.name);
        if(seed)block.terms=[...new Set([...(block.terms||[]),...(seed.terms||[])])];
        for(const concept of seed?.emerging||[]){const previous=block.emerging.find(row=>row.name===concept.name||concept.primaryTerms?.includes(taxonomyText(row.name)));if(previous)Object.assign(previous,concept,{terms:[...new Set([...previous.terms,...concept.terms])]});else block.emerging.push(concept);}
        for(const row of block.functions){const next=defaults.get(row.id);if(next){row.terms=next.name.startsWith('Landing')?next.terms:[...new Set([...row.terms,...next.terms])];for(const key of ['context','exclude'])if(next[key]?.length)row[key]=next[key];}}
      }
      sheet.getRange(index+2,2,1,1).setValues([[JSON.stringify(functionalRuleSettings(blocks))]]);
    }
    append_('Configuracion',Object.entries(functionalConfigurationSettings_(CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS)).filter(([key])=>!keys.has(key)).map(([key,value])=>[key,JSON.stringify(value)]));
    const settingsRow=sheet.getRange(2,1,sheet.getLastRow()-1,2).getValues().findIndex(row=>row[0]==='settings')+2,stored=JSON.parse(sheet.getRange(settingsRow,2,1,1).getValues()[0][0]);
    const settings=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS.settings).map(([key,value])=>[key,key in stored?stored[key]:value]));
    settings.newsletterEnabled=true;
    if(refreshCatalog)settings.searchTerms=[...new Set([...settings.searchTerms,...CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS.settings.searchTerms])];
    sheet.getRange(settingsRow,2,1,1).setValues([[JSON.stringify(settings)]]);
    if(!ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().some(trigger=>trigger.getHandlerFunction()==='configurationEdited_'))ScriptApp.newTrigger('configurationEdited_').forSpreadsheet(book_()).onEdit().create();
    const subscriptions=book_().getSheetByName('Suscripciones'),countSubscriptions=subscriptions.getLastRow()-1;
    if(countSubscriptions>0){const range=subscriptions.getRange(2,8,countSubscriptions,1);range.setValues(range.getValues().map(([value])=>[value||'es']));}
    const vocabularyChanged=updateVocabulary_(sheet);invalidateConfiguration_();
    if(refreshCatalog){upgradeCollectionQueries_();if(translationJob_())requestTranslations_(true);properties_().setProperty('CATALOG_VERSION',CONFIGURATION_CATALOG_VERSION);}
    requestNewsClassification_(vocabularyChanged);
    if(refreshCatalog&&newsSheet_().getLastRow()>1)requestTaxonomy_();
    initializeCollectionQueue_();
    if(refreshCatalog&&(newsSheet_().getLastRow()>1||book_().getSheetByName('Telemetria')?.getLastRow()>1))maintenance_();
    initializeBackgroundSchedules_();
    const removed=pruneNewsGenerations_();
    telemetry_('initializeConfiguration',0,'OK','Pestañas obsoletas eliminadas: '+(removed.join(', ')||'ninguna'));
    return 'Configuración inicializada. Pestañas obsoletas eliminadas: '+(removed.join(', ')||'ninguna')+'.';
  });
}
function validateConfiguration_(config){
  const numeric={windowDays:[1,90],pageSize:[1,100],maxCustomFeeds:[1,100],maxFeedBytes:[10000,2000000],maxItems:[1,1000],exportLimit:[1,10000],eventLimit:[100,20000],retentionDays:[1,90],trendPoints:[2,60],trendSeries:[1,6],collectionBatch:[1,5],retryMinutes:[1,60],pauseMinutes:[1,60],dailyHour:[0,23],briefingLimit:[1,100],newsletterBatch:[1,100],newsletterDailyLimit:[1,1500]};
  if(!config||typeof config.settings!=='object')throw Error('Falta configuración operativa.');
  for(const [name,[min,max]] of Object.entries(numeric)){const n=config.settings[name];if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<min||n>max)throw Error(name+': requiere un entero entre '+min+' y '+max+'.');}
  if(typeof config.settings.newsletterEnabled!=='boolean')throw Error('Configuración de newsletter no válida.');
  newsletterEmail_(config.settings.newsletterSender);
  if(typeof config.settings.newsletterAppUrl!=='string'||(config.settings.newsletterAppUrl&&!/^https:\/\/script\.google\.com\/(?:a\/macros\/bbva\.com\/|macros\/)s\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\/exec$/.test(config.settings.newsletterAppUrl)))throw Error('URL de newsletter no válida: indica la WebApp publicada en Apps Script.');
  if(typeof config.settings.newsletterSenderName!=='string'||!config.settings.newsletterSenderName.trim()||config.settings.newsletterSenderName.length>100||/[\r\n]/.test(config.settings.newsletterSenderName))throw Error('Nombre del remitente no válido.');
  try{new Intl.DateTimeFormat('es',{timeZone:config.settings.timezone});}catch(_){throw Error('Zona horaria no válida.');}
  for(const key of ['entities','geographies','segments','signals','feeds','searchLanguages','relevanceRules']){
    const list=config[key];if(!Array.isArray(list)||list.length>200)throw Error('Catálogo no válido: '+key);
    const names=new Set();
    for(const row of list){
      if(!row||typeof row.name!=='string'||!row.name.trim()||row.name.length>100||names.has(row.name)||typeof row.enabled!=='boolean')throw Error('Nombre duplicado, vacío o activación no válida: '+key);
      names.add(row.name);
      for(const field of ['terms','context','aliases','countries','exclude'])if(field in row&&(!Array.isArray(row[field])||row[field].length>(key==='searchLanguages'?160:80)||row[field].some(value=>typeof value!=='string'||!value.trim()||value.length>100)))throw Error('Lista de términos no válida: '+row.name);
      if(['segments','signals'].includes(key)&&!row.terms?.length)throw Error('Añade términos a '+row.name);
      if(key==='signals'&&(!Array.isArray(row.context)||!Array.isArray(row.exclude)||!['headline','fullText'].includes(row.scope)))throw Error('Define el contexto de '+row.name+' (puede estar vacío).');
      if(key==='signals'&&!['Novedad','Problema'].includes(row.group))throw Error('Define el tipo de señal: '+row.name);
      if(key==='entities'&&(!row.type||!Array.isArray(row.aliases)||!Array.isArray(row.countries)))throw Error('Entidad incompleta: '+row.name);
      if(key==='geographies'&&(!row.searchName||!/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(row.code)||!/^\d{3}$/.test(row.mapId)||!/^[a-z]{2}(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})?$/.test(row.language)))throw Error('País: código ISO, identificador cartográfico o idioma incorrectos.');
      if(key==='feeds'&&row.language&&feedLanguage(row.language)!==row.language)throw Error('Idioma de fuente no válido.');
      if(key==='feeds'&&(!row.id||!canonicalUrl_(row.url)||!domainMatches_(row.url,row.domain)||!/^[a-z0-9-]+(?:\.[a-z0-9-]+)+$/.test(row.domain)||!row.entity))throw Error('Fuente RSS no válida: '+row.name);
    }
    if(JSON.stringify(list).length>40000)throw Error('El catálogo excede el tamaño de una celda: '+key);
  }
  if(config.segments.length!==1||config.segments[0].name!==sectorNewsDefaults.segment||!config.segments[0].enabled)throw Error('El ámbito de contenido es Empresas e instituciones.');
  validateCapabilities_(config.capabilities);
  validateTaxonomy_(config.taxonomy);
  if(typeof config.settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl!=='string'||(config.settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl&&!/^https:\/\/docs\.google\.com\/spreadsheets\/d\/[\w-]+(?:\/edit(?:[?#].*)?)?$/.test(config.settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl)))throw Error('Fuente del catálogo funcional no válida.');
  for(const row of config.relevanceRules)if(!RELEVANCE_ROLES.includes(row.role)||!row.terms.length||Object.keys(row).sort().join(',')!=='enabled,name,role,terms'||row.terms.some(term=>/[\\^$+?(){}[\]|]/.test(term)||term.includes('**')||term.split(' ').some(word=>word.includes('*')&&word.indexOf('*')!==word.length-1)))throw Error('Criterio de relevancia no válido.');
  const languages=new Set();for(const row of config.searchLanguages){if(!/^[a-z]{2}$/.test(row.language)||languages.has(row.language)||!row.terms.length||row.terms.length>160||Object.keys(row).sort().join(',')!=='enabled,language,name,terms')throw Error('Perfil de búsqueda no válido.');languages.add(row.language);}
  if(Object.keys(config).sort().join(',')!=='applicationScope,capabilities,entities,feeds,geographies,relevanceRules,searchLanguages,segments,settings,signals,taxonomy')throw Error('Claves de configuración no reconocidas.');
  for(const key of ['searchTerms','disabledSources'])if(!Array.isArray(config.settings[key])||config.settings[key].length>1000||config.settings[key].some(value=>typeof value!=='string'||value.length>160))throw Error('Lista operativa no válida: '+key);
  if(!config.settings.searchTerms.length||config.settings.searchTerms.length>80)throw Error('Define entre 1 y 80 términos de búsqueda.');
  if(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(functionalConfigurationSettings_(config))).replace(/%[A-F\d]{2}/gi,'x').length>90000)throw Error('Configuración demasiado grande para la caché.');
  const countries=new Set(config.geographies.map(row=>row.name)),aliases=new Set();
  const scopes=config.applicationScope,scopeNames=applicationScopeSegments;
  if(!Array.isArray(scopes)||scopes.length!==scopeNames.length||new Set(scopes.map(row=>row?.name)).size!==scopeNames.length||scopes.some(row=>!row||!scopeNames.includes(row.name)||Object.keys(row).sort().join(',')!=='countries,name'||!Array.isArray(row.countries)||row.countries.some(country=>!countries.has(country))||new Set(row.countries).size!==row.countries.length))throw Error('Ámbito de aplicación no válido.');
  for(const row of config.entities){
    if(row.countries.some(country=>!countries.has(country)))throw Error('País desconocido en '+row.name);
    for(const name of [row.name,...row.aliases]){const key=searchText_(name);if(aliases.has(key))throw Error('Alias compartido por varias entidades: '+name);aliases.add(key);}
  }
  if(new Set(config.geographies.map(row=>row.code)).size!==config.geographies.length||new Set(config.geographies.map(row=>row.mapId)).size!==config.geographies.length)throw Error('Código de país duplicado.');
  if(typeof config.settings.unknownCountry!=='string'||!config.settings.unknownCountry.trim()||config.settings.unknownCountry.length>100)throw Error('Define la geografía predeterminada de los RSS.');
  if(new Set(config.feeds.map(row=>row.id)).size!==config.feeds.length||new Set(config.feeds.map(row=>canonicalUrl_(row.url))).size!==config.feeds.length)throw Error('Fuente RSS duplicada.');
  return config;
}
function configurationRevision_(){configuration_();return configurationVersionMemory_;}
function getConfiguration(){authorize_(true);return {config:configuration_(),revision:configurationRevision_(),capabilityDefaults:CONFIGURATION_DEFAULTS.capabilities};}
function saveConfiguration(payload){authorize_(true);return writeConfiguration_(payload.config,payload.revision);}
function writeConfiguration_(config,revision){
  validateConfiguration_(config);const canonical=functionalConfiguration_(config);if(JSON.stringify(config.taxonomy.map(block=>[block.name,block.functions.map(row=>[row.id,row.name])]))!==JSON.stringify(canonical.taxonomy.map(block=>[block.name,block.functions.map(row=>[row.id,row.name])])))throw Error('Los códigos y nombres oficiales se actualizan exclusivamente desde el catálogo maestro.');config=canonical;return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
    if(revision!==String(properties_().getProperty('CONFIG_REVISION')||'0'))throw Error('La configuración ha cambiado en otra sesión. Recarga los catálogos antes de guardar.');
    const reclassify=classificationRulesRevision_()!==classificationRulesRevision_(config);
    const taxonomyChanged=JSON.stringify(configuration_().taxonomy)!==JSON.stringify(config.taxonomy)||configuration_().settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl!==config.settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl;
    const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Configuracion'),rows=Object.entries(functionalConfigurationSettings_(config)).map(([key,value])=>[key,JSON.stringify(value)]);
    sheet.getRange(2,1,Math.max(rows.length,sheet.getLastRow()-1),2).clearContent();append_('Configuracion',rows);invalidateConfiguration_();if(reclassify)requestNewsClassification_(true);if(taxonomyChanged)requestTaxonomy_();initializeBackgroundSchedules_();
    return 'Configuración guardada. Se aplicará a filtros, clasificación y próximas recopilaciones.';
  });
}

function validateCapabilities_(capabilities){
  if(!capabilities||Object.keys(capabilities).join(',')!=='Empresas')throw Error('Define capacidades digitales para Empresas e instituciones.');
  for(const [segment,rows] of Object.entries(capabilities)){
    if(!Array.isArray(rows)||rows.length>60)throw Error('Máximo 60 capacidades por segmento: '+segment);
    const names=new Set();
    for(const row of rows){
      const name=searchText_(row?.name);
      if(!row||typeof row.name!=='string'||!name||row.name.length>100||names.has(name)||typeof row.enabled!=='boolean'||Object.keys(row).sort().join(',')!=='enabled,name,terms')throw Error('Capacidad vacía, duplicada o no válida: '+segment);
      names.add(name);
      if(!Array.isArray(row.terms)||!row.terms.length||row.terms.length>24||row.terms.some(term=>typeof term!=='string'||!term.trim()||term.length>80||/[";\r\n]/.test(term)))throw Error('Define entre 1 y 24 términos de hasta 80 caracteres: '+row.name);
    }
  }
  if(JSON.stringify(capabilities).length>40000)throw Error('El catálogo de capacidades excede el tamaño de una celda.');
}





function canonicalSignalRules_(rows,seeds){
 return seeds.map(seed=>{
  const saved=rows.find(row=>row.name===seed.name||seed.group==='Problema'&&row.group==='Problema');
  return {...saved,...seed,...Object.fromEntries(['terms','context','exclude'].map(key=>[key,[...new Map([...(saved?.[key]||[]),...(seed[key]||[])].map(term=>[searchText_(term),term])).values()]]))};
 });
}

function newsRecordsKey_(){return 'news-records:'+sha256_(JSON.stringify([RADAR.version,llmRevision_(),newsStorageKey_(),taxonomyStorageKey_(),configurationRevision_(),properties_().getProperty('NEWS_RECORDS_REVISION')||'0']));}
function newsRecordIndex_(){
  const key='news-records:index:'+newsStorageKey_()+':'+RADAR.version+':'+(properties_().getProperty('NEWS_CONTENT_REVISION')||'0'),cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),cached=readDashboardCache_(cache,key);if(cached)return cached;
  const sheet=newsSheet_(),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1,days=Object.create(null),entities=new Set(),sources=new Set();
  if(count>0)sheet.getRange(2,2,count,4).getDisplayValues().forEach(([date,,source,entity],index)=>{
    const position=index+2,ranges=days[date]||(days[date]=[]),last=ranges.at(-1);
    if(last&&last[1]===position-1)last[1]=position;else ranges.push([position,position]);
    if(entity)entities.add(entity);if(source)sources.add(source);
  });
  const value={days,entities:[...entities],sources:[...sources]};writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,value);return value;
}
function cachedNewsRecords_(query={}){
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key=newsRecordsKey_()+':'+sha256_(JSON.stringify([query.from||'',query.to||''])),raw=cache.get(key);
  if(raw){
    const manifest=JSON.parse(raw),keys=Array.from({length:manifest.parts},(_,index)=>key+':'+manifest.id+':'+index),parts=cache.getAll(keys);
    if(keys.every(key=>parts[key]))return keys.flatMap(key=>JSON.parse(parts[key])).map(unpackNews_);
  }
  const rows=annotateNews_(newsRowsForPeriod_(query).filter(businessNews_)),chunks=[];
  function chunk(items){
    const value=cacheJsonValue_(items);if(value){chunks.push(value);return chunks.length<=NEWS_CACHE.recordParts;}
    if(items.length<2)return false;const middle=Math.ceil(items.length/2);return chunk(items.slice(0,middle))&&chunk(items.slice(middle));
  }
  let complete=true;for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i+=NEWS_CACHE.chunkRows)if(!chunk(rows.slice(i,i+NEWS_CACHE.chunkRows).map(packNews_))){complete=false;break;}
  if(complete)try{const id=Utilities.getUuid();if(chunks.length)cache.putAll(Object.fromEntries(chunks.map((value,index)=>[key+':'+id+':'+index,value])),NEWS_CACHE.seconds);cache.put(key,JSON.stringify({id,parts:chunks.length}),NEWS_CACHE.seconds);}catch(_){}
  return rows;
}
function newsPeriodCount_(query){
  let count=0;for(const [day,ranges] of Object.entries(newsRecordIndex_().days))if(day>=query.from&&day<=query.to)for(const [first,last] of ranges)count+=last-first+1;return count;
}
function newsRowsForPeriod_(query={}){
  const positions=[];
  for(const [day,ranges] of Object.entries(newsRecordIndex_().days))if((!query.from||day>=query.from)&&(!query.to||day<=query.to))for(const [first,last] of ranges)for(let row=first;row<=last;row++)positions.push(row);
  return newsRowsAt_(positions.sort((a,b)=>a-b));
}
function newsRowsAt_(positions,gap=8){
  if(!positions.length)return [];
  const sheet=newsSheet_(),keys=RADAR.sheets.Noticias,result=[],wanted=new Set(positions);
  for(const [first,last] of sheetRowRanges_(positions,gap)){
    sheet.getRange(first,1,last-first+1,keys.length).getDisplayValues().forEach((values,index)=>{if(wanted.has(first+index))result.push({...Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,i)=>[key,values[i]])),_sheetRow:first+index});});
  }
  return result;
}

// A manifest is published only after all bounded fragments have been stored.
function readDashboardCache_(cache,key){
  const raw=cache.get(key);if(!raw)return null;
  const manifest=JSON.parse(raw),keys=Array.from({length:manifest.parts},(_,index)=>key+':'+manifest.id+':'+index),parts=cache.getAll(keys);
  return keys.every(key=>typeof parts[key]==='string')?JSON.parse(keys.map(key=>JSON.parse(parts[key])).join('')):null;
}
function writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,data){
  const encoded=JSON.stringify(data),size=NEWS_CACHE.dashboardChars,count=Math.ceil(encoded.length/size);
  if(count>NEWS_CACHE.dashboardParts)return;
  const id=Utilities.getUuid(),parts={};
  for(let index=0;index<count;index++)parts[key+':'+id+':'+index]=JSON.stringify(encoded.slice(index*size,(index+1)*size));
  try{cache.putAll(parts,NEWS_CACHE.seconds);cache.put(key,JSON.stringify({id,parts:count}),NEWS_CACHE.seconds);}catch(_){}
}

function dashboardSnapshotRevision_(view,now=new Date(),p=properties_().getProperties()){
  const period=dashboardPeriod_(view,now);
  return sha256_(JSON.stringify([RADAR.version,llmRevision_(),NEWS_CACHE.schema,newsStorageKey_(),taxonomyStorageKey_(),view,p.CONFIG_REVISION||'0',p.NEWS_REVISION||'0',p.TAXONOMY_REVISION||'0',p.TAXONOMY_TRANSLATIONS_REVISION||'0',Object.keys(languageNames).map(code=>p['TRANSLATIONS_REVISION:'+code]||'0'),period]));
}
function dashboardSnapshotManifest_(view){return dataGeneration_().snapshots?.[view]||null;}
function dashboardSnapshotsPending_(){if(llmJob_()?.state==='Publicando'&&!llmStateOverride_)return true;const p=properties_().getProperties(),now=new Date();return snapshotJobsPending_()||Boolean(p.DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT)||DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.some(view=>dashboardSnapshotManifest_(view)?.revision!==dashboardSnapshotRevision_(view,now,p));}
function dashboardSnapshotsDue_(){const p=properties_().getProperties();return Boolean(p.DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_REQUEST&&(p.DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_REQUEST==='ready'||Date.now()-Number(p.DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_REQUESTED_AT||Date.now())>=DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.refreshMs));}

function requestDashboardSnapshots_(ready=false){if(!dashboardSnapshotsPending_())return;const previous=properties_().getProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_REQUEST');invalidateDashboardSnapshots_();if(previous&&(!ready||previous==='ready'))return;if(ready)properties_().setProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_REQUEST','ready');ensureBackgroundWorker_();}
function defaultDashboardSnapshot_(view,query,language){
  if(!DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.includes(view))return null;
  const defaults=dashboardQuery_({view,initial:true}),revision=dashboardSnapshotRevision_(view),manifest=dashboardSnapshotManifest_(view);
  if(manifest?.periodFallback&&query.from===manifest.period.from&&query.to===manifest.period.to)Object.assign(defaults,manifest.period);
  if(Object.entries(query).some(([key,value])=>value!==''&&value!=null&&key!=='newsGeography'&&!(key==='page'&&Number(value)===0)&&value!==defaults[key]))return null;
  if(manifest?.revision!==revision){requestDashboardSnapshots_();if(!manifest)return null;}
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key='dashboard-snapshot:'+manifest.revision+':'+language+':'+(query.newsGeography||''),cached=readDashboardCache_(cache,key);if(cached)return cached;
  try{
    const rows=book_().getSheetByName(manifest.sheet||'DashboardSnapshots')?.getRange(manifest.first,1,manifest.parts,4).getDisplayValues();
    if(!rows||rows.some(([name,generation,part],index)=>name!==view||generation!==manifest.generation||Number(part)!==index))throw Error('Fragmentos incompletos');
    const encoded=rows.map(row=>row[3]).join('');if(sha256_(encoded)!==manifest.digest)throw Error('Contenido incompleto');
    const bundle=JSON.parse(Utilities.ungzip(Utilities.newBlob(Utilities.base64Decode(encoded),'application/gzip')).getDataAsString()),data=view==='news'?compactNewsSnapshotData_(bundle.news,query.newsGeography,language):bundle.variants[''][view==='radar'?'es':language];
    const value={data,period:bundle.period,periodFallback:bundle.periodFallback};writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,value);return value;
  }catch(error){console.warn('Snapshot '+view+': '+String(error.message||error));properties_().setProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT','true');requestDashboardSnapshots_();return null;}
}
