function buildDashboardSnapshotBatch_(job=null){
  const p=properties_().getProperties(),now=new Date(),signature=sha256_(JSON.stringify(DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.map(view=>dashboardSnapshotRevision_(view,now,p))));
  let build=JSON.parse(p.DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD||'null');
  if(!build||build.signature!==signature)build={signature,manifests:{}};
  if(!job&&!dashboardSnapshotsPending_()){completeSnapshotJobs_();clearDashboardSnapshotRequest_();return false;}
  const view=DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.find(view=>!build.manifests[view]);
  if(!view)return publishDashboardSnapshotSet_(build,job);
  const started=Date.now(),revision=dashboardSnapshotRevision_(view),feeds=feeds_();let query=dashboardQuery_({view,initial:true}),rows=cachedNewsRecords_(query),data=dashboardSnapshotData_(rows,query,feeds,view),periodFallback=false;
  if((view==='briefing'?data.briefing.total:data.contextTotal)===0){query={...query,...dashboardPeriod_(view,new Date(),true)};rows=cachedNewsRecords_(query);data=dashboardSnapshotData_(rows,query,feeds,view);periodFallback=true;}
  const payload=view==='news'?{news:compactNewsSnapshot_(rows,query,data)}:{variants:{'':dashboardSnapshotLanguages_(data,view)}};
  const period={from:query.from,to:query.to},encoded=Utilities.base64Encode(Utilities.gzip(Utilities.newBlob(JSON.stringify({period,periodFallback,...payload}),'application/json')).getBytes()),parts=Math.ceil(encoded.length/DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.chars);
  if(parts>DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.parts)throw Error('Snapshot demasiado grande: '+view);
  if(revision!==dashboardSnapshotRevision_(view))return true;
  let sheet=book_().getSheetByName('DashboardSnapshots');if(!sheet){sheet=book_().insertSheet('DashboardSnapshots');sheet.getRange(1,1,1,4).setValues([RADAR.sheets.DashboardSnapshots]);sheet.setFrozenRows(1);}
  const previous=dashboardSnapshotManifest_(view),slot=previous?.slot===0?1:0,first=2+(DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.indexOf(view)*2+slot)*DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.parts,generation=Utilities.getUuid(),needed=first+parts-1;
  if(needed>sheet.getMaxRows())sheet.insertRowsAfter(sheet.getMaxRows(),needed-sheet.getMaxRows());
  sheet.getRange(first,1,parts,4).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(Array.from({length:parts},(_,index)=>[view,generation,String(index),encoded.slice(index*DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.chars,(index+1)*DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.chars)]));SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  build.manifests[view]={revision,generation,slot,first,parts,digest:sha256_(encoded),generated:new Date().toISOString(),period,periodFallback};
  properties_().setProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD',JSON.stringify(build));
  if(view==='news')for(const language of Object.keys(languageNames))writeDashboardCache_(CacheService.getScriptCache(),'dashboard-snapshot:'+revision+':'+language+':',{data:compactNewsSnapshotData_(payload.news,'',language),period,periodFallback});
  else hydrateDashboardSnapshot_(CacheService.getScriptCache(),revision,payload.variants,view,period,periodFallback);
  telemetry_('dashboard-snapshot',Date.now()-started,'OK',view+'; '+period.from+' — '+period.to+'; anterior '+periodFallback+'; variantes '+(view==='news'?1:Object.keys(payload.variants).length)+'; comprimido '+encoded.length+' caracteres');
  if(DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.every(view=>build.manifests[view]))publishDashboardSnapshotSet_(build,job);return true;
}
function clearDashboardSnapshotRequest_(){for(const key of ['DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_REQUEST','DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_REQUESTED_AT','DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD','DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT'])properties_().deleteProperty(key);}
function publishDashboardSnapshotSet_(build,job){
  const signature=sha256_(JSON.stringify(DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.map(view=>dashboardSnapshotRevision_(view))));
  if(build.signature!==signature)return true;
  for(const view of DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views)try{verifyDashboardSnapshot_(view,build.manifests[view]);}catch(error){delete build.manifests[view];properties_().setProperty('DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUILD',JSON.stringify(build));throw error;}
  const previous=dataGeneration_(),generation={...previous,...(job?.categorization?{categorization:job.categorization}:{}),newsSheet:'Noticias',taxonomySheet:'Taxonomia',snapshots:build.manifests,revision:build.signature,published:new Date().toISOString()};
  // All view manifests and the historical corpus switch together. The previous slots remain intact.
  properties_().setProperty('DATA_GENERATION',JSON.stringify(generation));dataGenerationMemory_=generation;
  clearDashboardSnapshotRequest_();completeSnapshotJobs_();if(job?.llm){const llm=llmJob_();properties_().setProperty('LLM_JOB',JSON.stringify({...llm,state:'Completada',progress:100,error:'',published:generation.published}));}return true;
}

function verifyDashboardSnapshot_(view,manifest){
  if(!manifest)throw Error('Falta snapshot de '+view);
  const rows=book_().getSheetByName(manifest.sheet||'DashboardSnapshots').getRange(manifest.first,1,manifest.parts,4).getDisplayValues();
  if(rows.some(([name,generation,part],index)=>name!==view||generation!==manifest.generation||Number(part)!==index)||sha256_(rows.map(row=>row[3]).join(''))!==manifest.digest)throw Error('Snapshot incompleto: '+view);return rows;
}
function hydrateDashboardSnapshot_(cache,revision,variants,view,period,periodFallback){
  for(const [geography,values] of Object.entries(variants))for(const language of Object.keys(languageNames))writeDashboardCache_(cache,'dashboard-snapshot:'+revision+':'+language+':'+geography,{data:values[view==='radar'?'es':language],period,periodFallback});
}

// One shared catalogue and article table replace country × language copies of the same payload.
function compactNewsSnapshot_(rows,query,data){
  const selected=selectAnnotatedNews_(rows,query),geography=newsReadingGeography_(null,query),groups=new Map(data.newsGeographies.map(row=>[row.name,[]]));
  for(const row of selected)groups.get(geography(row))?.push(row);
  const articles=[],positions=new Map(),pages={};
  for(const [name,items] of groups){const page=newsEntityPage(items,0,data.pageSize);pages[name]={total:items.length,items:page.map(row=>{if(!positions.has(row)){positions.set(row,articles.length);articles.push(row);}return positions.get(row);})};}
  const fields=[...new Set(articles.flatMap(row=>Object.keys(row)))].filter(key=>!['_sheetRow','identityTitles'].includes(key)),records=articles.map(row=>fields.map(key=>row[key]??null)),translations={};
  for(const language of Object.keys(languageNames))translations[language]=savedArticleTranslations_(articles,language).map((row,index)=>[snapshotTextDelta_(articles[index].titular,row.titular),snapshotTextDelta_(articles[index].extracto??'',row.extracto??''),row.translation]);
  const {items,page,newsGeography,total,...metadata}=data;return {metadata,fields,records,translations,pages,defaultGeography:newsGeography};
}
function compactNewsSnapshotData_(bundle,geography,language){
  const name=Object.hasOwn(bundle.pages,geography)?geography:bundle.defaultGeography,page=bundle.pages[name]||{total:0,items:[]};
  const items=page.items.map(index=>{
    const row=Object.fromEntries(bundle.fields.flatMap((key,position)=>bundle.records[index][position]===null?[]:[[key,bundle.records[index][position]]])),[titular,extracto,translation]=bundle.translations[language][index];
    return {...row,titular:snapshotTextValue_(row.titular,titular),extracto:snapshotTextValue_(row.extracto??'',extracto),...(translation.state==='translated'?{original:{titular:row.titular,extracto:row.extracto}}:{}),translation};
  });
  return {...bundle.metadata,items,total:page.total,page:0,newsGeography:name};
}

function snapshotTextDelta_(original,value){
  if(original===value)return null;
  let prefix=0,suffix=0;while(prefix<original.length&&prefix<value.length&&original[prefix]===value[prefix])prefix++;
  while(suffix<original.length-prefix&&suffix<value.length-prefix&&original[original.length-1-suffix]===value[value.length-1-suffix])suffix++;
  return prefix+suffix>24?[prefix,suffix,value.slice(prefix,value.length-suffix)]:value;
}
function snapshotTextValue_(original,delta){return delta===null?original:Array.isArray(delta)?original.slice(0,delta[0])+delta[2]+(delta[1]?original.slice(-delta[1]):''):delta;}

function newsUrlIdentity_(value){
  const url=canonicalUrl_(value);if(!url)return '';
  const [path,query='']=url.split('?'),google=domainMatches_(url,'news.google.com'),parameters=query.split('&').filter(value=>value&&!/^msclkid=/i.test(value)&&!(google&&/^oc=/i.test(value))).join('&');
  return (google?path.replace('/rss/articles/','/articles/'):path)+(parameters?'?'+parameters:'');
}
function titleKey_(title,publisher){
  let text=searchText_(plainText_(title));const source=searchText_(publisher);
  if(source&&text.endsWith(source)){
    const prefix=text.slice(0,-source.length);if(/\s*[-–—|:]\s*$/.test(prefix))text=prefix.replace(/\s*[-–—|:]\s*$/,'');
  }
  const normalized=text.replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu,' ').trim();
  return normalized.length>=30&&normalized.split(' ').length>=5?normalized:'';
}
function titleIdentity_(item){
  const key=titleKey_(item.title,item.publisher),date=new Date(item.date);
  if(!key||!Number.isFinite(date.getTime()))return null;
  const day=typeof item.date==='string'&&/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(item.date)?date:calendarDate_(date);
  return {key,day:day.getTime()/86400000};
}
const EDITORIAL_STOPWORDS=new Set('para por con sin del las los una uno unos unas que como desde hasta sobre entre este esta sus the and for with from into this that are was has have not but you your their its dos das uma uns nas nos com sem pelo pela aos sao por que nao em as os de da do es en el la un o a e y i di il lo gli le dei delle per nel nella con che non der die das den dem des ein eine und oder von zur zum mit auf aus bei ist im zu et les des une dans sur pour pas aux du au ne ou ce ces se son sa ses un entre um ao pelo para sem ve bir bu ile icin gibi olan mais como foi'.split(' '));
function editorialIdentity_(item,identity=titleIdentity_(item)){
  const entity=item.entity?searchText_(entityKey_(item.entity)):'';if(!identity||!entity)return null;
  const excluded=new Set([...entity.split(' '),...searchText_(item.publisher).split(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u)]);
  const catalog=businessIndex_().entities.get(entity);for(const alias of catalog?.aliases||[])for(const token of searchText_(alias).split(' '))excluded.add(token);
  const tokens=[...new Set(identity.key.split(' ').filter(token=>(token.length>=3||/\d/.test(token))&&!EDITORIAL_STOPWORDS.has(token)&&!excluded.has(token)))];
  return tokens.length>=5?{key:JSON.stringify([entity,tokens.filter(token=>/\d/.test(token)).sort(),/\b(?:no|not|never|nao|non|nicht|yok)\b/.test(identity.key)]),tokens}:null;
}
function rememberTitle_(known,item,entry=true){
  const identity=titleIdentity_(item);if(!identity)return;
  if(!known.titles.has(identity.key))known.titles.set(identity.key,new Map());known.titles.get(identity.key).set(identity.day,entry);
  const editorial=editorialIdentity_(item,identity);if(!editorial)return;
  known.editorial=known.editorial||new Map();if(!known.editorial.has(editorial.key))known.editorial.set(editorial.key,new Map());
  const days=known.editorial.get(editorial.key);if(!days.has(identity.day))days.set(identity.day,[]);
  const candidates=days.get(identity.day);
  candidates.push({tokens:editorial.tokens,entry});
}
function equivalentEditorialTitle_(a,b){
  if(a.length<5||b.length<5)return false;
  const numbers=tokens=>tokens.filter(token=>/\d/.test(token)).sort().join('|');if(numbers(a)!==numbers(b))return false;
  const right=new Set(b),intersection=a.filter(token=>right.has(token)).length;
  return intersection/Math.min(a.length,b.length)>=.72||intersection/(a.length+b.length-intersection)>=.60;
}
function* duplicateTitleEntries_(known,item){
  const identity=titleIdentity_(item);if(!identity)return;
  const days=known.titles.get(identity.key);
  if(days)for(let offset=-COLLECTION_POLICY.duplicateDays;offset<=COLLECTION_POLICY.duplicateDays;offset++)if(days.has(identity.day+offset))yield days.get(identity.day+offset);
  const editorial=editorialIdentity_(item,identity),candidates=editorial&&known.editorial?.get(editorial.key);if(!candidates)return;
  for(let offset=-COLLECTION_POLICY.duplicateDays;offset<=COLLECTION_POLICY.duplicateDays;offset++)for(const candidate of candidates.get(identity.day+offset)||[])if(equivalentEditorialTitle_(editorial.tokens,candidate.tokens))yield candidate.entry;
}
function duplicateTitleEntry_(known,item){return duplicateTitleEntries_(known,item).next().value;}
function duplicateTitle_(known,item){return duplicateTitleEntry_(known,item)!==undefined;}
function newsRepresentative_(a,b){
  const original=row=>/europa\s*press/i.test(String(row.medio||''))||domainMatches_(row.url||'','europapress.es');
  const origin=Number(original(a))-Number(original(b));
  const richer=String(a.extracto||'').length-String(b.extracto||'').length;
  const direct=Number(!domainMatches_(a.url||'','news.google.com'))-Number(!domainMatches_(b.url||'','news.google.com'));
  return (origin||richer||direct||String(b.url||'').localeCompare(String(a.url||''))||String(b.id||'').localeCompare(String(a.id||'')))>0?a:b;
}
function uniqueNews_(rows,groups=null){
  const known={titles:new Map()},urls=new Map(),result=[],parents=[],members=groups?[]:null;
  const root=index=>{while(parents[index]!==index){parents[index]=parents[parents[index]];index=parents[index];}return index;};
  for(const row of rows){
    const items=[row.titular,row.original?.titular,...(row.identityTitles||[])].filter(Boolean).map(title=>({title,date:row.fecha,publisher:row.medio,entity:entityKey_(row.entidad),country:row.pais})),url=newsUrlIdentity_(row.url);
    const matches=new Set([url?urls.get(url):undefined,...items.flatMap(item=>[...duplicateTitleEntries_(known,item)])].filter(index=>index!==undefined).map(root));
    const index=matches.size?Math.min(...matches):result.length;
    if(!matches.size){parents.push(index);result.push(row);}
    else{for(const other of matches)if(other!==index){result[index]=newsRepresentative_(result[index],result[other]);parents[other]=index;result[other]=null;}result[index]=newsRepresentative_(result[index],row);}
    if(members)members.push(index);if(url)urls.set(url,index);for(const item of items)rememberTitle_(known,item,index);
  }
  if(groups){const positions=new Map(rows.map((row,index)=>[row,index]));rows.forEach((row,index)=>{const representative=result[root(members[index])];if(representative!==row)groups.push({index,representativeIndex:positions.get(representative)});});}
  return result.filter(Boolean);
}

// Read-only consolidation plan. Historical newsletter snapshots keep their original IDs.
function previewNewsDeduplication(){
  authorize_(true);
  const rows=translationIdentityRows_(rows_('Noticias')),aliases=[],survivors=uniqueNews_(rows,aliases),groups=new Map();
  for(const alias of aliases){
    if(!groups.has(alias.representativeIndex))groups.set(alias.representativeIndex,{representative:rows[alias.representativeIndex],duplicates:[]});
    groups.get(alias.representativeIndex).duplicates.push(rows[alias.index]);
  }
  return {revision:properties_().getProperty('NEWS_RECORDS_REVISION')||'0',total:rows.length,unique:survivors.length,duplicates:aliases.length,groups:[...groups.values()]};
}

function newsletterPipelinePending_(work){const p=properties_();return Boolean(snapshotPublicationPending_(work,false)||p.getProperty('DAILY_PIPELINE_REQUEST')||dailyCollectionPending_(work)||p.getProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST')||classificationPending_());}
function newsletterQuotaReset_(deliveries,now=new Date()){
  const timestamps=deliveries.filter(row=>['Enviando','Enviada','Revisar'].includes(row.estado)).map(row=>Date.parse(row.fecha)).filter(value=>value>now.getTime()-86400000).sort((a,b)=>a-b),index=timestamps.length-settings_().newsletterDailyLimit;
  return index>=0?timestamps[index]+86400000:0;
}
function pauseNewsletterQuota_(error){
  if(error.quota||serviceQuotaPause_(error))properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_QUOTA_UNTIL',String(Date.now()+(error.dailyQuota?86400000:serviceQuotaPause_(error)||settings_().pauseMinutes*60000)));
}
function newsletterDeliveryPlan_(now,deliveries){
  const periods=new Map(),attempts=newsletterDeliveryAttempts_(deliveries),planned=[];
  for(const subscription of subscriptionRows_().filter(row=>row.activa))for(const periodicity of Object.keys(newsletterCadences)){
    const row={...subscription,periodicidad:periodicity};
    if(!periods.has(periodicity))periods.set(periodicity,newsletterPeriod_(periodicity,now));
    const period=periods.get(periodicity);if(recordDay(now,settings_().timezone)<period.available||new Date(row.actualizada)>=new Date(period.cutoff))continue;
    const id=newsletterDeliveryId_(row,period);planned.push({row,id,attempt:newsletterDeliveryAttempt_(row,period,attempts)});
  }
  return {periods,planned,due:planned.filter(item=>!item.attempt||['No enviado','Bloqueada'].includes(item.attempt.estado)).map(item=>({...item,query:subscriptionQuery_(item.row,now,true)}))};
}
function getNewsletterProgress(){
  authorize_(true);const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),cached=cache.get('newsletter-progress');if(cached)return JSON.parse(cached);
  const now=new Date(),p=properties_(),deliveries=rows_('NewsletterEnvios',undefined,8),{planned,due}=newsletterDeliveryPlan_(now,deliveries),completed=planned.filter(item=>['Enviada','Sin novedades'].includes(item.attempt?.estado)),review=planned.filter(item=>['Enviando','Revisar'].includes(item.attempt?.estado)).length,enabled=settings_().newsletterEnabled,queued=enabled&&Boolean(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_REQUEST')),pausedUntil=Number(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_NEXT')||0),running=Number(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_RUNNING_UNTIL')||0)>Date.now();
  const job={total:planned.length,processed:completed.length,pending:due.length,accepted:completed.filter(item=>item.attempt.estado==='Enviada').length,empty:completed.filter(item=>item.attempt.estado==='Sin novedades').length,review,pausedUntil,updated:planned.reduce((date,item)=>item.attempt?.fecha>date?item.attempt.fecha:date,''),error:p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_LAST_ERROR')||'',state:running?'En curso':review?'En pausa':queued&&newsletterPipelinePending_()?'En cola':queued&&pausedUntil>Date.now()?'En pausa':due.length?queued?'En cola':'Pendiente':'Completada'};
  job.progress=jobProgressState_('newsletter',job,{queued,quotaUntil:Math.max(Number(p.getProperty('NEWSLETTER_QUOTA_UNTIL')||0),due.length?newsletterQuotaReset_(deliveries,now):0)});
  const result={enabled,queued,active:enabled&&(queued||running),job};cacheJson_('newsletter-progress',result,15);return result;
}
function requestNewsletterDelivery_(delay=0){properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_REQUEST','true');properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_NEXT',String(Date.now()+delay));ensureBackgroundWorker_(delay);}
function scheduledNewsletters_(){
  if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('newsletter');return;}
  if(dailyScheduleStatus_())requestDailyPipeline_();requestNewsletterDelivery_();
}
function newsletterReadyAt_(work){return properties_().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_REQUEST')&&settings_().newsletterEnabled&&!newsletterPipelinePending_(work)?Math.max(Date.now(),Number(properties_().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_NEXT')||0),Number(properties_().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_QUOTA_UNTIL')||0)):Infinity;}
function deliverNewsletterBatch_(work,maxMs=BACKGROUND_WORK.sliceMs){
  const started=Date.now(),now=new Date(started),result={accepted:0,empty:0,duplicates:0,pending:0,state:'disabled'};
  if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('newsletter');return {...result,state:'configuration_pause'};}
  if(!settings_().newsletterEnabled){properties_().deleteProperty('NEWSLETTER_REQUEST');return result;}
  if(newsletterPipelinePending_(work)){ensureNewsletterContinuation_();return {...result,state:'collection_priority'};}
  const quotaPause=Number(properties_().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_QUOTA_UNTIL')||0);if(quotaPause>Date.now()){requestNewsletterDelivery_(quotaPause-Date.now());return {...result,state:'limit'};}
  try{
    properties_().deleteProperty('NEWSLETTER_LAST_ERROR');properties_().setProperty('JOB_LAST_EXECUTED:newsletter',new Date().toISOString());properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_RUNNING_UNTIL',String(started+maxMs+BACKGROUND_WORK.activeGraceMs));CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('newsletter-progress');
    const deliveries=rows_('NewsletterEnvios'),{due,periods}=newsletterDeliveryPlan_(new Date(),deliveries);
    result.pending=due.length;result.state='no_due';
    if(!due.length){properties_().deleteProperty('NEWSLETTER_REQUEST');return result;}
    let remaining=settings_().newsletterBatch,quota=newsletterBudget_(deliveries,now);
    if(!quota){requestNewsletterDelivery_(newsletterQuotaReset_(deliveries,now)-Date.now());return {...result,state:'limit'};}
    let sender;
    const history=newsletterSentContent_(deliveries),window={from:due.reduce((start,item)=>item.query.from<start?item.query.from:start,due[0].query.from),to:due.reduce((end,item)=>item.query.to>end?item.query.to:end,due[0].query.to)};
    const news=annotateNews_(rows_('Noticias',undefined,undefined,window).filter(row=>businessNews_(row)&&newsScope_(row,window,''))),prepared=new Map(),sheet=book_().getSheetByName('NewsletterEnvios');
    sheet.getRange(1,9,1,1).setValues([['contenido']]);
    result.state='processed';
    for(const {row,id,query} of due){
      if(!remaining||!quota||Date.now()-started>=maxMs)break;
      if(backgroundPaused_()){deferBackgroundWork_('newsletter');result.state='configuration_pause';break;}
      if(newsletterPipelinePending_(work)){result.state='collection_priority';break;}
      const selection=newsletterSelectionQuery_(query),key=JSON.stringify(selection);
      if(!prepared.has(key))prepared.set(key,selectAnnotatedNews_(news,selection));
      const email=newsletterEmail_(row.correo);if(!history.has(email))history.set(email,new Set());
      const known=history.get(email),selected=prepared.get(key),unseen=query.view==='briefing'?newsletterUnseen_(selected,known):selected,edition=Utilities.getUuid();let content=newsletterContent_(unseen,query,row.nombre,now,row.id,row.idioma,edition,known);const keys=content.items.flatMap(newsletterItemKeys_);
      const skipped=selected.length-unseen.length;content.omitted=skipped;result.duplicates+=skipped;
      const needsTranslation=content.count&&!content.translationReady;
      if(needsTranslation&&!newsletterTranslationsReady_(content.items,row.idioma,started,maxMs)){result.state='translation_pending';continue;}
      if(needsTranslation&&content.items.length){content=newsletterContent_(unseen,query,row.nombre,now,row.id,row.idioma,edition,known);content.omitted=skipped;}
      if(content.count&&!sender)try{sender=newsletterSender_();}catch(error){recordNewsletterBlock_(error,properties_().getProperty('OWNER_EMAIL'));throw error;}
      if(content.count)saveNewsletterEdition_(edition,id,row.correo,row.nombre,query,row.idioma,content.evidence,content.editorial);
      append_('NewsletterEnvios',[[id,row.id,row.correo,query.from,query.to,content.count?'Enviando':'Sin novedades',now.toISOString(),newsletterContentDetail_(content),JSON.stringify(keys)]]);
      remaining--;result.pending--;
      if(!content.count){result.empty++;continue;}
      for(const key of keys)known.add(key);quota--;
      try{completeNewsletterDelivery_(sheet,sheet.getLastRow(),sender,row.correo,content);result.accepted++;}
      catch(error){pauseNewsletterQuota_(error);properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_LAST_ERROR',String(error.message).slice(0,300));result.state='error';result.error=error.message;if(error.rejected){quota++;result.pending++;}break;}
    }
    if(result.pending||result.state==='error'){
      const delay=!quota?Math.max(60000,newsletterQuotaReset_(rows_('NewsletterEnvios'),new Date())-Date.now()):result.state==='error'?settings_().pauseMinutes*60000:result.state==='translation_pending'&&translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls?nextDailyReset(Date.now(),settings_().timezone)-Date.now():60000;
      requestNewsletterDelivery_(delay);
    }else properties_().deleteProperty('NEWSLETTER_REQUEST');
    return result;
  }catch(error){pauseNewsletterQuota_(error);properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_LAST_ERROR',String(error.message).slice(0,300));ensureNewsletterContinuation_();throw error;}
  finally{properties_().deleteProperty('NEWSLETTER_RUNNING_UNTIL');CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('newsletter-progress');}
}

function newsletterTranslationsReady_(items,language,started,maxMs){
 const pending=savedArticleTranslations_(items,language).filter(row=>row.translation.state==='pending');if(!pending.length)return true;
 let calls=0;for(const row of pending){if(Date.now()-started>=maxMs||calls>=TRANSLATION_WORK.batchCalls||translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls)break;storeArticleTranslation_(row,language);calls++;const today=recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone),usage=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_TRANSLATION_USAGE')||'{}');properties_().setProperty('NEWSLETTER_TRANSLATION_USAGE',JSON.stringify({day:today,calls:(usage.day===today?Number(usage.calls)||0:0)+1}));}
 requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);return !savedArticleTranslations_(items,language).some(row=>row.translation.state==='pending');
}

function newsletterWords_(text,limit){const words=plainText_(text).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);return words.slice(0,limit).join(' ')+(words.length>limit?'…':'');}
function newsletterSelectionQuery_(query){return {...query,country:''};}
function newsletterDigest_(items,query,language,t,known=new Set()){
 items=items.filter(briefingAllowed);
 const cadence=Object.entries(newsletterCadences).find(([,value])=>value.view===(query.view||'briefing'))?.[0];if(!cadence)throw Error('Periodicidad no válida.');
 const fortnightly=cadence==='fortnightly',focused=Boolean(query.country),scopeOf=row=>focused&&row.pais===query.country?'local':'global',buckets={local:[],global:[]},groups=new Map();
 for(const row of items){const scope=scopeOf(row);buckets[scope].push(row);for(const tag of row.taxonomia.length?row.taxonomia:[{palanca:'Otros',subpalanca:''}]){if(query.palanca&&tag.palanca!==query.palanca||query.subpalanca&&taxonomyPath(tag)!==query.subpalanca)continue;const key=scope+'|'+tag.palanca;if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,{scope,tag,rows:new Map()});groups.get(key).rows.set(row.id,row);}}
 const candidates=[...groups.values()].map(group=>{const rows=[...group.rows.values()].sort((a,b)=>Number(newsletterWasSent_(a,known))-Number(newsletterWasSent_(b,known))||newsRelevance_(b)-newsRelevance_(a)||b.fecha.localeCompare(a.fecha)||a.id.localeCompare(b.id));return {...group,rows,row:rows[0],entities:new Set(rows.map(row=>row.entidad)).size};});
 // Count distinct evidence in the same geography/block, as in the heatmap; relevance breaks ties.
 candidates.sort((a,b)=>b.rows.length-a.rows.length||b.entities-a.entities||newsRelevance_(b.row)-newsRelevance_(a.row)||a.tag.palanca.localeCompare(b.tag.palanca,'es'));
 const limit=fortnightly?Math.min(NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.cards,settings_().briefingLimit):focused?2:1,chosen=[],ids=new Set(),blocks=new Set();
 function choose(entries,budget){for(const entry of entries){if(budget<=0||chosen.length>=limit)break;if(chosen.some(item=>item.scope===entry.scope&&item.tag.palanca===entry.tag.palanca))continue;const row=entry.rows.find(row=>!ids.has(row.id));if(!row)continue;chosen.push({...entry,row});ids.add(row.id);blocks.add(entry.tag.palanca);budget--;}}
 const local=candidates.filter(row=>row.scope==='local'),global=candidates.filter(row=>row.scope==='global');
 if(focused)choose(local,fortnightly?(global.length?Math.max(1,limit-1):limit):1);
 if(fortnightly){choose(global.filter(row=>!blocks.has(row.tag.palanca)),limit-chosen.length);choose(global,limit-chosen.length);}else choose(global,1);
 const cards=chosen.map(({row,tag,rows,scope,entities})=>({id:row.id,title:newsletterWords_(row.titular,NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.titleWords),fact:newsletterWords_(row.extracto,NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.factWords),relevance:newsletterWords_(fortnightly?formatText('Señal inmediata: {signal}.',{signal:t(row.senales[0]||'Noticia')},language):formatText('Tema observado en {count} entidades; comparar sus propuestas y fuentes.',{count:entities},language),NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.relevanceWords),evidenceIds:rows.slice(0,NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.supportItems).map(row=>row.id),relatedCount:rows.length,additionalCount:rows.length-1,entityCount:entities,countryCount:new Set(rows.map(row=>row.pais).filter(Boolean)).size,scope,countries:[...new Set(rows.map(row=>row.pais).filter(Boolean))],subcategory:tag.subpalanca||'',subcategoryPath:taxonomyPath(tag),subcategories:[...new Set(row.taxonomia.filter(item=>item.palanca===tag.palanca).map(item=>item.subpalanca))],category:tag.palanca,entity:row.entidad,country:row.pais,publisher:row.medio,date:row.fecha,url:canonicalUrl_(row.url)}));
 return {cadence,heading:t(fortnightly?'Movimientos de la quincena':'Balance del trimestre'),intro:t(fortnightly?'Novedades concretas para revisar esta quincena.':'Qué ha marcado tu canal y dónde mirar ahora.'),cards,reusedCount:chosen.filter(({row})=>newsletterWasSent_(row,known)).length,landscapes:fortnightly?null:{local:focused?newsletterLandscape_(buckets.local):null,global:newsletterLandscape_(buckets.global)},focusLabel:'Bloque funcional',focused,localCount:buckets.local.length,globalCount:buckets.global.length,context:query,scope:configuration_().applicationScope,geographies:configuration_().geographies};
}

// Independent proposals only. No consumer of Noticias, taxonomy or LLM reads this table.
const ENRICHMENT=Object.freeze({version:'1.2',rows:100,articles:2,maxText:24000,maxBytes:1000000,retries:3,retryMs:900000,dailyRequests:300});
function enrichmentSheet_(){return generationSheet_('Enriquecimiento',RADAR.sheets.Enriquecimiento);}
function enrichmentInput_(row,model=taxonomyModelRevision_(taxonomyCatalog_())){return sha256_(JSON.stringify([ENRICHMENT.version,row.id,row.titular,row.extracto,row.url,row.entidad,row.pais,row.clasificacion,row.taxonomia,model]));}
function enrichmentRss_(id,item){
  if(properties_().getProperty('ENRICHMENT_ENABLED')!=='true')return;
  cacheJson_('enrichment-rss:'+id,{feed:enrichmentUrl_(item.feedUrl||'')},21600);
}
function requestEnrichment_(){if(properties_().getProperty('ENRICHMENT_ENABLED')==='true'){properties_().setProperty('ENRICHMENT_REQUEST','true');ensureBackgroundWorker_();}}
function enrichmentJob_(){return JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('ENRICHMENT_JOB')||'null');}
function enrichmentQuotaAt_(){const usage=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('ENRICHMENT_HTTP_USAGE')||'{}');return usage.day===recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone)&&usage.calls>=ENRICHMENT.dailyRequests?nextDailyReset(Date.now(),settings_().timezone):0;}
function enrichmentReadyAt_(){const p=properties_(),job=enrichmentJob_();return p.getProperty('ENRICHMENT_ENABLED')==='true'&&(p.getProperty('ENRICHMENT_REQUEST')||job&&(job.state!=='Completada'||job.version!==ENRICHMENT.version))?Math.max(Date.now(),Number(job?.pausedUntil||0),Number(p.getProperty('FETCH_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0),enrichmentQuotaAt_()):Infinity;}
function enrichmentUrl_(value,base=''){
  const raw=String(value||'').trim(),origin=base.match(/^https:\/\/[^/]+/)?.[0]||'';
  const url=canonicalUrl_(raw.startsWith('//')?'https:'+raw:raw.startsWith('/')?origin+raw:raw.startsWith('https://')?raw:'');
  const host=url.match(/^https:\/\/([^/:]+)(?::\d+)?(?:\/|$)/)?.[1]?.toLowerCase()||'';
  return host&&host.includes('.')&&!/^(?:localhost|.*\.(?:local|internal|localhost|nip\.io|sslip\.io)|[0-9.]+|0x[0-9a-f]+)$/.test(host)&&!/[\[\]@]/.test(url)?url:'';
}
function enrichmentHeader_(headers,name){return String(Object.entries(headers).find(([key])=>key.toLowerCase()===name.toLowerCase())?.[1]||'');}
function enrichmentFetch_(url,metrics){
  if(metrics.deadline&&Date.now()>=metrics.deadline){const error=Error('Lote interrumpido por presupuesto de tiempo');error.interrupted=true;error.retryAt=Date.now()+60000;throw error;}
  const p=properties_(),today=recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone),usage=JSON.parse(p.getProperty('ENRICHMENT_HTTP_USAGE')||'{}');
  if(usage.day!==today){usage.day=today;usage.calls=0;}
  if(usage.calls>=ENRICHMENT.dailyRequests){const error=Error('Cuota diaria de enriquecimiento');error.quota=true;error.retryAt=nextDailyReset(Date.now(),settings_().timezone);throw error;}
  usage.calls++;p.setProperty('ENRICHMENT_HTTP_USAGE',JSON.stringify(usage));metrics.http++;
  const start=Date.now();try{
    const response=UrlFetchApp.fetch(url,{muteHttpExceptions:true,followRedirects:false,headers:{'User-Agent':'NewsRadar/1.0','Accept':'text/html, application/rss+xml, application/xml'}});
    const code=response.getResponseCode(),headers=response.getAllHeaders();
    if(code===429||code>=500){const error=Error('HTTP '+code);error.retryAt=Date.now()+ENRICHMENT.retryMs;throw error;}
    if(code>=400){const error=Error('HTTP '+code);error.restricted=[401,403,451].includes(code);error.terminal=true;throw error;}
    const text=response.getContentText();if(text.length>ENRICHMENT.maxBytes){const error=Error('Contenido demasiado grande');error.terminal=true;throw error;}
    return {code,headers,text};
  }finally{metrics.fetchMs+=Date.now()-start;}
}
function enrichmentRobots_(url,metrics){
  const origin=url.match(/^https:\/\/[^/]+/)[0],cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key='enrichment-robots:'+sha256_(origin),stored=cache.get(key);let rules;
  if(stored)rules=JSON.parse(stored);else{
    try{const response=enrichmentFetch_(origin+'/robots.txt',metrics);if(response.code!==200||enrichmentHeader_(response.headers,'tdm-reservation')==='1')return false;rules=response.text.slice(0,64000);cacheJson_(key,rules,3600);}catch(error){if(error.retryAt||serviceQuotaPause_(error))throw error;return false;}
  }
  if(/^\s*tdm-reservation\s*:\s*1/im.test(rules))return false;
  let agents=[],entries=[],group=[],seenRule=false;
  for(const line of rules.split(/\r?\n/)){const match=line.replace(/#.*/,'').match(/^\s*([\w-]+)\s*:\s*(.*?)\s*$/);if(!match)continue;const key=match[1].toLowerCase(),value=match[2];
    if(key==='user-agent'){if(seenRule){entries.push({agents,rules:group});agents=[];group=[];seenRule=false;}agents.push(value.toLowerCase());}
    else if(['allow','disallow'].includes(key)){seenRule=true;group.push({allow:key==='allow',path:value});}
  }entries.push({agents,rules:group});
  const specific=entries.filter(entry=>entry.agents.some(agent=>agent!=='*'&&'newsradar'.includes(agent))),selected=specific.length?specific:entries.filter(entry=>entry.agents.includes('*'));
  const path=url.slice(origin.length),matches=selected.flatMap(entry=>entry.rules).filter(rule=>rule.path&&new RegExp('^'+rule.path.replace(/[.+?^{}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&').replace(/\*/g,'.*')).test(path)).sort((a,b)=>b.path.length-a.path.length||Number(b.allow)-Number(a.allow));
  return !matches.length||matches[0].allow;
}
function enrichmentExtract_(html){
  for(const tag of html.match(/<meta\b[^>]*>/gi)||[]){const attrs=Object.fromEntries([...tag.matchAll(/([\w:-]+)\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)'|([^\s>]+))/g)].map(match=>[match[1].toLowerCase(),String(match[2]??match[3]??match[4]).toLowerCase().trim()]));if(attrs.name==='tdm-reservation'&&attrs.content==='1'||['robots','googlebot'].includes(attrs.name)&&/(?:noai|noimageai|nosnippet|noarchive)/.test(attrs.content||''))return {restricted:true,text:''};}
  if(/"isAccessibleForFree"\s*:\s*(?:false|"false")|(?:class|id)=["'][^"']*(?:paywall|subscription-wall)/i.test(html))return {restricted:true,text:''};
  const main=html.match(/<article\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/article>/i)?.[1]||html.match(/<main\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/main>/i)?.[1];
  if(!main)return {text:'',reason:'sin-contenido-principal'};
  const text=plainText_(main.replace(/<(nav|footer|header|aside|form)\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi,' ')).replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,ENRICHMENT.maxText);
  return {text};
}
function enrichmentContent_(row,metrics){
  const cached=CacheService.getScriptCache().get('enrichment-rss:'+row.id),metadata=cached?JSON.parse(cached):null;
  let text=plainText_(row.extracto||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,ENRICHMENT.maxText),source='rss:stored-excerpt',url=enrichmentUrl_(row.url);
  const feed=enrichmentUrl_(metadata?.feed||configuration_().feeds.find(feed=>feed.name===row.fuente&&feed.enabled)?.url||'');
  if(feed&&text.length<500){
    try{const response=enrichmentFetch_(feed,metrics);if(response.code===200){const item=parseFeed_(response.text).find(item=>newsUrlIdentity_(item.url)===newsUrlIdentity_(row.url)||searchText_(item.title)===searchText_(row.titular));if(item){const content=[item.excerpt,item.rssContent].filter(Boolean).map(plainText_).sort((a,b)=>b.length-a.length)[0]||'';if(content.length>text.length){text=content.slice(0,ENRICHMENT.maxText);source=item.rssContent?'rss:content:encoded':item.excerptSource;}}}}
    catch(error){if(error.retryAt||serviceQuotaPause_(error))throw error;}
  }
  if(text.length>=500)return {text,source,url};
  if(!url)return {text,source,url:'',reason:'url-no-permitida'};
  const resolveStart=Date.now();
  for(let hop=0;hop<4;hop++){
    if(!enrichmentRobots_(url,metrics))return {text,source,url,restricted:true,reason:'robots-no-permite-o-no-verificable'};
    const response=enrichmentFetch_(url,metrics);
    if([301,302,303,307,308].includes(response.code)){const next=enrichmentUrl_(enrichmentHeader_(response.headers,'location'),url);if(!next||hop===3)return {text,source,url,reason:'redireccion-no-permitida'};url=next;continue;}
    if(response.code!==200)return {text,source,url,reason:'HTTP '+response.code};
    if(/(?:noai|nosnippet|noarchive)/i.test(enrichmentHeader_(response.headers,'x-robots-tag'))||enrichmentHeader_(response.headers,'tdm-reservation')==='1')return {text,source,url,restricted:true,reason:'reserva-editorial'};
    if(!/text\/html/i.test(enrichmentHeader_(response.headers,'content-type')))return {text,source,url,reason:'formato-no-html'};
    const extract=enrichmentExtract_(response.text);if(extract.restricted)return {text,source,url,restricted:true,reason:'contenido-restringido'};
    if(extract.text.length>text.length){text=extract.text;source='editorial:article/main';}
    metrics.resolveMs+=Date.now()-resolveStart;return {text,source,url,reason:extract.reason};
  }return {text,source,url,reason:'limite-redirecciones'};
}
const enrichmentDefinitions_=new WeakMap();
function enrichmentSignals_(row,text){
  const catalog=taxonomyCatalog_();if(!enrichmentDefinitions_.has(catalog))enrichmentDefinitions_.set(catalog,catalog.map(item=>({...item,terms:item.terminos||[],context:item.context||[],exclude:item.exclude||[]})));
  const normalized=taxonomyText(row.titular+'. '+text),sentences=normalized.split(/(?<=[.!?;])\s+/).filter(sentence=>!/(?:\b(?:no|not|never|cannot|doesn.t|didn.t|won.t)\b.{0,40}\b(?:ofrec|permit|lanz|dispon|habilit|incorpor|admit|implement|soport|offer|allow|launch|enable|support|provide|introduc)|\b(?:podria|podrian|preve|planea|estudia|evalua|habilitara|incorporara|lanzara|permitira|ofrecera|implementara|could|would|might|plans|rumor|hace \d+ anos|en 20(?:0\d|1\d))\b)/.test(sentence)),context=sentences.filter(sentence=>{const subject=headlineEntity_(sentence,businessIndex_())?.name;return !subject||subject===row.entidad;}).join(' '),definitions=enrichmentDefinitions_.get(catalog),decision=taxonomyDecision(context,definitions,taxonomyText(row.titular));
  const entity=headlineEntity_(taxonomyText(row.titular),businessIndex_())?.name||'',attributed=entity===row.entidad;
  const functions=attributed?decision.matches.filter(match=>match.evidence.method==='literal').map(match=>({id:match.row.id,terms:match.evidence.terms,method:'tf-idf/ngram+context',ranking:Math.round(match.score*100)/100})):[];
  const movements=attributed?businessSignals_(searchText_(row.titular),searchText_(context)).map(row=>row.name):[];
  const countries=businessIndex_().geographies.filter(country=>country.terms.some(term=>phraseMatch_(context,term))).map(country=>country.name);
  return {functions,channels:[...new Set((context.match(/\b(?:app|web|api|movil|online|banca digital)\b/g)||[]))],entities:entity?[entity]:[],countries,movements,attribution:attributed?'headline-entity':'unverified',requiresApproval:true};
}
function enrichmentBatch_(maxMs=BACKGROUND_WORK.sliceMs,selectedIds=null){
  const started=Date.now(),p=properties_(),sheet=enrichmentSheet_(),keys=RADAR.sheets.Enriquecimiento,metrics={deadline:started+maxMs,http:0,fetchMs:0,resolveMs:0,reads:2,writes:0,processed:0,retried:0,success:0,changes:0,reasons:{}};
  const count=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),records=count?sheet.getRange(2,1,count,6).getDisplayValues().map(values=>Object.fromEntries(keys.slice(0,6).map((key,i)=>[key,values[i]]))):[],index=new Map(records.map((row,i)=>[row.newsId,{...row,row:i+2}])),job=enrichmentJob_()||{version:ENRICHMENT.version,next:2,newNext:2,state:'Pendiente'},last=newsSheet_().getLastRow();
  if(enrichmentQuotaAt_()>started){job.state='En pausa';job.pausedUntil=enrichmentQuotaAt_();p.setProperty('ENRICHMENT_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));return {job,metrics};}
  const model=taxonomyModelRevision_(taxonomyCatalog_()),source=newsStorageKey_();if(job.version!==ENRICHMENT.version||job.model&&job.model!==model||job.source&&job.source!==source||job.lastRow&&last<job.lastRow){job.next=2;job.newNext=2;}job.version=ENRICHMENT.version;job.model=model;job.source=source;job.lastRow=last;
  // New arrivals take precedence; the stable historical cursor advances in bounded windows.
  const ranges=[];if(job.newNext<=last)ranges.push([Math.max(2,job.newNext),Math.min(last,job.newNext+ENRICHMENT.rows-1),'newNext']);if(job.next<=last)ranges.push([job.next,Math.min(last,job.next+ENRICHMENT.rows-1),'next']);
  if(last>Number(job.newNext||2)+ENRICHMENT.rows-1)ranges.push([Math.max(2,last-ENRICHMENT.rows+1),last,'']);
  if(selectedIds)ranges.length=0;
  const retry=records.filter(row=>row.state==='Reintento'&&Number(row.nextAt)<=started).slice(0,ENRICHMENT.rows);const news=new Map();
  for(const [first,end,cursor]of ranges){for(const row of newsSheet_().getRange(first,1,end-first+1,RADAR.sheets.Noticias.length).getDisplayValues()){const item=Object.fromEntries(RADAR.sheets.Noticias.map((key,i)=>[key,row[i]]));news.set(item.id,item);}metrics.reads++;if(cursor)job[cursor]=end+1;}
  if(selectedIds){for(const row of rowsById_('Noticias',new Set(selectedIds)))news.set(row.id,row);metrics.reads++;}
  if(!selectedIds&&retry.length){for(const row of rowsById_('Noticias',new Set(retry.map(row=>row.newsId))))news.set(row.id,row);metrics.reads++;}
  const candidates=[...news.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.capturada.localeCompare(a.capturada));let interrupted=false,quotaUntil=0;
  for(const row of candidates){
    if(Date.now()-started>=maxMs||metrics.processed>=ENRICHMENT.articles||!selectedIds&&backgroundPaused_()){interrupted=true;break;}
    const input=enrichmentInput_(row,model),old=index.get(row.id);if(old?.inputHash===input&&(old.state!=='Reintento'||Number(old.nextAt)>Date.now()))continue;
    const record={newsId:row.id,inputHash:input,version:ENRICHMENT.version,state:'Completada',attempts:old?.inputHash===input?Number(old.attempts)+1:1,nextAt:'',url:row.url,source:'',contentHash:'',signals:'{}',comparison:'{}',error:'',updated:new Date().toISOString()};const articleStart=Date.now();
    try{const content=enrichmentContent_(row,metrics),signals=enrichmentSignals_(row,content.text),current=taxonomySaved_(row.taxonomia).ids||[],proposed=signals.functions.map(item=>item.id);record.source=content.source;record.url=content.url;record.contentHash=sha256_(content.text);record.signals=JSON.stringify(signals);record.comparison=JSON.stringify({current,proposed,added:proposed.filter(id=>!current.includes(id)),removed:current.filter(id=>!proposed.includes(id)),classificationHash:sha256_(row.clasificacion),taxonomyHash:sha256_(row.taxonomia),applied:false});record.state=content.restricted?'Restringida':content.text?'Completada':'Sin contenido';record.error=content.reason||'';if(content.text&&content.source!=='rss:stored-excerpt'&&!content.restricted)metrics.success++;if(proposed.some(id=>!current.includes(id)))metrics.changes++;}
    catch(error){if(error.interrupted||error.quota||serviceQuotaPause_(error))record.attempts--;if(error.quota||serviceQuotaPause_(error))quotaUntil=Number(error.retryAt)||Date.now()+86400000;record.error=String(error.message||error).slice(0,180);record.state=error.restricted?'Restringida':!error.terminal&&record.attempts<ENRICHMENT.retries?'Reintento':'Error';record.nextAt=record.state==='Reintento'?String(error.retryAt||Date.now()+ENRICHMENT.retryMs*2**(record.attempts-1)):'';if(serviceQuotaPause_(error)){record.nextAt=String(Date.now()+86400000);p.setProperty('FETCH_PAUSED_UNTIL',record.nextAt);}if(record.state==='Reintento')metrics.retried++;}
    record.durationMs=Date.now()-articleStart;const position=old?.row||sheet.getLastRow()+1;if(position>sheet.getMaxRows())sheet.insertRowsAfter(sheet.getMaxRows(),100);sheet.getRange(position,1,1,keys.length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([keys.map(key=>safeCell_(record[key]??''))]);index.set(row.id,{...record,row:position});metrics.writes++;metrics.processed++;metrics.reasons[record.error||record.state]=(metrics.reasons[record.error||record.state]||0)+1;if(quotaUntil){interrupted=true;break;}
  }
  delete metrics.deadline;
  if(selectedIds){telemetry_('enrichment-sample',Date.now()-started,'OK',JSON.stringify(metrics));return {metrics,records:selectedIds.map(id=>index.get(id)).filter(Boolean)};}
  if(interrupted){for(const [first,,cursor]of ranges)if(cursor)job[cursor]=first;}
  const scanning=job.next<=last||job.newNext<=last,active=scanning?null:new Set(last>1?newsSheet_().getRange(2,1,last-1,1).getDisplayValues().flat():[]);if(active)metrics.reads++;
  for(const record of index.values())if(record.state==='Reintento'&&active&&!active.has(record.newsId)){sheet.getRange(record.row,4,1,3).setValues([['Retirada',record.attempts,'']]);record.state='Retirada';metrics.writes++;}
  const retries=[...index.values()].filter(row=>row.state==='Reintento');job.processed=[...index.values()].filter(row=>!['Reintento','Retirada'].includes(row.state)&&(!active||active.has(row.newsId))).length;job.total=last-1;job.pending=Math.max(0,job.total-job.processed);job.state=quotaUntil?'En pausa':scanning||retries.length?'Pendiente':'Completada';job.pausedUntil=quotaUntil||(scanning?0:retries.length?Math.min(...retries.map(row=>Number(row.nextAt))):0);job.updated=new Date().toISOString();p.setProperty('ENRICHMENT_JOB',JSON.stringify(job));p.deleteProperty('ENRICHMENT_REQUEST');
  telemetry_('enrichment',Date.now()-started,'OK',JSON.stringify(metrics));return {job,metrics};
}
function startNewsEnrichment(){authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{const p=properties_();enrichmentSheet_();if(!enrichmentJob_()||enrichmentJob_().state==='Completada')p.setProperty('ENRICHMENT_JOB',JSON.stringify({version:ENRICHMENT.version,next:2,newNext:Math.max(2,newsSheet_().getLastRow()-ENRICHMENT.rows+1),state:'Pendiente'}));p.setProperty('ENRICHMENT_ENABLED','true');requestEnrichment_();return enrichmentJob_();});}
function getNewsEnrichmentStatus(){authorize_(true);return {job:enrichmentJob_(),enabled:properties_().getProperty('ENRICHMENT_ENABLED')==='true'};}

function enrichNewsSample(ids){authorize_(true);if(!Array.isArray(ids)||ids.length<1||ids.length>ENRICHMENT.articles||ids.some(id=>typeof id!=='string'))throw Error('Selecciona una o dos noticias persistidas.');return withForegroundWrite_(()=>enrichmentBatch_(BACKGROUND_WORK.sliceMs,ids));}

function newsletterFeedback_(id,email){return rows_('NewsletterFeedback',settings_().eventLimit).find(row=>row.edicion===id&&row.correo===email)||null;}
function saveNewsletterFeedback(input){
  const session=authorize_();newsletterEditionMetadata_(input?.edition,session.email);
  if(!['positive','negative',''].includes(input.rating)||typeof input.comment!=='string'||input.comment.length>NEWSLETTER_EDITORIAL.commentChars)throw Error('Valoración o comentario no válido.');
  return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
    const id=sha256_(input.edition+'|'+session.email),sheet=book_().getSheetByName('NewsletterFeedback'),rows=rows_('NewsletterFeedback'),index=rows.findIndex(row=>row.id===id),comment=plainText_(input.comment).trim();
    if(!input.rating&&!comment){if(index>=0)sheet.deleteRow(index+2);return {feedback:null};}
    const feedback={id,edicion:input.edition,correo:session.email,valoracion:input.rating,comentario:comment,fecha:new Date().toISOString(),estado:'pendiente'},values=RADAR.sheets.NewsletterFeedback.map(key=>safeCell_(feedback[key]));
    if(index>=0)sheet.getRange(index+2,1,1,values.length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([values]);else append_('NewsletterFeedback',[values]);
    return {feedback};
  });
}
function setNewsletterFeedbackState(input){
  authorize_(true);if(!['pendiente','atendido'].includes(input?.state))throw Error('Estado de seguimiento no válido.');
  return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{const rows=rows_('NewsletterFeedback'),index=rows.findIndex(row=>row.id===input.id);if(index<0)throw Error('Valoración no disponible.');book_().getSheetByName('NewsletterFeedback').getRange(index+2,7,1,1).setValues([[input.state]]);return {saved:true};});
}
function recordNewsletterEvents_(events,email){
  const attributed=events.filter(event=>event.edition&&['acceso','vista','lectura','exportacion'].includes(event.event));if(!attributed.length)return;
  const editions=new Map(),known=new Set(rows_('NewsletterEventos',settings_().eventLimit,1).map(row=>row.id)),values=[];
  for(const event of attributed){
    if(!/^[a-z0-9-]{16,80}$/i.test(event.id))throw Error('Evento no válido.');
    if(!editions.has(event.edition))editions.set(event.edition,newsletterEditionMetadata_(event.edition,email));
    if(known.has(event.id))continue;known.add(event.id);
    const edition=editions.get(event.edition),cadence=Object.entries(newsletterCadences).find(([,row])=>row.view===(JSON.parse(edition.filtros).view||'briefing'))[0],destination=event.event==='lectura'?'fuente':event.event==='exportacion'?'exportacion':event.view;
    values.push([event.id,event.edition,email,event.session,event.event,destination,cadence,new Date().toISOString()]);
  }
  append_('NewsletterEventos',values);
}
function getNewsletterInsights(query={}){
  authorize_(true);const events=filterRecords(rows_('NewsletterEventos',settings_().eventLimit),query.adoption||query,['edicion','cadencia'],['edicion','cadencia','destino'],'fecha',settings_().timezone),groups=new Map();
  for(const event of events){const key=event.edicion+'|'+event.cadencia;if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,{edition:event.edicion,cadence:event.cadencia,users:new Set(),sessions:new Set(),entries:0,destinations:new Set()});const group=groups.get(key);group.users.add(event.correo);group.sessions.add(event.correo+'|'+event.sesion);if(event.evento==='acceso')group.entries++;group.destinations.add(event.destino);}
  const editions=rows_('NewsletterEdiciones').filter(row=>row.estado==='Enviada'),recipients=new Map(editions.map(row=>[row.id,new Set([row.correo])])),feedback=filterRecords(rows_('NewsletterFeedback',settings_().eventLimit),query.feedback||query,['estado','edicion'],['edicion','comentario','estado'],'fecha',settings_().timezone);
  return {adoption:recordPage([...groups.values()].reverse().map(group=>({...group,users:group.users.size,sessions:group.sessions.size,destinations:[...group.destinations],recipients:recipients.get(group.edition)?.size||0})),query.adoption||query,settings_().pageSize),feedback:recordPage(feedback.slice().reverse(),query.feedback||query,settings_().pageSize),retentionDays:settings_().retentionDays};
}

// Administrative feedback uses header metadata only; article evidence is never read.
function adminFeedbackRows_(){
  const editions=new Map(rows_('NewsletterEdiciones').map(row=>[row.id,row]));
  return rows_('NewsletterFeedback').map(row=>{
    const edition=editions.get(row.edicion)||{};let filters={};try{filters=JSON.parse(edition.filtros||'{}');}catch(error){}
    const cadence=Object.entries(newsletterCadences).find(([,value])=>value.view===(filters.view||'briefing'))?.[0]||'';
    return {...row,nombre_edicion:edition.nombre||row.edicion,fecha_envio:edition.fecha||'',idioma:edition.idioma||'',filtros:filters,pais:filters.country||filters.pais||'',cadencia:cadence};
  });
}
function adminFeedbackSelection_(rows,query){return filterRecords(rows,query,['valoracion','estado','edicion','correo'],['correo','edicion','nombre_edicion','comentario','estado','pais','cadencia','idioma'],'fecha',settings_().timezone);}
function feedbackKpis_(rows){
  const total=rows.length,positive=rows.filter(row=>row.valoracion==='positive').length,negative=rows.filter(row=>row.valoracion==='negative').length,pending=rows.filter(row=>row.estado==='pendiente').length;
  return {total,positive,negative,positiveRate:positive+negative?Math.round(1000*positive/(positive+negative))/10:0,pending,resolved:rows.filter(row=>row.estado==='atendido').length};
}
function getAdminFeedback(query={}){
  authorize_(true);const started=Date.now();try{
  const rows=adminFeedbackRows_(),selected=adminFeedbackSelection_(rows,query),editionIds=new Set(selected.map(row=>row.edicion)),groups=new Map();
  const events=filterRecords(rows_('NewsletterEventos'),{...query,search:''},['edicion','correo'],['correo','edicion','destino'],'fecha',settings_().timezone);
  for(const event of events){
    if((query.valoracion||query.estado||query.search)&&!editionIds.has(event.edicion))continue;
    if(!groups.has(event.edicion))groups.set(event.edicion,{edicion:event.edicion,accesses:0,reads:0,exports:0});
    const group=groups.get(event.edicion);if(event.evento==='acceso')group.accesses++;if(event.evento==='lectura')group.reads++;if(event.evento==='exportacion')group.exports++;
  }
  const result={...recordPage(selected.slice().reverse(),query,settings_().pageSize),global:feedbackKpis_(rows),filtered:feedbackKpis_(selected),options:recordOptions(rows,['valoracion','estado','edicion','correo']),interactions:[...groups.values()]};
  telemetry_('feedback_admin',Date.now()-started,'OK',selected.length+' valoraciones filtradas; '+rows.length+' totales');return result;
  }catch(error){telemetry_('feedback_admin',Date.now()-started,'Error',error.message);throw error;}
}
function exportNewsletterFeedback(query={}){
  authorize_(true);const started=Date.now();try{
  const rows=adminFeedbackSelection_(adminFeedbackRows_(),query).slice().reverse(),columns=['fecha','correo','edicion','nombre_edicion','cadencia','pais','idioma','valoracion','comentario','estado'];
  const cell=value=>'"'+String(safeCell_(value??'')).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';
  const result={csv:'\ufeff'+[columns,...rows.map(row=>columns.map(key=>row[key]))].map(row=>row.map(cell).join(',')).join('\r\n'),count:rows.length};
  telemetry_('feedback_export',Date.now()-started,'OK',rows.length+' valoraciones exportadas');return result;
  }catch(error){telemetry_('feedback_export',Date.now()-started,'Error',error.message);throw error;}
}

function parseFeed_(xml) {
  const channel=XmlService.parse(xml).getRootElement().getChild('channel');
  if(!channel)throw Error('Se requiere RSS 2.0 con channel/item.');
  const items=channel.getChildren('item'),language=feedLanguage(channel.getChildText('language'));
  if(items.length>settings_().maxItems)throw Error('Feed demasiado grande (máximo '+settings_().maxItems+' entradas).');
  return items.map(item=>{const description=item.getChildText('description'),content=item.getChildText('encoded',XmlService.getNamespace('http://purl.org/rss/1.0/modules/content/'));return {title:item.getChildText('title'),url:item.getChildText('link'),date:item.getChildText('pubDate'),excerpt:description||content||'',rssContent:content||'',excerptSource:description?'rss:description':content?'rss:content:encoded':'rss:title',source:item.getChild('source')?.getText()||'',sourceUrl:canonicalUrl_(item.getChild('source')?.getAttribute('url')?.getValue()||''),language};});
}
function newsRecord_(item,feed,now) {
  const record={id:Utilities.getUuid(),fecha:Utilities.formatDate(item.date,settings_().timezone,'yyyy-MM-dd'),pais:item.country||feed.country,medio:publisherKey_(item.publisher||(feed.kind==='profile'?'':feed.name)),entidad:entityKey_(item.entity||feed.entity),titular:item.title,extracto:item.excerpt,url:item.url,capturada:now.toISOString(),fuente:feed.name,idioma:item.language||feed.language||'',clasificacion:JSON.stringify({...item.labels,procedencia:{fuente:feed.name,url:item.url,...(item.sourceUrl?{medioUrl:item.sourceUrl}:{}),extracto:item.provenance||'rss:description'}}),taxonomia:JSON.stringify(taxonomyRecord_(item.title,item.excerpt))};
  return RADAR.sheets.Noticias.map(key=>record[key]);
}
function ingestFeed_(feed,known,cycle,now,response) {
  if(response.getResponseCode()!==200)throw Error('HTTP '+response.getResponseCode());
  const xml=response.getContentText();if(xml.length>settings_().maxFeedBytes)throw Error('Feed excede el tamaño máximo permitido.');
  const items=parseFeed_(xml),news=[],audit=[],candidates=[],date=now.toISOString();let excluded=0,duplicated=0,inside=0,relevant=0,digital=0;const reasons={};
  known.titles=known.titles||new Map();
  for(const raw of items){
    const result=evaluate_(raw,feed,now),item=result.item;
    if(result.inRange)inside++;
    if(result.candidate)candidates.push(candidateRecord_(result.candidate,feed,now,result.reason));
    let state='Excluida',reason=result.reason;
    if(item){
      if(result.relevant)relevant++;
      if(known.has(newsUrlIdentity_(item.url))){state='Duplicada';reason='URL ya recopilada';}
      else if(duplicateTitle_(known,item)){state='Duplicada';reason='Titular sindicado equivalente en fecha próxima';known.add(newsUrlIdentity_(item.url));}
      else{known.add(newsUrlIdentity_(item.url));rememberTitle_(known,item);state='Incluida';reason=feed.kind==='profile'?'Noticia integrada desde RSS de Google News':'Noticia integrada desde RSS del editor';const record=newsRecord_(item,feed,now);news.push(record);enrichmentRss_(record[0],{feedUrl:feed.url});if(item.labels.digital)digital++;}
    }
    if(state==='Excluida'){excluded++;reasons[reason]=(reasons[reason]||0)+1;}else if(state==='Duplicada')duplicated++;
    if(state==='Incluida')audit.push([cycle,date,feed.name,item?.url||String(raw.url||''),state,reason]);
  }
  audit.push([cycle,date,feed.name,feed.url,'Fuente consultada',items.length+' evaluadas; '+news.length+' nuevas; '+excluded+' excluidas; '+duplicated+' duplicadas; '+relevant+' relevantes; '+inside+' dentro del período; motivos '+JSON.stringify(reasons)+((feed.kind==='profile'||feed.domain==='news.google.com')&&items.length>=COLLECTION_POLICY.providerLimit?'; posible límite del proveedor: cobertura parcial':'')]);
  return {news,audit,candidates,inside,evaluated:items.length,relevant,digital,duplicated,excluded,saturated:(feed.kind==='profile'||feed.domain==='news.google.com')&&items.length>=COLLECTION_POLICY.providerLimit&&inside>=COLLECTION_POLICY.providerLimit*COLLECTION_POLICY.saturationRatio};
}
let knownUrlsMemory_;
function knownUrls_(){
  const sheet=newsSheet_(),count=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),revision=newsStorageKey_()+':'+count+':'+(properties_().getProperty('NEWS_CONTENT_REVISION')||'0');
  if(knownUrlsMemory_?.revision===revision)return knownUrlsMemory_.known;
  const known=new Set();known.titles=new Map();
  if(count){const rows=sheet.getRange(2,2,count,5).getDisplayValues(),urls=sheet.getRange(2,8,count,1).getDisplayValues();
    for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){const row=rows[i],url=newsUrlIdentity_(urls[i][0]);if(url)known.add(url);rememberTitle_(known,{date:row[0],country:row[1],publisher:row[2],entity:entityKey_(row[3]),title:row[4]});}
  }
  knownUrlsMemory_={revision,known};return known;
}

function fetchFeedBatch_(feeds){
  const results=feeds.map(()=>({}));let pending=feeds.map((feed,index)=>({feed,index,url:feed.url}));
  for(let hop=0;pending.length;hop++){
    let responses;const requests=pending.map(({url})=>({url,muteHttpExceptions:true,followRedirects:false,headers:{Accept:'application/rss+xml, application/xml','User-Agent':'NewsRadar/1.0'}}));
    try{responses=UrlFetchApp.fetchAll(requests);}
    catch(error){
      const pause=serviceQuotaPause_(error);if(pause){error.quota=true;error.retryable=true;properties_().setProperty('FETCH_PAUSED_UNTIL',String(Date.now()+pause));for(const item of pending)results[item.index]={error};break;}
      if(pending.length===1){error.retryable=true;results[pending[0].index]={error};break;}
      responses=requests.map((request,index)=>{try{return UrlFetchApp.fetchAll([request])[0];}catch(failure){failure.retryable=true;results[pending[index].index]={error:failure};return null;}});
    }
    const next=[];
    pending.forEach((item,index)=>{
      const response=responses[index];if(!response)return;const status=response.getResponseCode();
      if(![301,302,303,307,308].includes(status)){results[item.index]={response};return;}
      const headers=response.getAllHeaders(),location=Object.entries(headers).find(([key])=>key.toLowerCase()==='location')?.[1];
      const raw=String(Array.isArray(location)?location[0]:location||''),origin=item.url.match(/^https:\/\/[^/]+/)[0];
      const path=item.url.split('?')[0],url=canonicalUrl_(raw.startsWith('//')?'https:'+raw:raw.startsWith('/')?origin+raw:raw.startsWith('?')?path+raw:/^https?:/i.test(raw)?raw:raw&&!/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i.test(raw)?path.slice(0,path.lastIndexOf('/')+1)+raw:'');
      if(hop>=3||!url||!domainMatches_(url,item.feed.domain)){results[item.index]={error:Error('HTTP '+status+': redirección no permitida o demasiados saltos')};return;}
      next.push({...item,url});
    });
    pending=next;
  }
  return results;
}

function validateTaxonomy_(blocks){
  if(!Array.isArray(blocks)||!blocks.length||blocks.length>60)throw Error('Define los bloques funcionales del catálogo.');
  const names=new Set(),ids=new Set();let count=0;
  for(const block of blocks){
    if(!block||!/^\d{2}\..{1,100}$/.test(block.name)||names.has(block.name)||!Array.isArray(block.functions)||!Array.isArray(block.terms)||!Array.isArray(block.emerging)||block.terms.length>80||block.emerging.length>20||block.terms.some(term=>typeof term!=='string'||!term.trim()||term.length>100))throw Error('Bloque funcional no válido o duplicado.');
    names.add(block.name);
    const concepts=new Set();for(const concept of block.emerging){if(!concept||typeof concept.name!=='string'||!concept.name.trim()||concept.name.length>100||concepts.has(taxonomyText(concept.name))||!Array.isArray(concept.terms)||!concept.terms.length||concept.terms.length>24||concept.terms.some(term=>typeof term!=='string'||!term.trim()||term.length>100)||('primary' in concept&&typeof concept.primary!=='boolean'))throw Error('Concepto emergente no válido.');concepts.add(taxonomyText(concept.name));}
    for(const row of [...block.functions,...block.emerging])for(const key of ['context','exclude','primaryTerms'])if(row[key]!==undefined&&(!Array.isArray(row[key])||row[key].length>24||row[key].some(term=>typeof term!=='string'||!term.trim()||term.length>200)))throw Error('Condición funcional no válida.');
    for(const row of block.functions){
      if(!row||!/^\d{2}\.\d{2}$/.test(row.id)||!row.id.startsWith(block.name.slice(0,3))||ids.has(row.id)||typeof row.name!=='string'||!row.name.trim()||row.name.length>200||!Array.isArray(row.terms)||row.terms.length>24||row.terms.some(term=>typeof term!=='string'||!term.trim()||term.length>200))throw Error('Funcionalidad no válida o duplicada: '+row?.id);
      if(row.description!==undefined&&(typeof row.description!=='string'||row.description.length>10000))throw Error('Descripción funcional no válida.');ids.add(row.id);count++;
    }
  }
  if(count>1000||JSON.stringify(functionalRuleSettings(blocks)).length>40000)throw Error('El catálogo funcional excede los límites de almacenamiento.');
}
function functionalCatalogRows_(sheets){
  const blocks=new Map();
  for(const rows of sheets){
    const header=rows.findIndex(row=>row.includes('Bloque funcional')&&row.includes('Funcionalidad/Sub Operativa'));
    if(header<0)throw Error('No se encuentran las columnas del catálogo funcional.');
    const columns=rows[header],idColumn=columns.indexOf('ID'),blockColumn=columns.indexOf('Bloque funcional'),functionColumn=columns.indexOf('Funcionalidad/Sub Operativa'),descriptionColumn=columns.indexOf('Descripción');
    for(const row of rows.slice(header+1)){
      const id=String(row[idColumn]||'').trim();if(!/^\d{2}\.\d{2}$/.test(id))continue;
      const name=String(row[blockColumn]||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(),label=id.slice(0,2)+'.'+name,key=[...blocks.keys()].find(key=>taxonomyText(key)===taxonomyText(label))||label;
      if(!blocks.has(key))blocks.set(key,{name:key,terms:[],emerging:[],functions:[]});
      blocks.get(key).functions.push({id,name:String(row[functionColumn]||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(),terms:[],description:descriptionColumn<0?'':String(row[descriptionColumn]||'').trim()});
    }
  }
  const result=[...blocks.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'es'));validateTaxonomy_(result);
  if(!result.some(row=>row.name.startsWith('08.'))||!result.some(row=>row.name.startsWith('20.')))throw Error('Catálogo incompleto: faltan Financiación o Venta Digital.');
  return result;
}
let functionalCatalogMemory_;
function functionalCatalog_(){
 const revision=properties_().getProperty('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_REVISION')||'seed';if(functionalCatalogMemory_?.revision===revision)return functionalCatalogMemory_.items;
 const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key='functional-catalog:'+revision,cached=readDashboardCache_(cache,key);let items=cached;
 if(!items){
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('CatalogoFuncional'),blocks=new Map();
  if(revision!=='seed'&&sheet?.getLastRow()>1)for(const [id,name,label,description] of sheet.getRange(2,1,sheet.getLastRow()-1,4).getDisplayValues()){if(!blocks.has(name))blocks.set(name,{name,functions:[]});blocks.get(name).functions.push({id,name:label,description});}
  items=blocks.size?[...blocks.values()]:FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_SEED;writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,items);
 }functionalCatalogMemory_={revision,items};return items;
}
function functionalConfiguration_(config){return {...config,taxonomy:functionalCatalogRules(functionalCatalog_(),config.taxonomy)};}

function writeFunctionalCatalog_(blocks){
 const descriptions=new Map(FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_SEED.flatMap(block=>block.functions.map(row=>[row.id,row])));
 const catalogue=blocks.map(({name,functions})=>({name,functions:functions.map(({id,name,description})=>({id,name,description:description||(descriptions.get(id)?.name===name?descriptions.get(id).description:'')||''}))})),revision=sha256_(JSON.stringify(catalogue)),p=properties_();
 let sheet=book_().getSheetByName('CatalogoFuncional');if(revision===p.getProperty('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_REVISION')&&sheet?.getLastRow()>1)return false;
 if(!sheet){sheet=book_().insertSheet('CatalogoFuncional');sheet.getRange(1,1,1,4).setValues([RADAR.sheets.CatalogoFuncional]);sheet.setFrozenRows(1);}
 const rows=catalogue.flatMap(block=>block.functions.map(row=>[row.id,block.name,row.name,row.description])),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1;
 sheet.getRange(2,1,rows.length,4).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(rows);if(count>rows.length)sheet.getRange(rows.length+2,1,count-rows.length,4).clearContent();
 p.setProperty('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_REVISION',revision);functionalCatalogMemory_={revision,items:catalogue};invalidateConfiguration_();return true;
}
function refreshFunctionalCatalog_(){
 const config=configuration_();if(!config.settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl)return {source:'espejo',detail:'Se utiliza el último espejo del catálogo.'};
 const started=Date.now();
 try{
  const id=config.settings.taxonomyCatalogUrl.match(/\/d\/([\w-]+)/)[1];if(id===properties_().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'))throw Error('El maestro debe ser un documento distinto del libro de News Radar.');
  const book=SpreadsheetApp.openById(id),names=['Soluciones Funcionales','Capacidades canal (core y VD)'];
  const tables=names.map(name=>{const sheet=book.getSheetByName(name);if(!sheet||sheet.getLastRow()>1500)throw Error('Pestaña del catálogo ausente o fuera de límite: '+name);return sheet.getRange(1,1,sheet.getLastRow(),6).getDisplayValues();});
  const changed=writeFunctionalCatalog_(functionalCatalogRows_(tables));
  if(changed){requestNewsClassification_(true);requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);}
  properties_().setProperty('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG_SYNCED',new Date().toISOString());telemetry_('catalogo_funcional',Date.now()-started,'OK',changed?'Espejo actualizado desde el maestro de Drive':'Sin cambios en el maestro de Drive');return {source:'drive',changed};
 }catch(error){const detail=String(error.message).slice(0,180);telemetry_('catalogo_funcional',Date.now()-started,'Error',detail);return {source:'espejo',error:detail};}
}

// Official labels and descriptions come exclusively from the read-only catalogue mirror.
function functionalCatalogRules(catalogue,rules){
 const aliases=new Map(rules.flatMap(block=>block.functions.map(row=>[row.id,row])));
 return catalogue.map(block=>{
  const ids=new Set(block.functions.map(row=>row.id)),rule=rules.find(row=>row.name===block.name)||rules.find(row=>row.functions.some(item=>ids.has(item.id)));
  return {...block,terms:rule?.terms||[],emerging:rule?.emerging||[],functions:block.functions.map(row=>{const alias=aliases.get(row.id);return {...row,terms:alias?.terms||[],context:alias?.context||[],exclude:alias?.exclude||[]};})};
 });
}
function functionalRuleSettings(blocks){
 return blocks.map(({name,terms,emerging,functions})=>({name,terms,emerging:emerging.map(functionalConditions),functions:functions.map(({id,terms,context,exclude})=>functionalConditions({id,terms,context,exclude}))}));
}
function functionalConditions({context,exclude,...row}){return {...row,...(context?.length?{context}:{}),...(exclude?.length?{exclude}:{})};}

function configurationStorageKey_(name){return name==='Noticias'?newsStorageKey_():name==='Taxonomia'?taxonomyStorageKey_():NEWSLETTER_ARCHIVE_TABLES.includes(name)?newsletterStorageKey_(name):name;}
function generationSheet_(name,headers){let sheet=book_().getSheetByName(name);if(!sheet)sheet=book_().insertSheet(name);if(sheet.getLastRow()===0)sheet.getRange(1,1,1,headers.length).setValues([headers]);return sheet;}

function writeVerifiedRows_(sheet,records){
  if(!records.length)return;
  const ordered=records.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.row-b.row),width=ordered[0].values.length,needed=ordered.at(-1).row;
  if(needed>sheet.getMaxRows())sheet.insertRowsAfter(sheet.getMaxRows(),needed-sheet.getMaxRows());
  const writes=[];
  for(let start=0;start<ordered.length;){
    let end=start+1;while(end<ordered.length&&ordered[end].row-ordered[end-1].row<=64&&ordered[end].row-ordered[start].row<250)end++;
    const first=ordered[start].row,size=ordered[end-1].row-first+1,rows=size===end-start?ordered.slice(start,end).map(record=>record.values):sheet.getRange(first,1,size,width).getDisplayValues();
    if(size!==end-start)for(const record of ordered.slice(start,end))rows[record.row-first]=record.values;
    sheet.getRange(first,1,size,width).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(rows);writes.push({first,rows});start=end;
  }
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  for(const {first,rows} of writes)if(sha256_(JSON.stringify(rows))!==sha256_(JSON.stringify(sheet.getRange(first,1,rows.length,width).getDisplayValues())))throw Error('La verificación del backup o de la generación ha fallado.');
}

function compactStorageDimensions_(){
  for(const sheet of book_().getSheets()){
    const name=sheet.getName(),schema=Object.keys(RADAR.sheets).find(key=>name===key||name.startsWith(key+'_'));if(!schema)continue;
    const rows=Math.max(1,sheet.getLastRow())+100,columns=Math.max(RADAR.sheets[schema]?.length||4,sheet.getLastColumn());
    if(sheet.getMaxRows()>rows)sheet.deleteRows(rows+1,sheet.getMaxRows()-rows);
    if(sheet.getMaxColumns()>columns)sheet.deleteColumns(columns+1,sheet.getMaxColumns()-columns);
  }
}

let newsletterKeyMemory_;
function newsletterItemKeys_(row){
  if(!newsletterKeyMemory_)newsletterKeyMemory_=new WeakMap();if(newsletterKeyMemory_.has(row))return newsletterKeyMemory_.get(row);
  const url=canonicalUrl_(row.url),keys=[...(url?['url:'+sha256_(url)]:[]),'text:'+sha256_(recordText(row.titular)+'\n'+recordText(row.extracto))];
  newsletterKeyMemory_.set(row,keys);return keys;
}
function newsletterSentContent_(deliveries){
  const recipients=new Map();
  for(const delivery of deliveries){
    if(String(delivery.id||'').startsWith('prueba:')||!delivery.suscripcion||!['Enviada','Enviando','Revisar'].includes(delivery.estado))continue;
    const email=newsletterEmail_(delivery.correo),keys=JSON.parse(delivery.contenido||'[]');
    if(!Array.isArray(keys)||keys.some(key=>!/^(url|text):[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(key)))throw Error('Registro de contenido no válido. Revisa el envío '+delivery.id+' antes de continuar.');
    if(!recipients.has(email))recipients.set(email,new Set());for(const key of keys)recipients.get(email).add(key);
  }
  return recipients;
}
function newsletterWasSent_(row,known){return known.size>0&&newsletterItemKeys_(row).some(key=>known.has(key));}
function newsletterUnseen_(rows,known){
  const seen=new Set();
  return rows.filter(row=>{const keys=newsletterItemKeys_(row);if(keys.some(key=>known.has(key)||seen.has(key)))return false;for(const key of keys)seen.add(key);return true;});
}

function newsletterContentDetail_(content){return content.count+' noticias incluidas'+(content.omitted?'; '+content.omitted+' noticias repetidas omitidas':'')+(content.editorial?.reusedCount?'; '+content.editorial.reusedCount+' ejemplos reutilizados en su tema':'');}

<section id="llm-section" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="admin-tab-llm" hidden>
 <div class="panel"><div class="panel-header"><h2>Categorización LLM</h2></div><p class="muted">Clasificación offline en un proyecto GPT. Descarga los pendientes, procesa los lotes y vuelve a importar los JSON o ZIP_STORED. Las noticias sin resultado válido conservan la clasificación determinista.</p><p class="muted">Solo una clasificación LLM vigente con evidencia fuerte sustituye al determinista; las abstenciones y los resultados débiles conservan el determinista.</p>

function collectionRequests_(){
  return Object.entries(properties_().getProperties()).filter(([key])=>key.startsWith('COLLECTION_REQUEST:')).map(([key,value])=>({key,value,...JSON.parse(value)}));
}
function requestCollection_(kind,range){
  const id=kind==='daily'?'daily/'+range.to+'/'+Utilities.getUuid():Utilities.getUuid(),request={id,kind,range,created:new Date().toISOString()};
  properties_().setProperty('COLLECTION_REQUEST:'+sha256_(kind+'|'+range.from+'|'+range.to),JSON.stringify(request));
  CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('collection-status');ensureBackgroundWorker_();
}
function collectionJobs_(){return rows_('Recargas').map((job,index)=>({...job,row:index+2}));}
function writeCollectionJob_(job){
  book_().getSheetByName('Recargas').getRange(job.row,1,1,RADAR.sheets.Recargas.length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues([RADAR.sheets.Recargas.map(key=>safeCell_(job[key]??''))]);
}
function jobRange_(job){return {from:job.desde,to:job.hasta};}
function drainCollectionRequests_(){
  const requests=collectionRequests_().sort((a,b)=>(b.kind==='daily')-(a.kind==='daily'));if(!requests.length)return;
  const jobs=collectionJobs_(),tasks=rows_('Recopilacion');
  const finished=new Set(jobs.filter(job=>['Completada','Parcial'].includes(job.estado)).map(job=>job.id)),sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion');
  let end=tasks.length;
  while(end){if(!finished.has(tasks[end-1].ciclo)||tasks[end-1].estado==='Error'){end--;continue;}let start=end-1;while(start&&finished.has(tasks[start-1].ciclo)&&tasks[start-1].estado!=='Error')start--;sheet.deleteRows(start+2,end-start);end=start;}
  const existing=new Set(tasks.filter(task=>!finished.has(task.ciclo)||task.estado==='Error').map(task=>task.ciclo+'|'+task.url));
  for(const request of requests){
    let job=jobs.find(job=>job.id===request.id)||jobs.find(job=>(Number(job.pendientes)>0||job.estado==='Preparando')&&job.tipo===request.kind&&(request.kind==='annual'||(job.desde===request.range.from&&job.hasta===request.range.to)));
    if(!job){
      job={id:request.id,tipo:request.kind,desde:request.range.from,hasta:request.range.to,inicio:request.created,estado:'Preparando',total:0,procesadas:0,pendientes:0,omitidas:0,fallidas:0,nuevas:0,actualizada:'',pausa:'',fin:'',row:book_().getSheetByName('Recargas').getLastRow()+1};
      append_('Recargas',[RADAR.sheets.Recargas.map(key=>job[key])]);jobs.push(job);SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    }
    if(job.estado==='Preparando'){
      const feeds=collectionFeeds_(jobRange_(job)),missing=feeds.filter(feed=>!existing.has(job.id+'|'+feed.url));
      append_('Recopilacion',missing.map(feed=>[job.id,feed.name,feed.url,'Pendiente',0,'',0,0,'',feed.range.to]));
      Object.assign(job,{estado:feeds.length?'Pendiente':'Completada',total:feeds.length,pendientes:feeds.length,fin:feeds.length?'':new Date().toISOString()});writeCollectionJob_(job);SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    }
    if(properties_().getProperty(request.key)===request.value)properties_().deleteProperty(request.key);
  }
  CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('collection-status');
}
function collectionSnapshots_(tasks,jobs,now=new Date()){
  const counters=new Map();
  for(const task of tasks){
    let count=counters.get(task.ciclo);if(!count){count={total:0,procesadas:0,pendientes:0,omitidas:0,fallidas:0,nuevas:0,actualizada:''};counters.set(task.ciclo,count);}
    count.total++;count.nuevas+=Number(task.nuevas||0);
    if(task.estado==='Completada')count.procesadas++;
    if(['Pendiente','Reintento programado'].includes(task.estado))count.pendientes++;
    if(task.estado==='Omitida')count.omitidas++;
    if(task.estado==='Error')count.fallidas++;
    if(task.actualizada>count.actualizada)count.actualizada=task.actualizada;
  }
  for(const job of jobs){
    const count=counters.get(job.id);if(!count)continue;
    Object.assign(job,count,{estado:count.pendientes?(Number(job.pausa)>now.getTime()?'En pausa':'Pendiente'):count.fallidas?'Parcial':'Completada',fin:count.pendientes?'':job.fin||now.toISOString()});
    if(!count.pendientes&&dashboardSnapshotsPending_()){job.estado='Publicando';job.fin='';requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);}
  }
  return jobs;
}
