function collectionRange_(mode,now){
  if(!['today','year'].includes(mode))throw Error('Selecciona Hoy o Último año.');
  const to=calendarDate_(now),from=new Date(to);if(mode==='year'){const month=from.getUTCMonth();from.setUTCFullYear(from.getUTCFullYear()-1);if(from.getUTCMonth()!==month)from.setUTCDate(0);}
  return {from:from.toISOString().slice(0,10),to:to.toISOString().slice(0,10)};
}
function collectionWindows_(range){
  const windows=[],first=Date.parse(range.from),cursor=Date.parse(range.to);
  for(let to=cursor;to>=first;to-=COLLECTION_POLICY.windowDays*86400000)windows.push({from:new Date(Math.max(first,to-(COLLECTION_POLICY.windowDays-1)*86400000)).toISOString().slice(0,10),to:new Date(to).toISOString().slice(0,10)});
  return windows;
}
function collectionFeeds_(range){
  const enabled=feeds_(),windows=collectionWindows_(range);
  const rss=enabled.filter(feed=>feed.kind==='rss').flatMap(feed=>domainMatches_(feed.url,'news.google.com')?windows.map(window=>collectionProfile_(feed,window)):[{...feed,range}]);
  const profiles=enabled.filter(feed=>feed.kind==='profile');
  const selected=rss.concat(windows.flatMap(window=>profiles.flatMap(base=>{
    const variants=[base,{...base,capabilitySearch:true}];
    return variants.map(feed=>collectionProfile_(feed,window)).filter(Boolean);
  })));
  const primary=new Set(configuration_().applicationScope.find(scope=>scope.name==='Empresas e instituciones').countries),seen=new Set();
  return selected.filter(feed=>{if(seen.has(feed.url))return false;seen.add(feed.url);return true;}).sort((a,b)=>String(b.range?.to||'').localeCompare(String(a.range?.to||''))||Number(primary.has(b.country))-Number(primary.has(a.country)));
}

function splitCollectionFeed_(feed){
  if(!feed.range||feed.range.from===feed.range.to)return [];
  const from=Date.parse(feed.range.from),to=Date.parse(feed.range.to),mid=from+Math.floor((to-from)/86400000/2)*86400000;
  const ranges=[{from:feed.range.from,to:new Date(mid).toISOString().slice(0,10)},{from:new Date(mid+86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10),to:feed.range.to}];
  return ranges.reverse().map(range=>collectionProfile_(feed,range)).filter(Boolean);
}
function collectionTaskFeed_(task,feeds,range){
  if(feeds.has(task.url))return {...feeds.get(task.url),range};
  const base=feeds.get('source:'+task.fuente);if(!base||(base.kind!=='profile'&&!domainMatches_(base.url,'news.google.com')))return null;
  const periodRange=collectionQueryRange_(task.url);if(!periodRange)return null;
  if(base.kind==='rss'){const feed=collectionProfile_(base,periodRange);return feed.url===task.url?feed:null;}
  const variants=[base,{...base,capabilitySearch:true}];
  for(const variant of variants){const feed=collectionProfile_(variant,periodRange);if(feed?.url===task.url)return feed;}
  return null;
}

function collectionRecentRange_(now){
  const to=calendarDate_(now),from=new Date(to);from.setUTCDate(from.getUTCDate()-settings_().windowDays);
  return {from:from.toISOString().slice(0,10),to:to.toISOString().slice(0,10)};
}

function collectionProfile_(base,range){
  if(base.kind==='rss'&&domainMatches_(base.url,'news.google.com')){
    const query=decodeURIComponent((base.url.match(/[?&]q=([^&]*)/)||[])[1]||'').replace(/\s*when:\d+d\b/g,'').replace(/\s*(?:after|before):\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/g,'').trim();
    return {...base,range,url:canonicalUrl_(base.url.replace(/([?&]q=)[^&]*/,(_,prefix)=>prefix+encodeURIComponent(collectionPeriod_(range)+' '+query)))};
  }
  const config=configuration_(),entity=config.entities.find(row=>row.name===base.entity),geo=config.geographies.find(row=>row.name===base.country);
  const feed=profileFeed_(geo,entity,range,base.capabilitySearch);return feed?{...feed,range}:null;
}
function collectionFeedIndex_(){
  const index=new Map();for(const feed of feeds_()){index.set(feed.url,feed);index.set('source:'+feed.name,feed);}return index;
}

function initializeCollectionQueue_(){
  const value=properties_().getProperty('COLLECTION_RANGE'),range=value?JSON.parse(value):null,paused=properties_().getProperty('COLLECTION_AFTER')||'',tasks=rows_('Recopilacion'),jobs=collectionJobs_();
  for(const job of jobs)if(job.tipo==='manual'){job.tipo='daily';writeCollectionJob_(job);}
  if(tasks.length){
    const jobIndex=new Map(jobs.map(job=>[job.id,job]));
    const priorities=tasks.map(task=>{if(task.prioridad)return task.prioridad;const before=task.url.match(/before(?::|%3A)(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/i);return before?new Date(Date.parse(before[1])-86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10):jobIndex.get(task.ciclo)?.hasta||range?.to||calendarDate_(new Date()).toISOString().slice(0,10);});
    book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion').getRange(2,10,tasks.length,1).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(priorities.map(value=>[value]));
    for(const id of new Set(tasks.map(task=>task.ciclo)))if(!jobs.some(job=>job.id===id)){
      const dates=tasks.filter(task=>task.ciclo===id).map(task=>task.actualizada).filter(Boolean).sort(),period=range||{from:priorities.slice().sort()[0],to:priorities.slice().sort().at(-1)};
      const job={id,tipo:Date.parse(period.to)-Date.parse(period.from)>7*86400000?'annual':'daily',desde:period.from,hasta:period.to,inicio:dates[0]||new Date().toISOString(),fin:'',estado:'Pendiente',total:0,procesadas:0,pendientes:0,omitidas:0,fallidas:0,nuevas:0,actualizada:'',pausa:paused};
      collectionSnapshots_(tasks,[job]);append_('Recargas',[RADAR.sheets.Recargas.map(key=>job[key])]);jobs.push(job);
    }
  }
  properties_().deleteProperty('COLLECTION_RANGE');properties_().deleteProperty('COLLECTION_AFTER');CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('collection-status');
}

function collectionQueryRange_(url){
  let query;try{query=decodeURIComponent((url.match(/[?&]q=([^&]*)/)||[])[1]||'');}catch(_){return null;}
  const period=query.match(/after:(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}) before:(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/);if(!period)return null;
  const after=Date.parse(period[1]),before=Date.parse(period[2]);
  if(!Number.isFinite(after)||!Number.isFinite(before)||new Date(after).toISOString().slice(0,10)!==period[1]||new Date(before).toISOString().slice(0,10)!==period[2]||before-after<2*86400000)return null;
  return {from:new Date(after+86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10),to:new Date(before-86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10)};
}
function upgradeCollectionQueries_(){
  const feeds=collectionFeedIndex_(),tasks=rows_('Recopilacion'),urls=tasks.map(task=>[task.url]);let changed=false;
  tasks.forEach((task,index)=>{
    const base=feeds.get('source:'+task.fuente),range=collectionQueryRange_(task.url);if(!base||(base.kind!=='profile'&&!domainMatches_(base.url,'news.google.com'))||!range||!['Pendiente','Reintento programado'].includes(task.estado))return;
    if(collectionTaskFeed_(task,feeds,range))return;
    const feed=collectionProfile_(base,range);if(!feed)return;
    urls[index]=[feed.url];changed=true;
  });
  if(changed)book_().getSheetByName('Recopilacion').getRange(2,3,urls.length,1).setValues(urls);
}

function recoveryAvailability(jobs,requests=[]){
  const active=jobs.filter(job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||['Preparando','En curso','En cola'].includes(job.estado));
  return {today:active.some(job=>job.tipo==='daily')||requests.some(request=>request.kind==='daily'),year:active.some(job=>job.tipo==='annual')||requests.some(request=>request.kind==='annual')};
}

function recoveryProgressJobs(jobs){
  const grouped=new Map();
  const active=job=>Number(job.pendientes)>0||['Preparando','En curso','En cola'].includes(job.estado);
  for(const job of jobs){
    const current=grouped.get(job.tipo);
    if(!current||Number(active(job))>Number(active(current))||(active(job)===active(current)&&String(job.inicio)>String(current.inicio)))grouped.set(job.tipo,job);
  }
  return [...grouped.values()].sort((a,b)=>Number(b.tipo==='daily')-Number(a.tipo==='daily')||String(a.tipo).localeCompare(String(b.tipo)));
}

function publisherKey_(value){const text=String(value||'').trim();return /^bbva(?:\s*[·-]\s*empresas|\s+empresas|\s+noticias)?$/i.test(text)?'BBVA':text;}
function plainText_(value) {
  const html=String(value||'').replace(/<\s*(\/?)\s*(h)\s*([1-6])\s*>/gi,'<$1$2$3>').replace(/(^|\s)(?:le|h[1-6]|article)\s*>/gi,'$1'), parts=[];
  let cursor=0, hidden='';
  // Extrae texto para clasificación. El cliente escapa este texto al mostrarlo.
  for(const tag of html.matchAll(/<!--[\s\S]*?(?:-->|$)|<[^>]*(?:>|$)/g)){
    if(!hidden)parts.push(html.slice(cursor,tag.index),' ');
    const name=tag[0].match(/^<\s*(\/?)\s*(script|style)\b/i);
    if(name){
      const kind=name[2].toLowerCase();
      if(!name[1]&&!hidden)hidden=kind;
      else if(name[1]&&hidden===kind)hidden='';
    }
    cursor=tag.index+tag[0].length;
  }
  if(!hidden)parts.push(html.slice(cursor));
  return parts.join('').replace(/&#(x[\da-f]+|\d+);/gi,(_,n)=>String.fromCodePoint(Math.min(parseInt(n[0].toLowerCase()==='x'?n.slice(1):n,n[0].toLowerCase()==='x'?16:10),0x10ffff))).replace(/&(?:amp|lt|gt|quot|apos|nbsp);/g,m=>({'&amp;':'&','&lt;':'<','&gt;':'>','&quot;':'"','&apos;':"'",'&nbsp;':' '})[m]).replace(/<\/?[a-z][^>]*(?:>|$)/gi,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
}
function canonicalUrl_(value) {
  const match = String(value || '').trim().match(/^https:\/\/([a-z0-9.-]+)(?::443)?(\/[^#?]*)?(?:\?([^#]*))?(?:#.*)?$/i);
  if (!match) return '';
  const query = (match[3] || '').split('&').filter(x=>x&&!/^(utm_\w+|fbclid|gclid)=/i.test(x)).sort().join('&');
  return 'https://' + match[1].toLowerCase() + (match[2] || '/') + (query?'?'+query:'');
}
function domainMatches_(url, domain) {
  const host = (url.match(/^https:\/\/([^/]+)/)||[])[1] || '';
  return host === domain || host.endsWith('.'+domain);
}
let businessIndexMemory_;
const newsRelevanceMemory_=new WeakMap();
function newsRelevance_(row){
  if(!newsRelevanceMemory_.has(row))newsRelevanceMemory_.set(row,Number(savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion).score||0));
  return newsRelevanceMemory_.get(row);
}
function packNews_(row){return [row,newsRelevanceMemory_.get(row)??0];}
function unpackNews_(record){newsRelevanceMemory_.set(record[0],record[1]);return record[0];}
function businessIndex_(){
  const config=configuration_();if(businessIndexMemory_?.config===config)return businessIndexMemory_;
  const entities=new Map(),entityTerms=new Map();for(const row of config.entities){const terms=[row.name,...row.aliases].map(searchText_);entityTerms.set(row.name,terms);for(const term of terms)entities.set(term,row);}
  const rules=rows=>rows.filter(row=>row.enabled).map(row=>{const terms=[...new Set(row.terms.map(searchText_))];return {...row,terms,pattern:phrasePattern_(terms),context:(row.context||[]).map(searchText_),contextPattern:phrasePattern_((row.context||[]).map(searchText_)),exclude:(row.exclude||[]).map(searchText_),excludePattern:phrasePattern_((row.exclude||[]).map(searchText_))};});
  const capabilities=Object.entries(config.capabilities).flatMap(([segment,rows])=>rules(rows).map(row=>({...row,segment}))),aliases=[...entities].filter(([,row])=>row.enabled).sort((a,b)=>b[0].length-a[0].length);
  const relevance=Object.fromEntries(RELEVANCE_ROLES.map(role=>[role,phrasePattern_(config.relevanceRules.filter(row=>row.enabled&&row.role===role).flatMap(row=>row.terms.map(searchText_)))]));
  const serviceNames=phrasePattern_(aliases.filter(([alias])=>alias.includes(' ')&&relevance.service.test(alias)).map(([alias])=>alias),'g');
  const catalogue=config.taxonomy.flatMap(block=>block.functions.map(row=>({name:row.id+'.'+row.name,segment:'Empresas',pattern:phrasePattern_([row.name,...row.terms].map(searchText_))})));
  const cataloguePattern=phrasePattern_(config.taxonomy.flatMap(block=>block.functions.flatMap(row=>[row.name,...row.terms])).map(searchText_));
  return businessIndexMemory_={cataloguePattern,catalogue,config,entities,entityTerms,aliases,serviceNames,relevance,capabilities,segments:rules(config.segments),signals:rules(config.signals),geographies:config.geographies.filter(row=>row.enabled).map(row=>({...row,terms:[...new Set([row.name,row.searchName,...(row.terms||[])].map(searchText_))]}))};
}
function phrasePattern_(terms,flags=''){return new RegExp('(?:^|[^a-z0-9])(?:'+(terms.map(term=>term.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&').replace(/\\\*/g,'[a-z0-9]*')).join('|')||'(?!)')+')(?![a-z0-9])',flags);}
function phrasePosition_(text,term){
  let at=-1;while((at=text.indexOf(term,at+1))>=0){if((at===0||!/[a-z0-9]/.test(text[at-1]))&&(at+term.length===text.length||!/[a-z0-9]/.test(text[at+term.length])))return at;}return -1;
}
function phraseMatch_(text,term){return phrasePosition_(text,term)>=0;}
function headlineEntity_(headline,index){
  let entity,first=Infinity;for(const [alias,row] of index.aliases){const position=phrasePosition_(headline,alias);if(position>=0&&position<first){entity=row;first=position;}}return entity;
}
// Exactly one business signal. Operational evidence is evaluated per clause so a
// generic prevention mention cannot mask a separately reported real outage.
function businessSignals_(title,text,index=businessIndex_()){
  const priority=['Problema','Alianza estratégica','Lanzamiento de producto','Mejora de oferta'];
  for(const kind of priority){
    const row=index.signals.find(rule=>kind==='Problema'?rule.group===kind:rule.name===kind);
    if(!row)continue;
    const scope=row.scope==='headline'?title:text;
    const clauses=kind==='Problema'?scope.split(/[.;!?\n]+|\b(?:pero|however|but)\b/):[scope];
    if(clauses.some(value=>{
      const evidence=kind==='Alianza estratégica'?value.replace(/\bde acuerdo con\b/g,' '):value;
      const denied=kind==='Problema'&&/\b(?:no|nunca)\s+(?:(?:se|han?|ha)\s+)?(?:hay|hubo|existe[n]?|reporta[n]?|reportado|registra[n]?|registrado|sufre[n]?|detecta[n]?|detectado)\b.{0,50}\b(?:caida[s]?|fallo[s]?|problema[s]?|incidencia[s]?|interrupcion|outage[s]?)\b/.test(value);
      return !denied&&row.pattern.test(evidence)&&(!row.exclude.length||!row.excludePattern.test(evidence))&&(!row.context.length||row.contextPattern.test(kind==='Problema'?evidence:text));
    }))return [row];
  }
  return [];
}
function digitalAssessment_(title,text,index=businessIndex_()){
  // Entity names are not evidence of a service (for example, Mercado Pago).
  const headline=title;title=title.replace(index.serviceNames,' ');text=text.replace(index.serviceNames,' ');
  const capabilities=index.capabilities.filter(row=>row.pattern.test(text));
  let business=index.segments.some(row=>row.pattern.test(text.replace(/\bbusiness (?:days?|hours?)\b/g,' '))),channel=index.relevance.channel.test(text),shared=index.relevance.shared.test(title);
  if(!capabilities.length&&business&&channel&&index.cataloguePattern.test(text))capabilities.push(...index.catalogue.filter(row=>row.pattern.test(text)));
  const signals=businessSignals_(title,text,index),change=signals.length>0,problem=signals.some(row=>row.group==='Problema'),editorial=(index.relevance.editorial.test(title.replace(/\breport\b/g,' '))||index.relevance.editorial.test(title)&&!change),excluded=headlineEntity_(headline,index)?.name==='Santander'&&santanderExcluded_(text)||index.relevance.corporate.test(title)||index.relevance.incidental.test(title)||!problem&&!business&&index.relevance.retail.test(text);
  const incident=problem&&(channel||index.relevance.service.test(text))&&Boolean(headlineEntity_(text,index))&&!excluded&&!editorial;
  if(incident){business=true;channel=true;if(!capabilities.length)capabilities.push({segment:'Empresas',name:/\b(?:pagos|transferencias|payments|transfers)\b/.test(text)?'Pagos':/\b(?:app|movil|mobile)\b/.test(text)?'Aplicaciones móviles empresariales':'Banca electrónica corporativa',pattern:index.relevance.service});}
  const relevant=incident||Boolean(capabilities.length&&!excluded&&!editorial&&(!problem||business||index.relevance.infrastructure.test(text))&&(business&&(channel||shared)&&(index.relevance.service.test(text)||headlineEntity_(headline,index))||shared&&(channel||change||index.relevance.infrastructure.test(title))));
  if(relevant&&!signals.length)signals.push({name:'Mejora de oferta',group:'Novedad',scope:'fullText',pattern:/(?!) /});
  const score=relevant?4+Math.min(3,capabilities.length)+(business?2:0)+(change?2:0):0;
  const evidence=(pattern,value)=>pattern.exec(value)?.[0]?.trim().slice(0,120)||'';
  return {capabilities,score,channel,change,editorial,excluded,relevant,business,shared,signals:signals.map(row=>row.name),evidence:{segmento:index.segments.map(row=>evidence(row.pattern,text)).filter(Boolean).slice(0,3),canal:evidence(index.relevance.channel,text),capacidades:capabilities.slice(0,8).map(row=>({nombre:row.name,texto:evidence(row.pattern,text)})),senales:signals.map(row=>({nombre:row.name,texto:evidence(row.pattern,row.scope==='headline'?title:text)})),corporativa:evidence(index.relevance.corporate,title),retail:!business?evidence(index.relevance.retail,text):'',editorial:evidence(index.relevance.editorial,title)}};
}
function classification_(title,text,includeLabels=true){
  const index=businessIndex_(),assessment=digitalAssessment_(title,text,index);
  const signals=assessment.signals;
  const segments=assessment.relevant?[sectorNewsDefaults.segment]:index.segments.filter(row=>row.pattern.test(text)).map(row=>row.name);
  return {signals,assessment,segments,labels:includeLabels?{...newsLabels_(assessment),contentHash:sha256_(JSON.stringify([title,text]))}:undefined};
}
let sourceGeographyMemory_;
function sourceCountry_(feed,index=businessIndex_()){
  const country=index.config.geographies.find(geo=>searchText_(geo.name)===searchText_(feed.country));
  if(country)return country.name;
  if(!domainMatches_(feed.url||'','news.google.com'))return '';
  const text=searchText_(feed.name),matches=index.geographies.filter(geo=>geo.terms.some(term=>phraseMatch_(text,term)));
  if(matches.length===1)return matches[0].name;
  const code=(String(feed.url).match(/[?&](?:gl|ceid)=([a-z]{2})(?:[&:]|%3A|$)/i)||[])[1];
  return index.config.geographies.find(geo=>geo.code===code?.toUpperCase())?.name||'';
}
function sourceGeographies_(index=businessIndex_()){
  if(sourceGeographyMemory_?.config===index.config)return sourceGeographyMemory_.values;
  const values=new Map();
  for(const feed of index.config.feeds){const country=sourceCountry_(feed,index);if(country)values.set(searchText_(feed.name),country);}
  for(const entity of index.config.entities)for(const geo of index.config.geographies)for(const name of [entity.name,...entity.aliases])values.set(searchText_(name+' · '+geo.name),geo.name);
  sourceGeographyMemory_={config:index.config,values};return values;
}
const DOMAIN_COUNTRY_CODES=Object.freeze({es:'ES',co:'CO',mx:'MX',ar:'AR',pe:'PE',cl:'CL',br:'BR',uy:'UY',it:'IT',de:'DE',fr:'FR',pt:'PT',uk:'GB',tr:'TR',nl:'NL',be:'BE',ch:'CH',ro:'RO',ca:'CA',au:'AU',in:'IN',sg:'SG',hk:'HK',jp:'JP',kr:'KR',vn:'VN',ph:'PH',my:'MY',th:'TH',ve:'VE',ae:'AE',nz:'NZ',ke:'KE',za:'ZA',id:'ID',il:'IL'});
const DOMAIN_COUNTRY_PUBLISHERS=Object.freeze({"es":["Cinco Días","Bolsamanía","Noticias Bancarias","Territorio Fintech","El Mundo Financiero"],"co":["El Tiempo","Portafolio","La República","Valora Analitik","Revista Semana","Semana","El Espectador","El Colombiano","Caracol Radio","Noticias Caracol","Blu Radio","RCN Radio","Noticias RCN","La FM","W Radio","Pulzo","RED+ Noticias","Más Colombia","Pluralidad Z","Colombia.com","La Opinión Cúcuta","La Opinión","El Frente","Vanguardia","Diario del Norte","El Heraldo","El País Cali","KienyKe","Las2orillas","Cambio Colombia","Dinero"],"mx":["El Economista México","El CEO","Expansión MX","Radio Fórmula","Milenio","El Financiero","El Universal","Excélsior","Grupo en Concreto","Eje Central","TresPm | Noticias"],"ar":["El Cronista","Ámbito","iProfesional","iProUP","Clarín","La Nación","Perfil","FM Noticias 88.1 Salta","TyC Sports"],"pe":["Gestión","Semana Económica"],"cl":["Diario Financiero","La Tercera","Portal Innova","The Clinic","PortalPortuario"],"br":["Valor Econômico","InfoMoney"],"uy":["El Observador","El País Uruguay"]});
const domainCountryIndexes_=new WeakMap();
function domainCountry_(url,publisher,sourceName,index=businessIndex_()){
  let lookup=domainCountryIndexes_.get(index);
  if(!lookup){const countries=new Map(index.geographies.map(geo=>[String(geo.code||'').toLowerCase(),geo.name])),publishers=new Map();for(const [code,names] of Object.entries(DOMAIN_COUNTRY_PUBLISHERS))for(const name of names)publishers.set(searchText_(name),countries.get((DOMAIN_COUNTRY_CODES[code]||code).toLowerCase())||'');lookup={countries,publishers,ambiguous:new Set(['La Nación','La República','La Opinión','El Universal','Vanguardia','El Heraldo'].map(searchText_))};domainCountryIndexes_.set(index,lookup);}
  const country=code=>lookup.countries.get(String(DOMAIN_COUNTRY_CODES[code]||code).toLowerCase())||'';
  if(domainMatches_(url||'','bbva.com')){const region=String(url).match(/^https:\/\/[^/]+\/[a-z]{2}\/([a-z]{2})(?:\/|$)/i),found=region&&country(region[1].toLowerCase());if(found)return found;}
  for(const value of [url,publisher,sourceName]){
    const domains=String(value||'').toLowerCase().match(/(?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)+[a-z]{2,}(?![a-z])/g)||[];
    for(const host of domains){if(host==='t.co'||host==='news.google.com'||host.endsWith('.news.google.com'))continue;const found=country(host.split('.').at(-1));if(found)return found;}
  }
  for(const value of [publisher,sourceName]){const key=searchText_(value),found=lookup.publishers.get(key);if(found){const market=lookup.ambiguous.has(key)&&sourceGeographies_(index).get(searchText_(sourceName));return market&&market!==country('es')?market:found;}}
  return '';
}
function newsCountry_(row,index=businessIndex_()){
  for(const value of [row.titular]){const text=searchText_(value).replace(/[\u2010-\u2015]/g,'-');for(const terms of [geo=>[geo.name,geo.searchName].map(searchText_),geo=>geo.terms]){const matches=index.geographies.filter(geo=>terms(geo).some(term=>phraseMatch_(text,term)));if(matches.length===1)return matches[0].name;}}
  const provenance=savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion).procedencia||{},editorUrl=canonicalUrl_(row.sourceUrl||provenance.medioUrl||'');
  const domain=domainCountry_(row.url,'','',index)||domainCountry_(editorUrl,row.medio,row.fuente,index);if(domain)return domain;
  const excerpt=searchText_(row.extracto).replace(/[\u2010-\u2015]/g,'-'),context=index.geographies.filter(geo=>geo.terms.some(term=>phraseMatch_(excerpt,term)));
  return (context.length===1?context[0].name:'')||sourceGeographies_(index).get(searchText_(row.fuente))||(index.geographies.some(geo=>geo.name===row.pais)?row.pais:settings_().unknownCountry);
}
function santanderExcluded_(text){
  if(!phraseMatch_(text,'santander'))return false;
  if(phrasePattern_(['ayuntamiento de santander','alcaldia de santander','alcalde de santander','alcaldesa de santander','concejal','vecinos de santander','mercado de mexico','bahia de santander','puerto de santander','universidad de cantabria','gobierno de cantabria','diputacion','gobernador de santander','gobernacion de santander','departamento de santander','bucaramanga','barrancabermeja','policia de santander','bomberos de santander','eln','bus incinerado','extorsion','norte de santander','santander y cesar']).test(text))return true;
  if(phrasePattern_(['cucuta','floridablanca','piedecuesta','giron','socorro','san gil','malaga','curos','barbosa','veolia','aguas del','pae','renta ciudadana','soat','mineria ilegal','mineria criminal','granadas','disidencias','farc','ejercito','policia','asesinato','capturados']).test(text)&&!phrasePattern_(['banco santander','banco de santander','grupo santander','santander empresas','santander corporate','santander cib','app de santander','banca','banking','pagos digitales','transferencias']).test(text))return true;
  if(phrasePattern_(['banco santander','banco de santander','grupo santander','santander empresas','santander corporate','santander cib','santander uk','santander brasil','santander mexico','santander chile','santander argentina','santander portugal','getnet','pagonxt','ebury','cash nexus','openbank','ana botin']).test(text))return false;
  return !phrasePattern_(['banco','banca','bank','banking','entidad financiera','clientes del santander','app de santander']).test(text)||/\b(?:en|de|hacia|desde) santander\b/.test(text);
}
function annotateNews_(rows){
  const index=businessIndex_(),items=taxonomyCatalog_(),taxonomy=new Map(items.map(({id,palanca,subpalanca})=>[id,{id,palanca,subpalanca}]));
  return rows.map(row=>{
    const catalog=index.entities.get(searchText_(row.entidad)),assignment=effectiveTaxonomyAssignment_(row,items),classification=savedNewsLabels_(row.clasificacion),labels={digital:classification.digital,capacidades:classification.capacidades};
    if(assignment.editorialExcluded)return null;
    const annotated={...row,clasificacion:JSON.stringify(labels),medio:publisherKey_(row.medio),pais:row.pais||settings_().unknownCountry,...(assignment.evidence?{functionalEvidence:assignment.evidence}:{}),taxonomia:assignment.ids.map(id=>taxonomy.get(id)),etiquetas:labels,entidad:catalog?.name||row.entidad,tipo:catalog?.type||'',segmentos:classification.segmentos||[],senales:classification.senales||[]};newsRelevanceMemory_.set(annotated,Number(classification.score||0));return annotated;
  }).filter(Boolean);
}
function evaluate_(item, feed, now) {
  const publisher=plainText_(item.source),rawTitle=plainText_(item.title);
  const title=publisher&&rawTitle.endsWith(' - '+publisher)?rawTitle.slice(0,-publisher.length-3):rawTitle;
  const url=canonicalUrl_(item.url),date=new Date(item.date);
  if (!title || !url || !domainMatches_(url,feed.domain) || !Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) return {reason:'Falta titular, URL del editor o fecha válida'};
  if(date>now)return {reason:'Fecha futura'};
  if(feed.range){const day=calendarDate_(date).toISOString().slice(0,10);if(day<feed.range.from||day>feed.range.to)return {reason:'Fuera del período de recuperación'};}
  else if(now-date>settings_().windowDays*86400000)return {reason:'Fuera de la ventana de '+settings_().windowDays+' días'};
  const excerpt=plainText_(item.excerpt).slice(0,1500),headline=searchText_(title),text=searchText_(title+' '+excerpt),index=businessIndex_();
  const entity=feed.entity==='Sector'?headlineEntity_(headline,index):index.entities.get(searchText_(feed.entity));
  const classification=classification_(headline,text);
  const candidate={date,title,excerpt,url,labels:classification.labels,entity:entity?.name||feed.entity,country:newsCountry_({titular:title,extracto:excerpt,url,sourceUrl:item.sourceUrl,medio:publisher,fuente:feed.name,pais:feed.country},index),language:item.language||feed.language||'',publisher:publisher||'',sourceUrl:canonicalUrl_(item.sourceUrl),provenance:item.excerptSource||'rss:description'};
  const reject=reason=>({inRange:true,reason,candidate});
  if(feed.entity==='Sector'&&!entity)return reject('Sin entidad de seguimiento en el titular');
  if(feed.kind==='profile'&&entity&&!index.entityTerms.get(entity.name).some(alias=>phraseMatch_(text,alias)))return reject('Sin evidencia de la entidad buscada');
  if(entityKey_(entity?.name||feed.entity)==='Santander'&&santanderExcluded_(text))return reject('Santander geográfico o municipal');
  if(!classification.labels.digital||!classification.labels.capacidades.some(name=>name.startsWith('Empresas: ')))return reject('Fuera de canal digital de Empresas e instituciones');
  const country=newsCountry_({titular:title,extracto:excerpt,url,sourceUrl:canonicalUrl_(item.sourceUrl),medio:publisher,fuente:feed.name,pais:feed.country},index);
  if(feed.capabilitySearch&&classification.assessment.excluded)return reject('Información corporativa sin novedad de canal digital');
  if(feed.capabilitySearch&&(!classification.assessment.capabilities.length||!classification.assessment.channel))return reject('Sin capacidad digital activa en contexto de canal');
  return {inRange:true,relevant:classification.labels.digital||(!classification.assessment.excluded&&classification.assessment.score>0),item:{date,title,excerpt:excerpt===title?'':excerpt,url,labels:classification.labels,entity:entity?.name||feed.entity,country,language:item.language||feed.language||'',publisher:publisher||'',sourceUrl:canonicalUrl_(item.sourceUrl),provenance:item.excerptSource||'rss:description'}};
}
function safeCell_(value) {
  return typeof value==='string' && /^[=+@-]/.test(value) ? "'"+value : value;
}

function sha256_(value){return Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256,value,Utilities.Charset.UTF_8).map(byte=>(byte&255).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');}

function newsReadingGeography_(context,query){return context?.cadence==='fortnightly'&&query.benchmark==='international'&&!query.country?()=> 'Otras geografías':applicationGeography(context?.scope||configuration_().applicationScope,query.segment);}
function newsGeographySelection_(rows,query,geography=applicationGeography(configuration_().applicationScope,query.segment)){

function searchText_(value) {
  return String(value||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/ı/g,'i').trim();
}
function newsScope_(row,query,entity,entityName=entityKey_){
  return (!query.country||row.pais===query.country)&&(!entity||entityName(row.entidad)===entity)&&(!query.source||row.medio===query.source||row.fuente===query.source)&&(!query.from||row.fecha>=query.from)&&(!query.to||row.fecha<=query.to);
}
function selectNews_(rows,query){
  const entity=query.entity?entityKey_(query.entity):'';
  return selectAnnotatedNews_(annotateNews_(rows.filter(row=>newsScope_(row,query,entity))),query);
}
function selectAnnotatedNews_(rows,query,entityName=entityKey_,identities=false) {
  const q=searchText_(String(query.search||'').slice(0,160));
  if(query.from && query.to && query.from>query.to)throw new Error('La fecha desde debe ser anterior o igual a la fecha hasta.');
  const entity=query.entity?entityName(query.entity):'';
  const selected=rows.filter(r=>(!q || searchText_(r.titular+' '+r.extracto+' '+r.entidad+' '+r.medio).includes(q)) && newsScope_(r,query,entity,entityName) && (!query.type || r.tipo===query.type) && (!query.segment || r.segmentos.includes(query.segment)) && (!query.signal || r.senales.includes(query.signal)) && (!query.coverage || r.etiquetas?.[query.coverage]===true) && (!query.palanca || r.taxonomia.some(item=>item.palanca===query.palanca)) && (!query.subpalanca || r.taxonomia.some(item=>item.subpalanca===taxonomySubLabel(query.subpalanca)&&(!query.palanca||item.palanca===query.palanca))));
  return uniqueNews_(identities||entityName===snapshotEntity_?selected:translationIdentityRows_(selected)).sort((a,b)=>b.fecha.localeCompare(a.fecha));
}
function newsDashboard_(rows, query, feeds,view='radar',context=null,pagination=null,previousRows=null) {
  const identities=Boolean(context)||view==='radar';if(!context&&view==='radar')rows=translationIdentityRows_(rows);
  const entityName=context?snapshotEntity_:entityKey_,selected=selectAnnotatedNews_(view==='briefing'?rows.filter(briefingAllowed):rows,query,entityName,identities),radar=view==='radar'?radarMetrics_(selected,query,context?.geographies,entityName):null;
  if(radar){radar.outages=radarOutageSelection_(selected,query,entityName,previousRows);const available={total:0,from:'',to:'',limited:false},period=['country','entity','source','search','type','segment','signal','coverage','palanca','subpalanca'].some(key=>query[key])?uniqueNews_(rows.filter(row=>newsScope_(row,{from:query.from,to:query.to},''))):selected;for(const row of period){available.total++;if(!available.from||row.fecha<available.from)available.from=row.fecha;if(row.fecha>available.to)available.to=row.fecha;}radar.available=available;}
  const geography=newsReadingGeography_(context,query);
  const newsGeographies=view==='news'?noveltyOverview(selected,[],geography).geographies.map(({name,total})=>({name,total})):[],newsGeography=newsGeographies.some(row=>row.name===query.newsGeography)?query.newsGeography:newsGeographies[0]?.name||'',visible=view==='news'?newsGeographySelection_(selected,{...query,newsGeography},geography):selected;
  const page=Math.min(Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(query.page)||0)),Math.max(0,Math.ceil(visible.length/settings_().pageSize)-1));
  const ordered=view==='news'&&pagination?newsEntityGroups(visible).flatMap(group=>group.items):visible;if(pagination)pagination(ordered);
  const values=items=>[...new Set(items.filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'es'));
  return {...taxonomyOptions_(),items:view==='news'&&!pagination?newsEntityPage(visible,page*settings_().pageSize,settings_().pageSize):ordered.slice(page*settings_().pageSize,(page+1)*settings_().pageSize),total:visible.length,contextTotal:selected.length,...(view==='news'?{newsGeographies,newsGeography}:{}),page,pageSize:settings_().pageSize,
    countries:values((query.country?selectAnnotatedNews_(rows,{...query,country:''},entityName,identities):selected).map(row=>row.pais)),entities:values([...rows.map(r=>entityName(r.entidad)),...feeds.map(f=>entityName(f.entity))]),sources:values(rows.map(r=>r.medio)),types:values(configuration_().entities.filter(row=>row.enabled).map(row=>row.type)),segments:configuration_().segments.filter(row=>row.enabled).map(row=>row.name),signals:view==='briefing'?[...BRIEFING_ALLOWED_SIGNALS]:configuration_().signals.filter(row=>row.enabled).map(row=>row.name),...(radar?{radar,stats:radar.summary,heatmap:taxonomyHeatmap_(selected,entityName)}:{}),...(view==='briefing'?{briefing:briefing_(selected,true,geography,entityName)}:{})};
}
function newsCsv_(rows, query, language='es',prepared=false,names,entityName=entityKey_) {
  const label=taxonomyLanguage_(language,names),selected=prepared?selectAnnotatedNews_(rows,query,entityName):selectNews_(rows,query),keys=[...RADAR.sheets.Noticias.filter(k=>!['id','capturada','clasificacion','taxonomia'].includes(k)),'tipo','segmentos','senales','bloques_funcionales','funcionalidades_suboperativas'];
  if(selected.length>settings_().exportLimit)throw new Error('Reduce el período para exportar hasta '+settings_().exportLimit+' publicaciones.');
  return {csv:'\ufeff'+[keys,...selected.map(r=>keys.map(k=>k==='bloques_funcionales'?[...new Set(r.taxonomia.map(item=>label(item.palanca)))].join(' · '):k==='funcionalidades_suboperativas'?r.taxonomia.map(item=>label(item.subpalanca)).join(' · '):r[k]))].map(row=>row.map(value=>'"'+String(safeCell_(value)||'').replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(';')).join('\r\n'),count:selected.length};
}

// Persist the completion barrier with the job; publication failure leaves it visibly incomplete.
function snapshotJob_(key,job){
  if(job.state!=='Completada'&&job.state!=='Publicando'){const pending=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS')||'[]').filter(value=>value!==key);if(pending.length)properties_().setProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS',JSON.stringify(pending));else properties_().deleteProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS');}
  if(job.state!=='Completada'||job.total===0&&!(key==='TAXONOMY_JOB'&&job.model))return job;
  const pending=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS')||'[]');if(!pending.includes(key))pending.push(key);
  properties_().setProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS',JSON.stringify(pending));requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);return {...job,state:'Publicando'};
}
function snapshotJobsPending_(){return llmJob_()?.state==='Publicando'||JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS')||'[]').length>0;}
function completeSnapshotJobs_(){
  const p=properties_(),pending=JSON.parse(p.getProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS')||'[]');
  for(const key of pending){const job=JSON.parse(p.getProperty(key)||'null');if(job?.state==='Publicando')p.setProperty(key,JSON.stringify({...job,state:'Completada',error:'',published:new Date().toISOString()}));}
  p.deleteProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS');
  for(const job of collectionJobs_())if(job.estado==='Publicando'){if(job.tipo==='daily'&&p.getProperty('MAINTENANCE_DAY')!==recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone))p.setProperty('MAINTENANCE_REQUEST',recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone));job.estado=Number(job.fallidas)>0?'Parcial':'Completada';job.fin=new Date().toISOString();writeCollectionJob_(job);}
  CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('collection-status');

}

function recordSnapshotFailure_(error){
  const p=properties_(),message=String(error.message||error).slice(0,180),keys=JSON.parse(p.getProperty('SNAPSHOT_JOBS')||'[]');
  for(const key of keys){const job=JSON.parse(p.getProperty(key)||'null');if(job?.state==='Publicando')p.setProperty(key,JSON.stringify({...job,error:message}));}
  telemetry_('dashboard-snapshot',0,'Error',message);
}

function collectionPeriod_(range){
  if(!range)return 'when:'+settings_().windowDays+'d';
  return 'after:'+new Date(Date.parse(range.from)-86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10)+' before:'+new Date(Date.parse(range.to)+86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
}
function profileFeed_(geo,entity,range,capabilitySearch=false) {
  const quote=value=>'"'+value.replace(/"/g,'')+'"';
  const period=collectionPeriod_(range);
  const terms=capabilitySearch?capabilitySearchTerms_(geo,entity):collectionSearchTerms_(geo);
  if(!terms.length)return null;
  const language=geo.language.split('-')[0],scopes=collectionLanguageMemory_.scopes;
  if(capabilitySearch&&!scopes.has(language))scopes.set(language,localizedSearchTerms_(configuration_().segments.filter(row=>row.enabled).flatMap(row=>row.terms),geo).slice(0,6));
  const scope=capabilitySearch?' ('+scopes.get(language).map(quote).join(' OR ')+')':'';
  // Fechas al principio y OR agrupados: el proveedor no debe ampliar el período por una alternativa.
  const prefix=period+' ('+[entity.name,...entity.aliases].slice(0,COLLECTION_POLICY.entityAliases+1).map(quote).join(' OR ')+') (',selected=[];let length=prefix.length+1+scope.length;
  for(const term of terms){const value=quote(term),size=value.length+(selected.length?4:0);if(length+size>COLLECTION_POLICY.queryChars)continue;selected.push(value);length+=size;}
  if(!selected.length)return null;const query=prefix+selected.join(' OR ')+')'+scope;
  // Google News no publica edición UY; su redirección legítima utiliza US en español latinoamericano.
  const code=geo.code==='UY'?'US':geo.code;
  const url=canonicalUrl_('https://news.google.com/rss/search?q='+encodeURIComponent(query)+'&hl='+geo.language+'&gl='+code+'&ceid='+code+':'+geo.language);
  return {id:'profile/'+geo.code+'/'+entity.name,name:entity.name+' · '+geo.name,url,domain:'news.google.com',entity:entity.name,country:geo.name,kind:'profile',language:geo.language,capabilitySearch,enabled:entity.enabled&&geo.enabled};
}
let collectionLanguageMemory_;
function localizedSearchTerms_(terms,geo){
  const config=configuration_();if(collectionLanguageMemory_?.config!==config){
    const terms=new Map();
    for(const row of config.searchLanguages.filter(row=>row.enabled))for(const term of row.terms){const key=searchText_(term);if(!terms.has(key))terms.set(key,new Set());terms.get(key).add(row.language);}
    collectionLanguageMemory_={config,terms,scopes:new Map()};
  }
  const language=geo.language.split('-')[0],native=[],english=[],custom=[];
  for(const term of terms){const languages=collectionLanguageMemory_.terms.get(searchText_(term));if(!languages)custom.push(term);else if(languages.has(language))native.push(term);else if(languages.has('en'))english.push(term);}
  return [...native,...english,...custom];
}
function collectionSearchTerms_(geo){
  const local=(configuration_().searchLanguages.find(row=>row.enabled&&row.language===geo.language.split('-')[0])?.terms||[]).slice(0,COLLECTION_POLICY.localTerms),terms=localizedSearchTerms_([...new Set(settings_().searchTerms)],geo),count=Math.min(terms.length,Math.max(0,COLLECTION_POLICY.searchTerms-local.length));
  return [...new Set([...local,...Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>terms[Math.floor(i*terms.length/count)])])];
}
let catalogueSearchMemory_;
function catalogueSearchRows_(){
  const config=configuration_(),revision=taxonomyMemory_?.revision||properties_().getProperty('TAXONOMY_REVISION')||'0';if(catalogueSearchMemory_?.config===config&&catalogueSearchMemory_.revision===revision)return catalogueSearchMemory_.rows;
  // Every catalogue ID participates; aliases improve recall without changing the canonical names.
  const rows=config.taxonomy.flatMap(block=>[
    ...block.functions.map(row=>({key:row.id,terms:[...new Set([...row.terms,row.name.replace(/^Landing(?: de)?\s*/i,'')])]})),
    ...block.emerging.map(row=>({key:block.name+'|'+row.name,terms:row.terms}))
  ]).filter(row=>row.terms.length);
  const admitted=new Map(config.taxonomy.flatMap(block=>block.emerging.map(row=>[block.name+'|'+taxonomyText(row.name),row])));
  for(const row of taxonomyCatalog_().filter(row=>row.origen==='tf-idf')){const key=row.palanca+'|'+taxonomyText(row.subpalanca.replace(/^\d{2}\.xx\s+/,'')),concept=admitted.get(key),entry=rows.find(item=>item.key===row.palanca+'|'+concept?.name);if(entry)entry.priority=Number(row.peso)||0;}
  catalogueSearchMemory_={config,revision,rows};return rows;
}
function capabilitySearchTerms_(geo,entity){
  const capabilities=businessIndex_().capabilities,catalogue=catalogueSearchRows_();
  if(!capabilities.length&&!catalogue.length)return [];
  const seed=[entity.name,geo.code].join('|'),day=Math.floor(Date.parse(recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone))/86400000),hash=[...seed].reduce((sum,char)=>sum*31+char.charCodeAt(0),0)>>>0;
  const terms=new Set(),base=new Set(collectionSearchTerms_(geo).map(searchText_)),limit=COLLECTION_POLICY.capabilityTerms,problems=configuration_().signals.filter(row=>row.enabled&&row.group==='Problema').map(row=>({terms:row.terms.map(term=>term.replace(/\*/g,''))})),reserve=problems.length?1:0;
  const add=(rows,budget)=>{
    if(!rows.length)return;const offset=(hash+day*budget)%rows.length;
    for(let i=0,added=0;i<rows.length&&added<budget;i++){
      const row=rows[(offset+i)%rows.length],choices=localizedSearchTerms_(row.terms,geo),term=choices.find(value=>!base.has(searchText_(value))&&!terms.has(value));
      if(term){terms.add(term);added++;}
    }
  };
  const priorities=catalogue.filter(row=>row.priority>0).sort((a,b)=>b.priority-a.priority||a.key.localeCompare(b.key));
  add(priorities,priorities.length?1:0);add(catalogue,Math.ceil((limit-reserve)/2)-terms.size);add(capabilities,limit-reserve-terms.size);add(problems,limit-terms.size);
  return [...terms];
}
function defaultFeeds_(range) {
  const config=configuration_(),disabled=new Set(config.settings.disabledSources);
  return config.feeds.map(feed=>({...feed,kind:'rss'})).concat(config.entities.flatMap(entity=>config.geographies.filter(geo=>entity.countries.includes(geo.name)).map(geo=>{const feed=profileFeed_(geo,entity,range);return {...feed,enabled:feed.enabled&&!disabled.has(feed.id)};})));
}

function saveSourceSettings(enabledIds){
  authorize_(true);const config=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(configuration_())),all=configuredFeeds_(),known=new Set(all.map(feed=>feed.id));
  if(!Array.isArray(enabledIds)||enabledIds.length>all.length||enabledIds.some(id=>!known.has(id)))throw Error('Configuración de fuentes no válida.');
  const enabled=new Set(enabledIds);config.feeds.forEach(feed=>feed.enabled=enabled.has(feed.id));config.settings.disabledSources=all.filter(feed=>feed.kind==='profile'&&!enabled.has(feed.id)).map(feed=>feed.id);
  writeConfiguration_(config,configurationRevision_());return enabled.size+' fuentes seleccionadas. Entidades y países desactivados permanecen desactivados.';
}
function saveFeeds(feeds){
  authorize_(true);const config=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(configuration_()));
  if(!Array.isArray(feeds)||feeds.length>settings_().maxCustomFeeds)throw Error('Máximo '+settings_().maxCustomFeeds+' fuentes RSS.');
  config.feeds=feeds.map(feed=>({id:'rss/'+canonicalUrl_(feed.url),name:plainText_(feed.name).slice(0,100),url:canonicalUrl_(feed.url),domain:String(feed.domain||'').toLowerCase().trim(),entity:plainText_(feed.entity).slice(0,80),country:plainText_(feed.country||settings_().unknownCountry).slice(0,60),language:String(feed.language||'').trim(),enabled:feed.enabled!==false}));
  return writeConfiguration_(config,configurationRevision_());
}
function enableDaily() {
  authorize_(true);disableDaily();
  replaceCollectionSchedule_();
  properties_().setProperty('DAILY_ENABLED','true');
  return 'Recopilación activada. '+collectionScheduleLabel_()+'.';
}

let radarBook_;
function book_() { return radarBook_ || (radarBook_=SpreadsheetApp.openById(properties_().getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID'))); }
function setupRadar() {
  const p=properties_(), email=Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail().toLowerCase();
  if (p.getProperty('OWNER_EMAIL') && p.getProperty('OWNER_EMAIL')!==email) throw new Error('Solo el propietario puede inicializar.');
  if(p.getProperty('OWNER_EMAIL'))authorize_(true);
  else if(Session.getActiveUser().getEmail().toLowerCase()!==email)throw new Error('Inicializa desde el editor con la cuenta propietaria.');
  const existing=p.getProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID');
  const book=existing?SpreadsheetApp.openById(existing):(SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet() || SpreadsheetApp.create('BBVA Empresas · News Radar'));
  radarBook_=book;
  p.setProperties({OWNER_EMAIL:email,SPREADSHEET_ID:book.getId()});
  initializeConfiguration();
  book.setSpreadsheetTimeZone(settings_().timezone);
  Object.entries(RADAR.sheets).forEach(([name,headers])=>{
    let sheet=book.getSheetByName(name);
    if (sheet) {
      const actual=sheet.getRange(1,1,1,headers.length).getValues()[0];
      if (actual.some((value,i)=>value && value!==headers[i])) throw new Error('Estructura inesperada en '+name+'.');
      sheet.getRange(1,1,1,headers.length).setValues([headers]).setFontWeight('bold').setBackground(SHEET_THEME.background).setFontColor(SHEET_THEME.foreground);
      return;
    }
    sheet=book.insertSheet(name);sheet.getRange(1,1,1,headers.length).setValues([headers]).setFontWeight('bold').setBackground(SHEET_THEME.background).setFontColor(SHEET_THEME.foreground);sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
  });
  return 'News Radar preparado: fuentes predeterminadas, recopilación automática y métricas.';
}
function rows_(sheet, limit, width=RADAR.sheets[sheet].length,period=null) {
  if(sheet==='Noticias'&&period){const rows=newsRowsForPeriod_(period);for(const row of rows)delete row._sheetRow;return rows;}
  const s=recordSheet_(sheet), count=s.getLastRow()-1;
  if (count<1) return [];
  const size=limit?Math.min(count,limit):count;
  const keys=RADAR.sheets[sheet].slice(0,width);
  return s.getRange(count-size+2,1,size,keys.length).getDisplayValues().map(r=>Object.fromEntries(keys.map((k,i)=>[k,r[i]])));
}
function append_(name, rows) {
  if (!rows.length) return;
  if(NEWSLETTER_ARCHIVE_TABLES.includes(name))markNewsletterArchiveEdited_();
  const s=recordSheet_(name), start=s.getLastRow()+1, needed=start+rows.length-1;
  if (needed>s.getMaxRows()) s.insertRowsAfter(s.getMaxRows(),needed-s.getMaxRows());
  const range=s.getRange(start,1,rows.length,rows[0].length);range.setNumberFormat('@').setValues(rows.map(r=>r.map(safeCell_)));
  enforceLogLimit_(name,s);
  if(name==='Ejecuciones')CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('dashboard-runs:'+RADAR.version);
}

function rowsById_(name,ids,limit=Infinity){
  const sheet=recordSheet_(name),count=Math.min(Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),limit),keys=RADAR.sheets[name],result=[];
  if(!count||!ids.size)return result;
  const first=sheet.getLastRow()-count+1,positions=sheet.getRange(first,1,count,1).getDisplayValues().flatMap(([id],index)=>ids.has(id)?[first+index]:[]);
  let start=0;
  for(let end=1;end<=positions.length;end++){
    if(end<positions.length&&positions[end]===positions[end-1]+1)continue;
    for(const row of sheet.getRange(positions[start],1,end-start,keys.length).getDisplayValues())result.push(Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,index)=>[key,row[index]])));
    start=end;
  }
  return result;
}

function newsRowsForCandidates_(candidates){
 const last=newsSheet_().getLastRow(),positions=[...new Set(candidates.map(candidate=>candidate.row).filter(row=>Number.isInteger(row)&&row>=2&&row<=last))].sort((a,b)=>a-b),physical=new Map(newsRowsAt_(positions).map(row=>[row._sheetRow,row])),articles=new Map(),displaced=new Set();
 for(const candidate of candidates){const row=physical.get(candidate.row);if(row?.id===candidate.id)articles.set(candidate.id,row);else displaced.add(candidate.id);}
 if(displaced.size)for(const row of rowsById_('Noticias',displaced))articles.set(row.id,row);
 return articles;
}

function cacheJsonValue_(value){
  const encoded=JSON.stringify(value);
  return encoded.length<=90000&&encodeURIComponent(encoded).replace(/%[A-F\d]{2}/gi,'x').length<=90000?encoded:null;
}
function cacheJson_(key,value,seconds){const encoded=cacheJsonValue_(value);if(encoded)try{CacheService.getScriptCache().put(key,encoded,seconds);}catch(_){}}

function sheetRowRanges_(positions,gap=8){
  if(!positions.length)return [];
  const dense=positions.at(-1)-positions[0]+1<=Math.max(2000,positions.length*4),ranges=[];let start=0;
  for(let end=1;end<=positions.length;end++){
    if(end<positions.length&&positions[end]-positions[start]<2000&&(dense||positions[end]-positions[end-1]<=gap))continue;
    ranges.push([positions[start],positions[end-1]]);start=end;
  }
  return ranges;
}

function newsWorkRows_(job,limit){
  const selected=[],days=newsRecordIndex_().days;
  scan:for(const day of Object.keys(days).sort().reverse()){
    if(job.cursor&&day>job.cursor.date)continue;
    for(const [first,last] of days[day].slice().reverse())for(let row=Math.min(last,job.total+1);row>=Math.max(first,job.firstRow||2);row--){
      if(job.cursor&&day===job.cursor.date&&row>=job.cursor.row)continue;
      selected.push({day,row});if(selected.length>=limit)break scan;
    }
  }
  const rows=new Map(newsRowsAt_(selected.map(item=>item.row).sort((a,b)=>a-b),64).map(row=>[row._sheetRow,row]));return selected.map(item=>rows.get(item.row));
}

function newsWorkCursor_(row){return {date:row.fecha,row:row._sheetRow};}

function writeNewsCells_(updates){
  const sheet=newsSheet_(),ordered=updates.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.column-b.column||a.row-b.row);
  for(let start=0;start<ordered.length;){
    let end=start+1;while(end<ordered.length&&ordered[end].column===ordered[start].column&&ordered[end].row-ordered[end-1].row<=64&&ordered[end].row-ordered[start].row<250)end++;
    const first=ordered[start].row,column=ordered[start].column,size=ordered[end-1].row-first+1,values=size===end-start?ordered.slice(start,end).map(item=>[item.value]):sheet.getRange(first,column,size,1).getDisplayValues();
    if(size!==end-start)for(const item of ordered.slice(start,end))values[item.row-first]=[item.value];
    sheet.getRange(first,column,size,1).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(values);start=end;
  }
}

// Shared membership index: translations and functional analysis only read business articles.
function businessNewsIndex_(){
  const sheet=newsSheet_(),count=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),job=classificationJob_();
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),key='business-news-index:'+newsStorageKey_()+':'+RADAR.version+':'+(properties_().getProperty('NEWS_CONTENT_REVISION')||'0')+':'+(job?.revision||'0')+':'+(job?.next||0)+':'+count,cached=readDashboardCache_(cache,key);if(cached)return cached;
  if(!count)return {rows:[],revision:sha256_('[]')};
  const labels=sheet.getRange(2,RADAR.sheets.Noticias.indexOf('clasificacion')+1,count,1).getDisplayValues(),dates=sheet.getRange(2,1,count,2).getDisplayValues(),captured=sheet.getRange(2,RADAR.sheets.Noticias.indexOf('capturada')+1,count,1).getDisplayValues();
  const rows=dates.flatMap(([id,fecha],index)=>id&&businessNews_({clasificacion:labels[index][0]})?[{id,fecha,captured:captured[index][0],row:index+2,priority:0}]:[]).sort((a,b)=>b.fecha.localeCompare(a.fecha)||b.row-a.row);
  const value={rows,revision:sha256_(JSON.stringify(rows.map(row=>[row.id,row.fecha,row.row])))};writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,value);return value;
}

 const limit=LOG_LIMITS[name];if(!limit)return;const overflow=sheet.getLastRow()-1-limit;if(overflow>0)sheet.deleteRows(2,overflow);
}

function newsletterEnabled_(){return settings_().newsletterEnabled&&scheduledTriggers_('scheduledNewsletters_').length>0;}
function newsletterCountries_(){return configuration_().applicationScope.find(row=>row.name===sectorNewsDefaults.segment).countries;}
function subscriptionFilters_(input={}){return {...sectorNewsDefaults,...(input.country?{country:input.country}:{})};}
function subscriptionRows_(email){
  return rows_('Suscripciones').filter(row=>row.id&&(!email||row.correo===email)).map(row=>{const filters=JSON.parse(row.filtros);return {...row,filtros:{...subscriptionFilters_(filters),...(filters.aliases?.length?{aliases:filters.aliases}:{})},activa:String(row.activa)==='true'};});
}
function subscriptionDefaults_(){return {active:true,filters:{},language:'es'};}
function getNewsletterOptions(){const session=authorize_();return {email:session.email,enabled:newsletterEnabled_(),countries:newsletterCountries_(),defaults:subscriptionDefaults_()};}
function subscriptionDates_(row,attempts,now=new Date()){
  return Object.keys(newsletterCadences).map(periodicidad=>{const subscription={...row,periodicidad},period=newsletterPeriod_(periodicidad,now);return newsletterNextDate_(subscription,now,newsletterDeliveryAttempt_(subscription,period,attempts));}).filter(Boolean).sort()[0]||'';
}
function getSubscriptions(){const email=authorize_().email,deliveries=rows_('NewsletterEnvios',undefined,8),attempts=newsletterDeliveryAttempts_(deliveries);return subscriptionRows_(email).map(row=>({...row,nextDelivery:subscriptionDates_(row,attempts),ultimaEntrega:deliveries.filter(item=>item.correo===email).at(-1)||null}));}
function getAdminSubscriptions(){authorize_(true);const deliveries=rows_('NewsletterEnvios',undefined,8),attempts=newsletterDeliveryAttempts_(deliveries);return subscriptionRows_().map(row=>({...row,nextDelivery:subscriptionDates_(row,attempts),ultimaEntrega:deliveries.filter(item=>item.correo===row.correo).at(-1)||null}));}
function subscriptionRecord_(input,email,id,now){
  const language=input.language||'es',country=String(input.country||'');
  if(!supportedLanguage(language))throw Error('Idioma no admitido.');
  if(country&&!newsletterCountries_().includes(country))throw Error('Geografía no disponible para Empresas e instituciones.');
  return {id,correo:email,nombre:'Mi Newsletter'+(country?' · '+country:''),filtros:subscriptionFilters_({country}),periodicidad:'all',activa:input.active!==false,actualizada:now.toISOString(),idioma:language};
}
function newsletterPeriod_(periodicity,now){return newsletterWindow(periodicity,recordDay(now,settings_().timezone),true);}
function subscriptionQuery_(subscription,now,closed=false){const periodicity=subscription.periodicidad,period=newsletterWindow(periodicity,recordDay(now,settings_().timezone),closed);return {...subscriptionFilters_(subscription.filtros),from:period.from,to:period.to,view:newsletterCadences[periodicity].view};}
function newsletterDeliveryId_(subscription,period){return subscription.id+':'+subscription.periodicidad+':'+period.from;}
function newsletterSubscriptionIds_(subscription){return [subscription.id,...(subscription.filtros?.aliases||[])];}
function newsletterAttemptPriority_(row){return !row?0:row.estado==='Enviada'?4:row.estado==='Sin novedades'?3:['Enviando','Revisar'].includes(row.estado)?2:1;}
function newsletterDeliveryAttempts_(deliveries){
  const attempts=new Map();for(const row of deliveries)if(newsletterAttemptPriority_(row)>=newsletterAttemptPriority_(attempts.get(row.id)))attempts.set(row.id,row);return attempts;
}
function newsletterDeliveryAttempt_(subscription,period,attempts){
  let selected;for(const id of newsletterSubscriptionIds_(subscription)){const attempt=attempts.get(newsletterDeliveryId_({...subscription,id},period));if(newsletterAttemptPriority_(attempt)>newsletterAttemptPriority_(selected))selected=attempt;}return selected;
}
function newsletterNextDate_(subscription,now,last){
  if(!subscription.activa)return '';
  const day=recordDay(now,settings_().timezone),period=newsletterPeriod_(subscription.periodicidad,now),completed=newsletterSubscriptionIds_(subscription).some(id=>last?.id===newsletterDeliveryId_({...subscription,id},period))&&!['No enviado','Bloqueada'].includes(last.estado);
  const available=completed||new Date(subscription.actualizada)>=new Date(period.cutoff)?newsletterWindow(subscription.periodicidad,day).available:period.available;
  return day>available?day:available;
}
function writeSubscription_(input,admin){
  const session=authorize_(admin),email=admin?String(input.email||'').trim().toLowerCase():session.email;newsletterEmail_(email);
  return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{
    const rows=subscriptionRows_(),index=rows.findIndex(row=>admin&&input.id?row.id===input.id:row.correo===email);
    if(input.id&&(index<0||rows[index].id!==input.id))throw Error('Suscripción no encontrada.');
    if(rows.some((row,i)=>i!==index&&row.correo===email))throw Error('Ya existe una suscripción para ese correo.');
    const record=subscriptionRecord_(input,email,index>=0?rows[index].id:Utilities.getUuid(),new Date());if(index>=0){const original=JSON.parse(book_().getSheetByName('Suscripciones').getRange(index+2,4,1,1).getDisplayValues()[0][0]);if(original.aliases?.length)record.filtros.aliases=original.aliases;}const values=RADAR.sheets.Suscripciones.map(key=>key==='filtros'?JSON.stringify(record[key]):record[key]);
    if(index<0)append_('Suscripciones',[values]);else book_().getSheetByName('Suscripciones').getRange(index+2,1,1,values.length).setValues([values]);
    properties_().setProperty('SUBSCRIPTIONS_REVISION',Utilities.getUuid());return 'Suscripción guardada. Recibirás las ediciones quincenal y trimestral.';
  });
}
function saveSubscription(input){return writeSubscription_(input,false);}
function saveAdminSubscription(input){return writeSubscription_(input,true);}
function deleteSubscription(id){
  const session=authorize_();return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{const rows=rows_('Suscripciones'),index=rows.findIndex(row=>row.correo===session.email&&(row.id===id||JSON.parse(row.filtros).aliases?.includes(id)));if(index<0)throw Error('Suscripción no encontrada.');book_().getSheetByName('Suscripciones').deleteRow(index+2);properties_().setProperty('SUBSCRIPTIONS_REVISION',Utilities.getUuid());return 'Suscripción eliminada.';});
}
function deleteAdminSubscription(id){authorize_(true);return withForegroundWrite_(()=>{const index=rows_('Suscripciones').findIndex(row=>row.id===id);if(index<0)throw Error('Suscripción no encontrada.');book_().getSheetByName('Suscripciones').deleteRow(index+2);properties_().setProperty('SUBSCRIPTIONS_REVISION',Utilities.getUuid());return 'Suscripción eliminada.';});}

// Sparse statistics and bounded evidence; article bodies are never retained.
const TAXONOMY_POLICY=Object.freeze({version:'3.11.0',batchRows:100,maxMs:10000,maxCandidates:600,maxEmergingPerLever:3,minEmergingDocuments:3,minEmergingSources:2,maxTerms:24,checkpointRows:20,checkpointChars:40000,maxAssignments:3,maxOverlapLinks:32,overlapContainment:.8,overlapSizeRatio:.5});
const taxonomyDefinitionMemory=new WeakMap(),rankingIndexes=new WeakMap();
function taxonomyText(value){return String(value||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/ı/g,'i');}
const words=value=>taxonomyText(value).match(/[a-z][a-z0-9]+/g)||[];
function taxonomyDefinitions(blocks){
 if(taxonomyDefinitionMemory.has(blocks))return taxonomyDefinitionMemory.get(blocks);
 const definitions=blocks.flatMap(block=>[
  {key:block.name,palanca:block.name,subpalanca:'',segments:['Empresas'],terms:block.terms.map(taxonomyText),emerging:block.emerging},
  {key:block.name+'|Otros',palanca:block.name,subpalanca:block.name.slice(0,2)+'.xx Otros',segments:['Empresas'],terms:[],context:[],exclude:[],description:'Operativa del bloque sin suboperativa específica demostrada.',origin:'local'},
  ...block.functions.map(row=>({key:row.id,palanca:block.name,subpalanca:row.id+'.'+row.name,segments:['Empresas'],description:row.description||'',context:(row.context||[]).map(taxonomyText),exclude:(row.exclude||[]).map(taxonomyText),terms:[...new Set([taxonomyText(row.name),...row.terms.map(taxonomyText)])]}))
 ]);taxonomyDefinitionMemory.set(blocks,definitions);return definitions;
}
function taxonomySeed(state,definitions){state.catalog=definitions;}
function taxonomyTermCounts(text,terms){
 const counts=new Map();
 for(const term of terms){if(!term)continue;let at=-1,count=0;while((at=text.indexOf(term,at+1))>=0)if((at===0||!/[a-z0-9]/.test(text[at-1]))&&(at+term.length===text.length||!/[a-z0-9]/.test(text[at+term.length])))count++;if(count)counts.set(term,count);}
 return counts;
}
// Compile once per catalogue, then rank bounded phrases by specificity and headline evidence.
const rankingWord=word=>word.length>4?word.replace(/s$/,''):word;
const rankingStopWords=new Set(words('landing de del la el y para con que en un una los las por se su sus al es esta este como donde todos todas cliente clientes permite permitir funcionalidad funcionalidades operativa canal producto productos información desde hasta sobre entre también actualmente través mediante disponer tener haber ser estar poder así más banco banca bancario empresarial empresa negocio pymes digital solución nuevo nueva sistema plataforma servicio gestión operar realizar uso proceso acceso mejora ofrecer incluir disponible usuario titular pago cobro cuenta crédito financiación tarjeta transferencia operación dato forma opción utilizar solicitud consulta reporte seguimiento the and of for to in on with that this from into a an is are can be will has have their it by as at or our your all more new business businesses enterprise corporate bank banking customer client company companies service product solution platform system digital web online mobile app application internet movil telefono phone linea payment pay money finance financial credit account card operation data use offer enable provide process ve bir bu için ile banka bankacilik şirket işletme hizmet yeni ürün ödeme sistem plataforma servicio pagamento servico empresa novo nuova sistema piattaforma').map(rankingWord));
function rankingIndex(definitions){
 let index=rankingIndexes.get(definitions);if(index)return index;
 const frequencies=new Map(),phrases=new Map(),canonical=new Map(),labels=new Map(),contexts=new Map(),rows=definitions.filter(row=>row.subpalanca);const contextWords=value=>words(value).map(rankingWord).filter(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(word)&&word.length>2);
 for(const row of rows){
  const tokens=new Set();for(const term of row.terms){if(!phrases.has(term))phrases.set(term,words(term).map(rankingWord));for(const word of phrases.get(term))tokens.add(word);}
  for(const word of contextWords(row.description))tokens.add(word);contexts.set(row,new Set(contextWords(row.description)));
  for(const word of tokens)frequencies.set(word,(frequencies.get(word)||0)+1);
  labels.set(row,taxonomyText(row.subpalanca.replace(/^\d{2}\.(?:\d{2}|xx)[. ]*/,'')));canonical.set(row,new Set(words(row.subpalanca).map(rankingWord).filter(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(word))));
 }
 const weights=new Map([...phrases].map(([term,tokens])=>[term,tokens.reduce((sum,word)=>sum+1+Math.log((1+rows.length)/(1+(frequencies.get(word)||0))),0)/Math.max(1,tokens.length)*(1+Math.log(1+tokens.length))]));
 const idf=new Map([...frequencies].map(([word,count])=>[word,1+Math.log((1+rows.length)/(1+count))]));
 const norms=new Map([...contexts].map(([row,tokens])=>[row,[...tokens].reduce((sum,word)=>sum+(idf.get(word)||0)**2,0)]));const minimumIdf=Math.min(4.8,1+Math.log((1+rows.length)/2));for(const [row,tokens] of contexts)contexts.set(row,[...tokens].filter(word=>(idf.get(word)||0)>=minimumIdf));
 index={weights,phrases,canonical,labels,contexts,norms,idf,blocks:new Map(definitions.filter(row=>!row.subpalanca).map(row=>[row.palanca,row]))};rankingIndexes.set(definitions,index);return index;
}
function taxonomyDecision(text,definitions,headline=''){
 const index=rankingIndex(definitions),title=taxonomyText(headline),tokens=new Set(words(text).map(rankingWord)),titleWords=new Set(words(title).map(rankingWord));let best,second;const ranked=[];
 for(const row of definitions){
  if(!row.subpalanca||/\.xx Otros$/.test(row.subpalanca))continue;
  if(row.context?.length&&!taxonomyTermCounts(text,row.context).size||row.exclude?.length&&taxonomyTermCounts(text,row.exclude).size)continue;
  if(/(?:^|\.)landing\b/i.test(row.subpalanca)&&!/(?:landing|dashboard|visi[oó]n integral|vista (?:global|agregada)|posici[oó]n (?:global|integrada)|aggregate|aggregated|overview|bütünleşik|genel bakış)/i.test(text))continue;
  const terms=row.terms.filter(term=>row.context?.length||index.phrases.get(term)?.some(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(word))||term===index.labels.get(row)&&index.phrases.get(term).length>1),counts=taxonomyTermCounts(text,terms),context=index.contexts.get(row),shared=context.filter(word=>tokens.has(word));
  let semantic=0;if(shared.length>=3&&(!title||shared.some(word=>titleWords.has(word)))){const matched=shared.reduce((sum,word)=>sum+index.idf.get(word)**2,0),norm=index.norms.get(row);semantic=Math.sqrt(matched/Math.max(1,norm));}
  if(!counts.size&&semantic<.5)continue;
  const titleCounts=title?taxonomyTermCounts(title,[...counts.keys()]):new Map();
  let score=semantic*8,count=counts.size?0:shared.length;
  for(const [term,frequency]of counts){
   const nameEvidence=index.phrases.get(term)?.some(word=>index.canonical.get(row).has(word))?1.5:1,headlineEvidence=titleCounts.has(term)?4*(1+1/(1+title.indexOf(term)/80)):1;
   score+=(index.weights.get(term)||1)*(1+Math.log(frequency))*nameEvidence*headlineEvidence;count+=frequency;
  }
  const block=index.blocks.get(row.palanca);if(block&&taxonomyTermCounts(text,block.terms).size)score*=1.25;
  const evidence={terms:[...(titleCounts.size?titleCounts.keys():counts.size?counts.keys():shared.map(stem=>words(text).find(word=>rankingWord(word)===stem)))].slice(0,3),location:titleCounts.size?'headline':'text',method:counts.size?'literal':'description'},candidate={row,count,score,evidence};
  ranked.push(candidate);
  if(!best||score>best.score||score===best.score&&row.subpalanca.localeCompare(best.row.subpalanca,'es')<0){second=best;best=candidate;}else if(!second||score>second.score)second=candidate;
 }
 const distinct=second&&best.row.subpalanca.replace(/^\d{2}\.(?:\d{2}|xx)[. ]*/, '')!==second.row.subpalanca.replace(/^\d{2}\.(?:\d{2}|xx)[. ]*/, '');
 const ambiguous=best?.evidence.method==='description'&&distinct&&second.score>=best.score*.85;
 const matches=best&&!ambiguous?[best]:[];
 if(matches.length){
  const used=new Set(best.evidence.terms),ordered=ranked.filter(row=>row!==best).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.row.subpalanca.localeCompare(b.row.subpalanca,'es'));
  for(const candidate of ordered){
   if(matches.length>=TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxAssignments)break;
   const independent=candidate.score>=best.score*.35&&taxonomyIndependentEvidence(candidate.evidence,[...used]);
   if(!independent)continue;
   matches.push(candidate);for(const term of candidate.evidence.terms)used.add(term);
  }
 }
 // A block fallback requires a discriminating phrase, never a generic banking word.
 const used=new Set(matches.flatMap(match=>match.evidence.terms));
 for(const block of index.blocks.values()){
  if(matches.some(match=>match.row.palanca===block.palanca)||matches.length>=TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxAssignments)continue;
  const concepts=(block.emerging||[]).filter(concept=>(!concept.context?.length||taxonomyTermCounts(text,concept.context.map(taxonomyText)).size)&&!taxonomyTermCounts(text,(concept.exclude||[]).map(taxonomyText)).size);
  const terms=[...taxonomyTermCounts(text,[...block.terms,...concepts.flatMap(concept=>concept.terms.map(taxonomyText))]).keys()].filter(term=>words(term).some(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(rankingWord(word))));
  const evidence={terms:terms.slice(0,3),method:'literal',location:terms.some(term=>title.includes(term))?'headline':'text'};
  if(!terms.length||matches.length&&!taxonomyIndependentEvidence(evidence,[...used]))continue;
  const row=definitions.find(row=>row.palanca===block.palanca&&/\.xx Otros$/.test(row.subpalanca));
  if(row){matches.push({row,count:terms.length,score:0,evidence});for(const term of evidence.terms)used.add(term);}
 }
 return {matches,reason:matches.length?'matched':ambiguous?'ambiguous':'insufficient'};
}
const evidenceWord=word=>rankingWord(word).replace(word.length>5?/[oa]$/:/$^/,'');
function taxonomyIndependentEvidence(evidence,used){
 return evidence.method==='literal'&&evidence.terms.some(term=>words(term).length>=2&&words(term).some(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(rankingWord(word)))&&!used.some(previous=>words(previous).some(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(rankingWord(word))&&words(term).map(evidenceWord).includes(evidenceWord(word)))));
}
function taxonomyMatches(text,definitions,headline=''){return taxonomyDecision(text,definitions,headline).matches;}
function taxonomyObserve(state,text,definitions,excludedWords,evidence='',options={}){
 taxonomySeed(state,definitions);
 const matched=taxonomyMatches(text,definitions,options.headline);if(!matched.length&&!definitions.some(row=>!row.subpalanca&&(taxonomyTermCounts(text,row.terms).size||row.emerging.some(concept=>taxonomyTermCounts(text,concept.terms.map(taxonomyText)).size))))return false;
 state.documents++;state.size=Object.keys(state.candidates).length;
 const observed=[];
 const observe=(entry,count)=>{
  let stats=state.candidates[entry.key];
  if(!stats){if(state.size>=definitions.length+TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxCandidates)return;stats=state.candidates[entry.key]={...entry,df:0,tf:0,sources:[]};state.size++;}
  stats.primaryEvidence=Boolean(stats.primaryEvidence||entry.primaryEvidence);stats.df++;stats.tf+=1+Math.log(count);observed.push(stats);
 };
 for(const {row,count}of matched)observe({...row,origin:'regla'},count);
 for(const a of observed)for(const b of observed){if(a===b)continue;a.overlap=a.overlap||{};if(Object.hasOwn(a.overlap,b.key)||Object.keys(a.overlap).length<TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxOverlapLinks)a.overlap[b.key]=(a.overlap[b.key]||0)+1;}
 return true;
}
function taxonomyBuild(state){
 const candidates=new Map((state.catalog||[]).map(row=>[row.key,{...row,origin:'regla',df:0,tf:0}]));
 for(const row of Object.values(state.candidates))candidates.set(row.key,row);
 const rows=[...candidates.values()].map(row=>({...row,peso:Number((row.tf/Math.max(1,state.documents)*(Math.log((1+state.documents)/(1+row.df))+1)).toFixed(6))}));
 const anchors=rows.filter(row=>row.origin==='regla');
 return anchors.sort((a,b)=>a.palanca.localeCompare(b.palanca,'es')||a.subpalanca.localeCompare(b.subpalanca,'es'));
}

function taxonomyEvidenceSupports(text,terms){return [...taxonomyTermCounts(taxonomyText(text),terms.map(taxonomyText)).keys()].some(term=>words(term).some(word=>!rankingStopWords.has(rankingWord(word))));}

function taxonomyHeatmap_(rows,entityName=entityKey_){
  const nodes=[],indices=new Map(),entities=new Map(),countries=new Map();let tagged=0;
  function node(category,level){
    const key=level==='palanca'?'p:'+category.palanca:'s:'+category.id;
    if(!indices.has(key)){indices.set(key,nodes.length);nodes.push({id:key,level,palanca:category.palanca,subpalanca:level==='palanca'?'':category.subpalanca,count:0});}
    return indices.get(key);
  }
  function group(map,name,labels){
    if(!map.has(name))map.set(name,{name,total:0,counts:new Map()});const row=map.get(name);row.total++;
    for(const index of labels)row.counts.set(index,(row.counts.get(index)||0)+1);
  }
  for(const row of rows){
    const labels=new Set();for(const category of row.taxonomia){labels.add(node(category,'palanca'));if(category.subpalanca)labels.add(node(category,'subpalanca'));}
    if(labels.size)tagged++;for(const index of labels)nodes[index].count++;
    group(entities,entityName(row.entidad),labels);group(countries,row.pais||settings_().unknownCountry,labels);
  }
  const groups=map=>[...map.values()].sort((a,b)=>Number(b.name==='BBVA')-Number(a.name==='BBVA')||b.total-a.total||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'es')).map(row=>({...row,counts:[...row.counts]}));
  return {nodes,entities:groups(entities),countries:groups(countries),total:rows.length,tagged};
}

function taxonomyOptions_(){const rows=taxonomyCatalog_();return {palanca:[...new Set(rows.map(row=>row.palanca))],subpalanca:rows.filter(row=>row.subpalanca).map(taxonomyPath)};}
function taxonomySaved_(value){try{const data=JSON.parse(value||'{}');return {...data,invalid:Boolean(value)&&(!Array.isArray(data.ids)||data.ids.some(id=>typeof id!=='string')),fingerprint:data.fingerprint||'',ids:Array.isArray(data.ids)?data.ids:[],evidence:data.evidence||null,reason:data.reason||''};}catch(_){return {fingerprint:'',ids:[],invalid:Boolean(value)};}}
function taxonomyFingerprint_(title,excerpt){return sha256_(JSON.stringify([title,excerpt]));}
function taxonomyRecord_(title,excerpt,items=taxonomyCatalog_()){
 const fingerprint=taxonomyFingerprint_(title,excerpt),text=taxonomyText(title+' '+excerpt);
 if(!taxonomyMatchingMemory_.has(items))taxonomyMatchingMemory_.set(items,{rows:items.map(item=>({...item,terms:item.terminos,description:item.descripcion||''})),revision:taxonomyModelRevision_(items)});
 const model=taxonomyMatchingMemory_.get(items),metadata={fingerprint,version:TAXONOMY_POLICY.version,model:model.revision};
 if(!items.length||!taxonomyEligible_(searchText_(title),text))return {...metadata,ids:[],reason:'insufficient'};
 const decision=taxonomyDecision(text,model.rows,title),match=decision.matches[0];
 return {...metadata,ids:decision.matches.map(match=>match.row.id),primary:match?.row.id||'',reason:decision.reason,...(match?{evidence:{...match.evidence,assignments:decision.matches.map(({row,evidence})=>({id:row.id,...evidence}))}}:{})};
}

function taxonomyModelRevision_(items){return sha256_(JSON.stringify(items.map(row=>[row.id,row.palanca,row.subpalanca,row.segmentos,row.terminos,row.descripcion,row.condiciones])));}
function publishTaxonomy_(state){
  taxonomySeed(state,taxonomyDefinitions(configuration_().taxonomy));
  const items=taxonomyBuild(state).map(row=>({id:sha256_(row.key).slice(0,24),palanca:row.palanca,subpalanca:row.subpalanca,segmentos:row.segments,terminos:row.terms,noticias:row.df,peso:row.peso,origen:/\.xx Otros$/.test(row.subpalanca)?'local':row.origin,descripcion:row.description||'',context:row.context||[],exclude:row.exclude||[],condiciones:JSON.stringify({context:row.context||[],exclude:row.exclude||[],...(row.emerging?{emerging:row.emerging}:{})})}));
  const revision=sha256_(JSON.stringify(items));
  if(revision===properties_().getProperty('TAXONOMY_REVISION')&&taxonomySheet_().getLastRow()>1){taxonomyMemory_={revision,items};return taxonomyModelRevision_(items);}
  const sheet=taxonomySheet_(),previous=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1),keys=RADAR.sheets.Taxonomia;
  const values=items.map(row=>keys.map(key=>Array.isArray(row[key])?JSON.stringify(row[key]):row[key]));
  if(values.length)sheet.getRange(2,1,values.length,keys.length).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(values);
  if(previous>values.length)sheet.getRange(values.length+2,1,previous-values.length,keys.length).clearContent();
  properties_().setProperty('TAXONOMY_REVISION',revision);taxonomyMemory_={revision,items};invalidateNews_(false);
  return taxonomyModelRevision_(items);
}
function taxonomyPrimarySource_(row){return configuration_().feeds.some(feed=>feed.enabled&&entityKey_(feed.entity)===entityKey_(row.entidad)&&domainMatches_(row.url,feed.domain));}
