function taxonomyBatch_(maxMs=TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxMs){
 const job=taxonomyJob_();if(!job||['Completada','Publicando'].includes(job.state))return;
 const started=Date.now();let written=false;
 try{
  if(job.rules!==taxonomyRulesRevision_()||job.corpus!==(properties_().getProperty('NEWS_CONTENT_REVISION')||'0')||job.candidateRevision!==(properties_().getProperty('CANDIDATES_REVISION')||'0')){requestTaxonomy_(job.request);return;}
  if(job.phase!=='tag'){
   const state=readTaxonomyCheckpoint_(job),definitions=taxonomyDefinitions(configuration_().taxonomy),excluded=new Set(configuration_().entities.flatMap(row=>[row.name,...row.aliases]).map(taxonomyText));
   taxonomySeed(state,definitions);
   if(job.phase==='scan'){
    const cursor={table:0,row:2,...job.scanCursor};let observed=0;
    while(cursor.table<2&&Date.now()-started<maxMs&&!backgroundPaused_(true)){
     const name=cursor.table===0?'Noticias':'Candidatos',sheet=recordSheet_(name),keys=RADAR.sheets[name],count=cursor.table===0?job.total:job.candidateTotal,width=cursor.table===0?7:6;
     if(cursor.row>count+1){cursor.table++;cursor.row=2;continue;}
     const size=Math.min(5000,count+2-cursor.row),rows=sheet.getRange(cursor.row,2,size,width).getDisplayValues(),provenance=cursor.table===1?sheet.getRange(cursor.row,keys.indexOf('procedencia')+1,size,1).getDisplayValues():null;
     let read=0;
     for(const values of rows){
      if(Date.now()-started>=maxMs||backgroundPaused_(true))break;
      const row=Object.fromEntries(keys.slice(1,1+width).map((key,j)=>[key,values[j]]));
      observeTaxonomyRow_(state,row,definitions,excluded,row.medio||JSON.parse(provenance?.[read][0]||'{}').medio||'');read++;observed++;
     }
     cursor.row+=read;if(read<rows.length)break;
    }
    while(cursor.table<2&&cursor.row>(cursor.table===0?job.total:job.candidateTotal)+1){cursor.table++;cursor.row=2;}
    job.scanCursor=cursor;job.documents=state.documents;job.candidatesProcessed=cursor.table>1?job.candidateTotal:cursor.table===1?cursor.row-2:0;
    if(cursor.table===2)job.phase='publish';
    // The manifest and exact next-row cursor commit together, after verification.
    if(observed||job.phase==='publish')saveTaxonomyCheckpoint_(job,state);
   }
   if(job.phase==='publish'&&Date.now()-started<maxMs&&!backgroundPaused_()){
    job.model=publishTaxonomy_(state);job.documents=state.documents;job.phase='tag';job.next=2;
   }
  }else{
   const sheet=newsSheet_(),keys=RADAR.sheets.Noticias,items=taxonomyCatalog_(),size=Math.min(TAXONOMY_POLICY.batchRows,job.total-job.next+2),updates=[];let read=0;
   const rows=size>0?sheet.getRange(job.next,1,size,keys.length).getDisplayValues():[];
   for(const values of rows){if(Date.now()-started>=maxMs||backgroundPaused_(true))break;const row=Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key,i)=>[key,values[i]])),saved=taxonomySaved_(row.taxonomia);const value=JSON.stringify(necessaryTaxonomyRecord_(row,items));if(value!==row.taxonomia)updates.push({row:job.next+read,column:keys.indexOf('taxonomia')+1,value});read++;}
   writeNewsCells_(updates);written=updates.length>0;job.next+=read;job.tagged+=updates.length;job.processed=job.next-2;
   if(job.next>job.total+1){job.state='Completada';properties_().setProperties({TAXONOMY_APPLIED_MODEL:job.model,TAXONOMY_APPLIED_RULES:job.rules,TAXONOMY_EVALUATED_CORPUS:job.corpus});}
  }
  if(written)invalidateNews_(false);Object.assign(job,{state:job.state==='Completada'?'Completada':'En curso',updated:new Date().toISOString(),error:'',pausedUntil:0});writeTaxonomyJob_(job);
  if(job.phase==='tag'){clearTaxonomyCheckpoints_();if(job.checkpoint){delete job.checkpoint;delete job.scanCursor;writeTaxonomyJob_(job);}}
  if(job.state==='Completada'){requestTaxonomyTranslations_();requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);}
  telemetry_('taxonomia',Date.now()-started,'OK',job.phase+'; '+job.processed+' revisadas; '+job.tagged+' etiquetas actualizadas');
 }catch(error){const durable=taxonomyJob_()||job;Object.assign(durable,{state:'En pausa',error:String(error.message).slice(0,180),pausedUntil:Date.now()+(serviceQuotaPause_(error)||settings_().retryMinutes*60000)});writeTaxonomyJob_(durable);telemetry_('taxonomia',Date.now()-started,'Error',durable.error);}
}

function observeTaxonomyRow_(state,row,definitions,excluded,publisher){
  if(!row.titular)return;
  const text=taxonomyText(row.titular+' '+row.extracto),url=newsUrlIdentity_(row.url),urlKey=url?'url:'+sha256_(url):'',identity=titleIdentity_({title:row.titular,date:row.fecha,publisher}),key=identity?sha256_(identity.key):'',days=state.titles[key]||[];
  const duplicate=urlKey&&Object.hasOwn(state.titles,urlKey)||identity&&days.some(day=>Math.abs(day-identity.day)<=COLLECTION_POLICY.duplicateDays);
  if(duplicate)return;
  if(urlKey)state.titles[urlKey]=[];
  if(identity){days.push(identity.day);state.titles[key]=days;}
  if(taxonomyEligible_(searchText_(row.titular),text))taxonomyObserve(state,text,definitions,excluded,publisher,{headline:row.titular,primary:taxonomyPrimarySource_(row)});
}

const taxonomyValidationMemory_=new WeakMap();
function taxonomyValidationIndex_(items){
  if(!taxonomyValidationMemory_.has(items)){
    const ids=new Set();for(const item of items){if(!item.id||ids.has(item.id))throw Error('Catálogo funcional con IDs vacíos o duplicados.');ids.add(item.id);}
    let model;taxonomyValidationMemory_.set(items,{ids,byId:new Map(items.map(item=>[item.id,item])),get model(){return model||(model=taxonomyModelRevision_(items));}});
  }
  return taxonomyValidationMemory_.get(items);
}
function validateTaxonomyAssignment_(saved,items,id,strict=true,row=null){
  const index=taxonomyValidationIndex_(items),fail=message=>{throw Error('Integridad taxonómica ['+id+']: '+message);};
  if(saved.invalid||new Set(saved.ids).size!==saved.ids.length||saved.ids.some(value=>!index.ids.has(value)))fail('IDs inexistentes o duplicados.');
  if((strict||saved.model)&&saved.model!==index.model)fail('Generación del catálogo distinta.');
  if(!strict)return;
  if(saved.version!==TAXONOMY_POLICY.version||!saved.reason||row&&saved.fingerprint!==taxonomyFingerprint_(row.titular,row.extracto))fail('Asignación pendiente de reproceso.');
  const assignments=saved.evidence?.assignments||[];
  if(saved.ids.length>TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxAssignments||assignments.length!==saved.ids.length||saved.ids.some((value,i)=>assignments[i]?.id!==value)||saved.ids.length&&saved.primary!==saved.ids[0])fail('Evidencia o categoría principal incompleta.');
  const text=row?taxonomyText(row.titular+' '+row.extracto):'',used=[];
  for(const evidence of assignments){
    if(!Array.isArray(evidence.terms)||!evidence.terms.length||!['literal','description'].includes(evidence.method)||row&&evidence.terms.some(term=>!taxonomyTermCounts(text,[term]).size))fail('Evidencia individual no verificable.');
    if(used.length&&!taxonomyIndependentEvidence(evidence,used))fail('Evidencia secundaria solapada o genérica.');
    used.push(...evidence.terms);
  }
}


function taxonomyCheckpointFirstRow_(){return 2+DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.views.length*2*DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOTS.parts;}
function readTaxonomyCheckpoint_(job){
 const manifest=job.checkpoint;if(!manifest)return {documents:0,candidates:{},titles:{}};
 const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('DashboardSnapshots'),rows=sheet?.getRange(manifest.first,1,manifest.parts,4).getDisplayValues();
 if(!rows||rows.some(([kind,generation,part],i)=>kind!=='taxonomy-checkpoint'||generation!==manifest.generation||Number(part)!==i))throw Error('Checkpoint de taxonomía incompleto.');
 const text=rows.map(row=>row[3]).join('');if(sha256_(text)!==manifest.digest)throw Error('Checkpoint de taxonomía corrupto.');return JSON.parse(text);
}
function taxonomyCheckpointFreeRow_(sheet,parts,keep=null){
 const first=taxonomyCheckpointFirstRow_(),count=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-first+1),rows=count?sheet.getRange(first,1,count,4).getDisplayValues():[];
 let start=first,free=0;
 for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
  const row=first+i,protectedRow=keep&&row>=keep.first&&row<keep.first+keep.parts;
  if(protectedRow||rows[i].some(value=>value!=='')){free=0;start=row+1;continue;}
  if(++free>=parts)return start;
 }
 return keep&&start<keep.first+keep.parts&&start+parts>keep.first?keep.first+keep.parts:start;
}
function saveTaxonomyCheckpoint_(job,state){
 const sheet=generationSheet_('DashboardSnapshots',RADAR.sheets.DashboardSnapshots),text=JSON.stringify(state),parts=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(text.length/40000)),first=taxonomyCheckpointFreeRow_(sheet,parts,job.checkpoint),generation=job.id+':'+Utilities.getUuid(),needed=first+parts-1;
 if(needed>sheet.getMaxRows())sheet.insertRowsAfter(sheet.getMaxRows(),needed-sheet.getMaxRows());
 sheet.getRange(first,1,parts,4).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(Array.from({length:parts},(_,i)=>['taxonomy-checkpoint',generation,String(i),text.slice(i*40000,(i+1)*40000)]));SpreadsheetApp.flush();
 const candidate={...job,checkpoint:{first,parts,generation,digest:sha256_(text)}};readTaxonomyCheckpoint_(candidate);writeTaxonomyJob_(candidate);job.checkpoint=candidate.checkpoint;clearTaxonomyCheckpoints_(candidate.checkpoint);
}
function clearTaxonomyCheckpoints_(keep=null){
 const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('DashboardSnapshots'),first=taxonomyCheckpointFirstRow_(),count=sheet?sheet.getLastRow()-first+1:0;if(count<=0)return;
 const rows=sheet.getRange(first,1,count,2).getDisplayValues();
 for(let start=0;start<rows.length;){if(rows[start][0]!=='taxonomy-checkpoint'||rows[start][1]===keep?.generation){start++;continue;}let end=start+1;while(end<rows.length&&rows[end][0]==='taxonomy-checkpoint'&&rows[end][1]!==keep?.generation)end++;sheet.getRange(first+start,1,end-start,4).clearContent();start=end;}
}

function taxonomyPath(row){return row.subpalanca?row.palanca+' › '+row.subpalanca:row.palanca;}
function taxonomySubLabel(value){return String(value||'').split(' › ').slice(1).join(' › ')||String(value||'');}
function taxonomyDisplayLabel(value){return taxonomySubLabel(value).replace(/^\d{2}\.(?:\d{2}\.|xx\s+)?\s*/, '');}
function taxonomyChoices(paths,selection={}){
  const rows=paths.map(value=>({value,palanca:value.split(' › ')[0],subpalanca:taxonomySubLabel(value)}));
  return {palanca:[...new Set(rows.filter(row=>!selection.subpalanca||row.subpalanca===taxonomySubLabel(selection.subpalanca)).map(row=>row.palanca))],subpalanca:rows.filter(row=>!selection.palanca||row.palanca===selection.palanca).map(row=>row.value)};
}

  const values=taxonomyTranslationIndex_(),unique=new Set(items.flatMap(row=>[row.palanca,row.subpalanca]).filter(Boolean)),result={};

function taxonomyLanguage_(language,names=taxonomyTranslations_()[language]||{}){

}
function translationCallsToday_(){
  const today=recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone),usage=JSON.parse(properties_().getProperty('NEWSLETTER_TRANSLATION_USAGE')||'{}');
  return (usage.day===today?Number(usage.calls)||0:0)+[translationJob_(),taxonomyTranslationJob_()].reduce((sum,job)=>sum+(job?.callDay===today?Number(job.calls||0):0),0);
}
function taxonomyTranslationPlan_(){const names=taxonomyTranslationNames_(),languages=Object.keys(languageNames).filter(language=>language!=='es').sort();return {names,languages,revision:sha256_(JSON.stringify([names,languages]))};}
function requestTaxonomyTranslations_(){
  const p=properties_(),{revision}=taxonomyTranslationPlan_();if(taxonomyTranslationJob_()?.revision===revision||p.getProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST')===revision)return false;
  p.setProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST',revision);ensureBackgroundWorker_();return true;
}
function taxonomyTranslationReadyAt_(){
  if(taxonomyPending_()||properties_().getProperty('TAXONOMY_REQUEST'))return Infinity;
  const job=taxonomyTranslationJob_(),request=properties_().getProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST');
  if(job?.state==='Publicando'||!request&&(!job||job.state==='Completada'))return Infinity;
  const paused=Number(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0);if(paused>Date.now())return paused;
  if(request)return Date.now();
  if(job?.pausedUntil>Date.now())return job.pausedUntil;
  if(translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls){
    // Wake after the daily budget resets, even if article translation is disabled.
    return nextDailyReset(Date.now(),settings_().timezone);
  }
  return Math.max(Date.now(),Number(job.pausedUntil||0));
}
function getTaxonomyTranslationStatus(){
  authorize_(true);return {job:withJobProgress_('taxonomyTranslation',taxonomyTranslationJob_(),Boolean(properties_().getProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST'))),queued:Boolean(properties_().getProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST')),newsRevision:publishedNewsRevision_(),taxonomyTranslations:taxonomyTranslations_()};
}
function startTaxonomyTranslations(){authorize_(true);requestTaxonomyTranslations_();return getTaxonomyTranslationStatus();}
function taxonomyTranslationBatch_(maxMs=TAXONOMY_POLICY.maxMs){
  if(Number(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0)>Date.now())return;
  if(taxonomyTranslationJob_()?.state==='Publicando')return;
  const started=Date.now(),p=properties_(),today=recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone);let job=taxonomyTranslationJob_(),written=false,touched=false;
  try{
    const {names,languages,revision}=taxonomyTranslationPlan_(),request=p.getProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST');
    if(job?.revision===revision&&job.state==='Completada'){if(request)p.deleteProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST');return;}
    if(!job||job.revision!==revision){
      job={revision,state:'Pendiente',total:names.length*languages.length,processed:0,translated:0,started:new Date().toISOString(),updated:new Date().toISOString(),calls:job?.callDay===today?job.calls:0,callDay:today,error:'',pausedUntil:0};
    }
    if(request&&p.getProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST')===request)p.deleteProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATION_REQUEST');
    if(job.callDay!==today){job.callDay=today;job.calls=0;job.pausedUntil=0;}
    if(job.pausedUntil>started)return;
    const index=taxonomyTranslationIndex_();let calls=0;
    touched=true;job.state='En curso';job.error='';writeTaxonomyTranslationJob_(job);
    while(job.processed<job.total&&Date.now()-started<maxMs&&!backgroundPaused_()){
      if(collectionRequests_().some(request=>request.kind==='daily'))break;
      const name=names[Math.floor(job.processed/languages.length)],language=languages[job.processed%languages.length],key=taxonomyTranslationKey_(name,language);
      if(!index.has(key)){
        const staticName=Object.hasOwn(translations,name);
        if(!staticName&&(calls>=TRANSLATION_WORK.batchCalls||translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls))break;
        if(!staticName){calls++;job.calls++;writeTaxonomyTranslationJob_(job);}
        const text=staticName?translateText(name,language):String(LanguageApp.translate(name,'',language)||'').trim();
        if(!text||text.length>5000)throw Error('Respuesta de traducción incompleta.');
        append_('TaxonomiaTraducciones',[[key,language,text,new Date().toISOString()]]);index.set(key,text);written=true;job.translated++;
      }
      job.processed++;
    }
    job.state=job.processed===job.total?'Completada':translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls?'En pausa':'Pendiente';
    if(job.state==='En pausa')job.error='Límite diario de traducción alcanzado. Continuará en la siguiente ejecución diaria.';
    if(job.state==='Completada'){
      const active=new Set(names.flatMap(name=>languages.map(language=>taxonomyTranslationKey_(name,language)))),sheet=book_().getSheetByName('TaxonomiaTraducciones'),rows=rows_('TaxonomiaTraducciones'),kept=rows.filter(row=>active.has(row.clave));
      if(kept.length!==rows.length){
        if(kept.length)sheet.getRange(2,1,kept.length,4).setValues(kept.map(row=>RADAR.sheets.TaxonomiaTraducciones.map(key=>row[key])));
        sheet.getRange(kept.length+2,1,rows.length-kept.length,4).clearContent();taxonomyTranslationMemory_=new Map(kept.map(row=>[row.clave,row.texto]));written=true;
      }
    }
    telemetry_('traduccion-taxonomia',Date.now()-started,'OK',job.processed+'/'+job.total+' nombres; '+calls+' llamadas');
  }catch(error){
    if(!job)throw error;
    if(serviceQuotaPause_(error))p.setProperty('TRANSLATION_PAUSED_UNTIL',String(Date.now()+serviceQuotaPause_(error)));
    touched=true;Object.assign(job,{state:'En pausa',error:'Traducción temporalmente no disponible. Se reintentará automáticamente.',pausedUntil:Date.now()+(serviceQuotaPause_(error)||TRANSLATION_WORK.retryMs)});
    telemetry_('traduccion-taxonomia',Date.now()-started,'Error',String(error.message).slice(0,180));
  }finally{if(written){p.setProperty('TAXONOMY_TRANSLATIONS_REVISION',Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));invalidateNews_(false,false);}if(job&&touched){job.updated=new Date().toISOString();writeTaxonomyTranslationJob_(job);}if(touched&&job?.state==='Completada')requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);}
}

function getTranslationStatus(){authorize_(true);return {newsRevision:publishedNewsRevision_(),scheduled:properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_ENABLED')!=='false',timezone:settings_().timezone,job:withJobProgress_('translation',translationJob_(),Boolean(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST'))),queued:Boolean(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST'))};}
function translationCandidates_(job){
  return businessNewsIndex_().rows.filter(row=>row.captured<=job.started&&(!job.cursor||row.fecha<job.cursor.fecha||row.fecha===job.cursor.fecha&&row.id<job.cursor.id)).sort((a,b)=>a.fecha===b.fecha?(a.id===b.id?0:a.id>b.id?-1:1):a.fecha>b.fecha?-1:1);
}
function translationCompletionRevision_(){const p=properties_().getProperties();return sha256_(JSON.stringify([RADAR.version,newsStorageKey_(),p.NEWS_CONTENT_REVISION||'0',p.NEWS_RECORDS_REVISION||'0',p.CONFIG_REVISION||'0',p.TRANSLATIONS_INDEX_REVISION||'0',Object.keys(languageNames).map(code=>[code,p['TRANSLATIONS_REVISION:'+code]||'0'])]));}
function markTranslationComplete_(){if(!properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST'))properties_().setProperty('TRANSLATION_COMPLETED_REVISION',translationCompletionRevision_());}
function translationBatch_(maxMs=TRANSLATION_WORK.maxMs){
  const existing=translationJob_();if(existing?.state==='Publicando')return;
  const revision=translationCompletionRevision_();if(existing?.state==='Completada'&&properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_COMPLETED_REVISION')===revision){properties_().deleteProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST');properties_().deleteProperty('TRANSLATION_PRIORITY_REQUEST');return;}
  const started=Date.now(),now=new Date(started),today=recordDay(now,settings_().timezone);let job;
  try{
    const paused=Number(properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_PAUSED_UNTIL')||0);if(paused>started)return;
    job=translationJob_();const request=properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST');
    if(!job||properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_PRIORITY_REQUEST')||request&&(job.state==='Completada'||recordDay(job.started,settings_().timezone)<today))job={state:'Pendiente',started:now.toISOString(),updated:now.toISOString(),total:0,processed:0,translated:0,errors:0,calls:job?.callDay===today?job.calls:0,callDay:today,cursor:null,error:'',pausedUntil:0};
    if(job.state==='Completada'&&!request)return;
    if(job.callDay!==today){job.callDay=today;job.calls=0;job.pausedUntil=0;job.error='';}
    const candidates=translationCandidates_(job);job.total=job.processed+candidates.length;job.businessPending=candidates.filter(row=>row.priority===0).length;
    if(!candidates.length){job.state='Completada';job.error='';if(request&&job.started>=request&&properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST')===request){properties_().deleteProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST');properties_().deleteProperty('TRANSLATION_PRIORITY_REQUEST');}markTranslationComplete_();return;}
    writeTranslationJob_(job);if(request&&job.started>=request&&properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST')===request){properties_().deleteProperty('TRANSLATION_REQUEST');properties_().deleteProperty('TRANSLATION_PRIORITY_REQUEST');}
    if(job.pausedUntil>started)return;
    if(translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls&&candidates.length){job.state='En pausa';job.pausedUntil=nextDailyReset(Date.now(),settings_().timezone);job.error='Límite diario de traducción alcanzado. Continuará en la siguiente ejecución diaria.';return;}
    job.state='En curso';job.error='';writeTranslationJob_(job);
    const feeds=new Set(configuration_().feeds.map(feed=>feed.name)),known=articleTranslationIndex_();let calls=0;
    outer:for(let offset=0;offset<Math.min(candidates.length,TRANSLATION_WORK.batchRows);offset+=TRANSLATION_WORK.readRows){
      if(backgroundPaused_()||Date.now()-started>=maxMs)break;
      const selected=candidates.slice(offset,offset+TRANSLATION_WORK.readRows),articles=newsRowsForCandidates_(selected);
      for(const candidate of selected){
        if(backgroundPaused_()||Date.now()-started>=maxMs||collectionRequests_().some(request=>request.kind==='daily'))break outer;
        const row=articles.get(candidate.id);
        if(row)for(const language of Object.keys(languageNames)){
          if(backgroundPaused_()||Date.now()-started>=maxMs||collectionRequests_().some(request=>request.kind==='daily'))break outer;
          if(nativeArticle_(row,language,feeds)||known.has(articleTranslationKey_(row,language)))continue;
          if(calls>=TRANSLATION_WORK.batchCalls||translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls)break outer;
          calls++;job.calls++;writeTranslationJob_(job);storeArticleTranslation_(row,language);job.translated++;
        }
        job.processed++;job.cursor={id:candidate.id,fecha:candidate.fecha,priority:candidate.priority};if(candidate.priority===0)job.businessPending--;job.updated=new Date().toISOString();writeTranslationJob_(job);
      }
    }
    job.state=job.processed===job.total?'Completada':translationCallsToday_()>=TRANSLATION_WORK.dailyCalls?'En pausa':'Pendiente';
    if(job.state==='En pausa'){job.pausedUntil=nextDailyReset(Date.now(),settings_().timezone);job.error='Límite diario de traducción alcanzado. Continuará en la siguiente ejecución diaria.';}
    if(job.state==='Completada'){compactArticleTranslations_();markTranslationComplete_();}
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();telemetry_('traduccion',Date.now()-started,'OK',job.processed+'/'+job.total+' noticias; '+calls+' llamadas; '+job.translated+' traducciones guardadas');
  }catch(error){
    if(!job)throw error;
    if(serviceQuotaPause_(error))properties_().setProperty('TRANSLATION_PAUSED_UNTIL',String(Date.now()+serviceQuotaPause_(error)));
    job.state='En pausa';job.errors++;job.error='Traducción temporalmente no disponible. Se reintentará automáticamente.';job.pausedUntil=Date.now()+(serviceQuotaPause_(error)||TRANSLATION_WORK.retryMs);
    telemetry_('traduccion',Date.now()-started,'Error',String(error.message).slice(0,180));
  }finally{if(job){job.updated=new Date().toISOString();writeTranslationJob_(job);if(job.state==='Completada')requestDashboardSnapshots_(true);}}
}

let articleTranslationRows_,articleTranslationMemory_;
function articleFingerprint_(row){return sha256_(String(row.titular||'')+'\n'+String(row.extracto||''));}
function articleTranslationKey_(row,language){return language+':'+articleFingerprint_(row);}
let articleIdentityTitlesMemory_;
function articleIdentityTitles_(){
  const revisions=Object.keys(languageNames).map(language=>properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATIONS_REVISION:'+language)||'0'),revision=JSON.stringify(revisions);
  if(articleIdentityTitlesMemory_?.revision===revision)return articleIdentityTitlesMemory_.values;
  const key='news-records:translation-titles:'+sha256_(revision),cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),cached=readDashboardCache_(cache,key);
  if(cached){const values=new Map(cached);articleIdentityTitlesMemory_={revision,values};return values;}
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Traducciones'),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1,variants=new Map();
  // Deduplication needs titles only; never fetch or cache translated excerpts here.
  for(let offset=0;offset<count;offset+=2000)for(const [key,language,title] of sheet.getRange(offset+2,1,Math.min(2000,count-offset),3).getDisplayValues()){
    if(!supportedLanguage(language)||!key.startsWith(language+':'))continue;
    const fingerprint=key.slice(language.length+1),titles=variants.get(fingerprint)||new Map();titles.set(language,title);variants.set(fingerprint,titles);
  }
  const values=new Map([...variants].map(([fingerprint,titles])=>[fingerprint,[...new Set(Object.keys(languageNames).map(language=>titles.get(language)).filter(Boolean))]]));
  writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,[...values]);articleIdentityTitlesMemory_={revision,values};return values;
}
function translationIdentityRows_(rows){
  if(!rows.length||!Object.keys(languageNames).some(language=>properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATIONS_REVISION:'+language)))return rows;
  const titles=articleIdentityTitles_();
  rows.forEach(row=>{row.identityTitles=titles.size?(titles.get(articleFingerprint_(row.original||row))||[]):[];});
  return rows;
}
function articleTranslationIndexKey_(){return 'article-index:'+sha256_(JSON.stringify([book_().getSheetByName('Traducciones').getLastRow(),properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATIONS_INDEX_REVISION')||'0',Object.keys(languageNames).map(language=>properties_().getProperty('TRANSLATIONS_REVISION:'+language)||'0')]));}
function articleTranslationIndex_(){
  if(articleTranslationRows_)return articleTranslationRows_;
  const key=articleTranslationIndexKey_(),cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),cached=readDashboardCache_(cache,key);if(cached)return articleTranslationRows_=new Map(cached);
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Traducciones'),count=sheet.getLastRow()-1,entries=count?sheet.getRange(2,1,count,1).getDisplayValues().map(([key],index)=>[key,index+2]):[];
  writeDashboardCache_(cache,key,entries);return articleTranslationRows_=new Map(entries);
}
function cachedArticleTranslations_(keys){
  articleTranslationMemory_=articleTranslationMemory_||new Map();
  const missing=[...new Set(keys)].filter(key=>!articleTranslationMemory_.has(key));if(!missing.length)return articleTranslationMemory_;
  const cache=CacheService.getScriptCache(),cached=cache.getAll(missing.map(key=>'article:'+key)),uncached=[];
  for(const key of missing){const value=cached['article:'+key];if(value)articleTranslationMemory_.set(key,JSON.parse(value));else uncached.push(key);}
  if(!uncached.length)return articleTranslationMemory_;
  const index=articleTranslationIndex_(),positions=uncached.filter(key=>index.has(key)).map(key=>({key,row:index.get(key)})).sort((a,b)=>a.row-b.row),values={};
  for(const key of uncached)articleTranslationMemory_.set(key,null);
  const byRow=new Map(positions.map(({key,row})=>[row,key]));
  for(const [first,last] of sheetRowRanges_(positions.map(item=>item.row),64)){
    const rows=book_().getSheetByName('Traducciones').getRange(first,3,last-first+1,2).getDisplayValues();
    rows.forEach(([titular,extracto],offset)=>{const key=byRow.get(first+offset);if(!key)return;const value={titular:plainText_(titular),extracto:plainText_(extracto)};articleTranslationMemory_.set(key,value);const encoded=cacheJsonValue_(value);if(encoded)values['article:'+key]=encoded;});
  }
  if(Object.keys(values).length)try{cache.putAll(values,21600);}catch(_){}return articleTranslationMemory_;
}
function translateArticleText_(row,language){
  const escape=value=>String(value||'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,char=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[char]));
  const title=plainText_(row.titular).slice(0,5000),excerpt=plainText_(row.extracto).slice(0,5000),hasExcerpt=Boolean(excerpt),input='<p id="headline">'+escape(title)+'</p>'+(hasExcerpt?'<p id="excerpt">'+escape(excerpt)+'</p>':'');
  const html=LanguageApp.translate(input,'',language,{contentType:'html'});
  const blocks=[...html.matchAll(/<p\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/p>/gi)].map(match=>plainText_(match[1]));
  if(blocks.length!==(hasExcerpt?2:1)||!blocks[0]||(hasExcerpt&&!blocks[1]))throw Error('Respuesta de traducción incompleta.');
  return {titular:blocks[0].slice(0,5000),extracto:hasExcerpt?blocks[1].slice(0,5000):''};
}
function nativeArticle_(row,language,feeds){return feeds.has(row.fuente)&&String(row.idioma||'').toLowerCase().split(/[-_]/)[0]===language;}
function savedArticleTranslations_(rows,language){
  const feeds=new Set(configuration_().feeds.map(feed=>feed.name));
  const keys=rows.map(row=>nativeArticle_(row,language,feeds)?null:articleTranslationKey_(row,language)),values=cachedArticleTranslations_(keys.filter(Boolean));
  return rows.map((row,index)=>{
    if(nativeArticle_(row,language,feeds))return {...row,translation:{language,state:'native'}};
    const value=values.get(keys[index]);
    return {...row,...(value?{...value,original:{titular:row.titular,extracto:row.extracto}}:{}),translation:{language,state:value?'translated':'pending'}};
  });
}
function storeArticleTranslation_(row,language){
  const key=articleTranslationKey_(row,language),value=translateArticleText_(row,language),index=articleTranslationIndex_(),sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Traducciones'),position=index.get(key)||sheet.getLastRow()+1,values=[[key,language,value.titular,value.extracto,new Date().toISOString()]];
  if(index.has(key))sheet.getRange(position,1,1,5).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(values.map(row=>row.map(safeCell_)));else append_('Traducciones',values);index.set(key,position);
  articleTranslationMemory_=articleTranslationMemory_||new Map();articleTranslationMemory_.set(key,value);cacheJson_('article:'+key,value,21600);
  const revision=Date.now()+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  properties_().setProperties({['TRANSLATIONS_REVISION:'+language]:revision,NEWS_REVISION:revision});return value;
}

function compactArticleTranslations_(){
  const sheet=book_().getSheetByName('Traducciones'),count=Math.max(0,sheet.getLastRow()-1);if(!count)return;
  const fingerprints=new Set();
  const source=newsSheet_(),total=source.getLastRow()-1;
  for(let offset=0;offset<total;offset+=1000)for(const [titular,extracto] of source.getRange(offset+2,6,Math.min(1000,total-offset),2).getDisplayValues())fingerprints.add(articleFingerprint_({titular,extracto}));
  const rows=sheet.getRange(2,1,count,5).getDisplayValues(),unique=new Map();
  for(const row of rows)if(supportedLanguage(row[1])&&row[0].startsWith(row[1]+':')&&fingerprints.has(row[0].slice(row[1].length+1)))unique.set(row[0],row);
  if(unique.size===rows.length)return;
  const kept=[...unique.values()];
  if(kept.length)sheet.getRange(2,1,kept.length,5).setNumberFormat('@').setValues(kept.map(row=>row.map(safeCell_)));
  sheet.getRange(kept.length+2,1,count-kept.length,5).clearContent();
  properties_().setProperty('TRANSLATIONS_INDEX_REVISION',Utilities.getUuid());articleTranslationRows_=undefined;articleTranslationMemory_=undefined;articleIdentityTitlesMemory_=undefined;
  const revision=Utilities.getUuid();for(const language of Object.keys(languageNames))properties_().setProperty('TRANSLATIONS_REVISION:'+language,revision);
}

const identityIndexes=new Map();
function identityKey(value){return String(value||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/^https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?|^www\./,'').replace(/\/$/,'');}
function identityAsset(kind,name){
 if(!identityIndexes.has(kind)){
  const index=new Map();
  for(const [label,asset] of Object.entries(IDENTITY_ASSETS[kind]||{}))for(const alias of [label,...(asset.aliases||[])])index.set(identityKey(alias),asset);
  identityIndexes.set(kind,index);
 }
 const canonical=kind==='entities'&&typeof entityKey_==='function'?entityKey_(name):kind==='publishers'&&typeof publisherKey_==='function'?publisherKey_(name):name;
 return identityIndexes.get(kind).get(identityKey(canonical))||identityIndexes.get(kind).get(identityKey(name));
}
function identityMark(kind,name,escape,images){
 const asset=identityAsset(kind,name);
 if(!asset)return kind==='entities'&&name?'<span class="entity-monogram" title="'+escape(name)+'" aria-label="'+escape(name)+'">'+escape(name.split(/\s+/).map(word=>word.replace(/^[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/u,'')[0]||'').join('').slice(0,2))+'</span>':'';
 if(images)images.set(asset.id,asset);
 const src=images?'cid:'+asset.id:'data:image/png;base64,'+asset.data;
 return '<img class="'+(kind==='countries'?'geography-flag':kind==='publishers'?'publisher-logo':'entity-logo')+'" src="'+src+'" width="'+asset.width+'" height="'+asset.height+'" alt="'+escape(name)+'" title="'+escape(name)+'"'+(images?'':' loading="lazy" decoding="async"')+'>';
}
function storyIdentity(entity,country,escape,images){
 const marks=identityMark('entities',entity,escape,images)+identityMark('countries',country,escape,images);
 return marks?'<span class="story-identity">'+marks+'</span>':'';
}

const WORK_COORDINATION=Object.freeze({waitMs:60000,leaseMs:600000,resumeMs:60000,pollMs:1000});
let workPauseCheck_;
function backgroundPaused_(cached=false){
  const now=Date.now();
  if(!cached||!workPauseCheck_||now-workPauseCheck_.checked>=WORK_COORDINATION.pollMs){
    const values=properties_().getProperties();
    workPauseCheck_={checked:now,until:Math.max(0,...Object.entries(values).filter(([key])=>key.startsWith('WORK_INTENT:')).map(([,value])=>Number(value)||0))};
  }
  return workPauseCheck_.until>now;
}
function deferBackgroundWork_(name){properties_().setProperty('WORK_PENDING:'+name,'true');}
function scheduleWorkWake_(delay){
  scheduledTriggers_('workWake_').forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));
  ScriptApp.newTrigger('workWake_').timeBased().after(delay).create();
}
function withForegroundWrite_(operation){
  const properties=properties_(),intent='WORK_INTENT:'+Utilities.getUuid(),lock=LockService.getScriptLock();let acquired=false;
  try{
    properties.setProperty(intent,String(Date.now()+WORK_COORDINATION.leaseMs));
    for(const [handler,name] of [['backgroundTick_','background'],['newsletterTick_','newsletter']])if(scheduledTriggers_(handler).length)deferBackgroundWork_(name);
    if(!lock.tryLock(WORK_COORDINATION.waitMs))throw Error('El trabajo activo aún no ha liberado el bloqueo. Vuelve a intentarlo cuando termine su llamada en curso.');
    acquired=true;return operation();
  }finally{
    try{if(acquired){try{SpreadsheetApp.flush();}finally{lock.releaseLock();}}}
    finally{
      properties.deleteProperty(intent);workPauseCheck_=undefined;
      scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);
    }
  }
}
function workWake_(){
  if(backgroundPaused_()){scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);return;}
  const lock=LockService.getScriptLock();let acquired=false;
  try{
    if(!lock.tryLock(1000)){scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);return;}acquired=true;
    const properties=properties_(),values=properties.getProperties(),now=Date.now();
    if(Object.entries(values).some(([key,value])=>key.startsWith('WORK_INTENT:')&&Number(value)>now)){scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);return;}
    scheduledTriggers_('workWake_').forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));
    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(values))if(key.startsWith('WORK_INTENT:')&&Number(value)<=Date.now())properties_().deleteProperty(key);
    workPauseCheck_={checked:now,until:0};
    const pending=Object.keys(values).filter(key=>key.startsWith('WORK_PENDING:'));
    for(const key of pending){
      if(backgroundPaused_(true)){scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);return;}
      const name=key.slice('WORK_PENDING:'.length);
      if(name==='daily')requestDailyPipeline_();
      else if(name==='classification'){properties_().setProperty('CLASSIFICATION_REQUEST',recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone));ensureBackgroundWorker_();}
      else if(name==='taxonomy'){properties_().setProperty('TAXONOMY_REQUEST',recordDay(new Date(),settings_().timezone));ensureBackgroundWorker_();}
      else if(name==='edited'){invalidateConfiguration_();requestNewsClassification_(true);}
      else if(name==='news')invalidateNews_();
      else if(name==='newsletter')ensureNewsletterContinuation_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);
      else if(name==='background'){scheduledTriggers_('backgroundTick_').forEach(trigger=>ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(trigger));properties_().deleteProperty('BACKGROUND_NEXT');}
      if(backgroundPaused_()){scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);return;}
      properties_().deleteProperty(key);
    }
    if(pending.includes('WORK_PENDING:background'))ensureBackgroundWorker_();
  }catch(error){scheduleWorkWake_(WORK_COORDINATION.resumeMs);throw error;}
  finally{if(acquired)lock.releaseLock();}
}
